works.title: The sulfur content and isotopic composition of the subarc mantle
works.abstract: Sulfur plays a critical role in modulating redox cycling on Earth. Yet, sulfur’s behavior during subduction and in mantle redox reactions is debated. We analyzed 34 S/ 32 S in mafic arc melt inclusions from contrasting subduction zones and modeled slab-mantle interaction to investigate the subduction zone sulfur cycle. We find that degassing may enrich or deplete the melt strongly in 34 S as a function of melt redox state. After correction for this effect, arc magmas have a substantially narrow range of δ 34 S values (+3 ± 2‰), higher than the ambient upper mantle (−1‰). Slab-derived sulfur is oxidized, evidenced by a concurrent increase in mantle Fe 3+ and sulfur contents, and contributes up to 86% of the mantle wedge’s sulfur budget. Arc magma δ 34 S values reflect a common slab source for sulfur: the oceanic crust. Subduction zones act as a “filter” for oxidative power and 34 S, effectively returning these to the surface over geological timescales.
works.label: flagship
works.translated_title: 俯冲弧下地幔的硫含量及同位素组成

summary_bullets.research_question: 硫在俯冲过程中的行为和地幔氧化还原反应如何？
summary_bullets.methodology: 分析了俯冲带镁铁质弧熔体包裹体中的硫同位素，并模拟了板片-地幔相互作用。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 弧岩浆δ34S值经校正后集中为+3±2‰，俯冲板片的氧化性硫贡献了地幔楔中高达86%的硫预算。
summary_bullets.innovation: 揭示了熔体氧化还原状态对脱气过程中硫同位素分馏的控制作用，并量化了板片硫的贡献。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 阐明了俯冲带作为氧化能和34S的“过滤器”，在地质时间尺度上将它们返回地表的关键机制。

works.title: The role of continental and oceanic subduction in generating the giant Jiaodong gold province, China: Constraints from mercury isotopes
works.abstract: Mantle metasomatism has been increasingly recognized as a key process in the formation of giant gold deposits at craton margins, but its specific role remains controversial. The lithospheric mantle beneath the Cretaceous Jiaodong gold province at the eastern margin of the North China Craton was metasomatized by both Triassic continental subduction and Jurassic–Cretaceous oceanic subduction. To clarify the influence of mantle metasomatism on the giant gold endowment, this study systematically examined Hg isotopic compositions of pyrite from representative gold deposits across the western (Jiaobei Terrane) to eastern (Sulu Terrane) parts of the Jiaodong Peninsula. Gold deposits in the Jiaobei Terrane exhibit mixed terrestrial and marine Hg isotopic signatures (δ202Hg: −2.51‰ to 0.62‰; Δ199Hg: −0.24‰ to 0.17‰), whereas those in the Sulu Terrane display predominantly marine-derived Hg isotopic characteristics (δ202Hg: −0.73‰ to − 0.19‰; Δ199Hg: −0.05‰ to 0.10‰) with no significant terrestrial influence. These findings suggest that the mantle beneath Jiaobei was metasomatized by both continental and oceanic components, while that under Sulu was primarily overprinted by oceanic subduction. Given that most gold resources of Jiaodong occur within the Jiaobei Terrane, we propose that the synergistic effects of continental and oceanic subduction were critical in forming giant gold deposits. Continental subduction might have contributed to Au pre-enrichment in the lithospheric mantle, while oceanic subduction might have introduced oxidizing agents and volatiles that promoted gold mobilization. This implies that the junction between continental and oceanic subduction zones provides a particularly favorable setting for giant gold deposit formation.

works.translated_title: 大陆和海洋俯冲在形成中国巨型胶东金矿省中的作用：来自汞同位素的制约

summary_bullets.research_question: 探讨大陆与海洋俯冲导致的地幔交代如何影响胶东巨型金矿省的形成。
summary_bullets.methodology: 系统分析胶北与苏鲁地体代表性金矿床中黄铁矿的汞同位素组成。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 胶北显示大陆-海洋混合汞信号，苏鲁仅具海洋特征，多数金资源赋存于受双重交代的胶北地体。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次用汞同位素揭示大陆俯冲提供金预富集、海洋俯冲引入氧化剂和挥发分的协同成矿作用。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 指明大陆与海洋俯冲交汇区是巨型金矿形成的极有利场所，为区域找矿提供新方向。

works.title: Late Neoarchean subduction triggered mantle oxidation through slab melting: Insights from the Zanhuang Complex
works.abstract: The redox state of the Archean mantle was a critical control on early Earth’s degassing and atmospheric oxygen evolution. Yet, the timing, extent, and mechanisms of its oxidation remain poorly constrained. To address this, we investigated the oxygen fugacity (fO2) of 2.58–2.49 Ga metamorphosed mafic rocks from the Zanhuang Complex, North China Craton. These rocks exhibit geochemical and isotopic signatures (whole-rock and zircon) indicative of late Neoarchean metasomatism by fluids/melts derived from 2.7 Ga and 2.9 Ga oceanic/continental crust. Mantle source fO2, calculated from primitive samples using V-Sc and V-Ti systems, averages ΔFMQ − 0.88 ± 0.48—significantly more oxidized than the middle Neoarchean upper mantle (ΔFMQ − 2.14 ± 0.09). This oxidation is attributed to a hydrous melt generated by eclogite-facies metamorphosed subducted oceanic crust and overlying terrigenous sediments. Key evidence includes positive correlations between ΔFMQ and fluid-mobile indices (LOI and Ba/La), and negative correlations between zircon ε Hf(t) and ΔFMQ and between whole-rock V/Sc and ε Nd(t), which point to source enrichment. The oxidation process was facilitated by residual, ferrous iron-rich garnet in the source, as indicated by the positive correlation between ΔFMQ and δ 56Fe, as well as between ΔFMQ and the Dy/Yb ratio in whole-rock and zircon analyses. Phase equilibrium modeling of a hybrid source (80% MORB and 20% late Archean metapelite) at 700–850 °C and 12–16 kbar predicts ∼ 30 wt% melt yielded with, ∼15 wt% H2O, ΔFMQ of ∼ − 0.3, and Dy/Yb of ∼ 2.0. These properties closely match those inferred for the metasomatizing agent. Thus, late Neoarchean subduction and melting of oceanic crust coupled with sedimentary material not only oxidized the mantle wedge but also likely contributed to the environmental preconditioning for the Great Oxidation Event in the early Paleoproterozoic.

works.translated_title: 新太古代晚期俯冲作用通过板片熔融触发地幔氧化：来自赞皇杂岩的启示

summary_bullets.research_question: 太古宙晚期地幔氧化的时间、程度和机制仍不明确，本文探究华北克拉通赞皇杂岩的氧化态及其成因。
summary_bullets.methodology: 利用V-Sc、V-Ti氧逸度计、全岩及锆石地球化学和相平衡模拟，反演变质基性岩的地幔源区氧化条件。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 晚新太古代地幔已显著氧化，源于俯冲洋壳和沉积物的榴辉岩相熔融产生的含水熔体交代作用。
summary_bullets.innovation: 将铁同位素、元素比值与相平衡模拟结合，首次揭示残留石榴石对氧化熔体形成的关键作用。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为理解大氧化事件前的地幔氧化机制提供新证据，对追索早期地球表面环境演变具有重要价值。

works.title: Continental-type eclogites in southern East Kunlun Orogen reveal Ordovician collision of the Paleo- and Proto-Tethyan terranes
works.abstract: The East Kunlun Orogen (EKO) is a compound orogenic belt and a Proto-Tethyan tectonic collage. Its constituent blocks document long-term accretionary and collision processes, with episodic, arc-related magmatism and dispersal of several eclogite-hosting units along the orogenic strike. To shed new light on the controversial Early Paleozoic accretion of the EKO to adjoining Gondwana-derived terranes to the south, we present the first investigation of eclogite blocks in banded orthogneisses from the upper Hatu Valley, southern EKO. The Hatu eclogites exhibit varying modal abundances of green amphibole, garnet, omphacite, phengite pseudomorphs, plagioclase, and quartz. Most omphacite and all phengite in the matrix have been replaced by calcic clinopyroxene–plagioclase and biotite–plagioclase symplectites, respectively. The inferred peak assemblage is garnet + omphacite (with 20–28 mol% jadeite) + calcic amphibole + phengite. Pseudosection modeling and conventional thermobarometry reveal a clockwise, four-stage P–T path with peak conditions of 620–700 °C and 14–16 kbar, typical of warm continental subduction. The protoliths of the Hatu eclogites were derived from metasomatized mantle, most likely in a rifted continental-margin setting rather than a mid-ocean ridge environment. Differences in mineralogy, whole-rock geochemistry, and P–T paths during exhumation between the Hatu eclogites and their central EKO equivalents may reflect two distinct tectonic regimes within the Proto-Tethyan subduction system. The concordant, ∼1.10-Ga U–Pb ages of magmatic zircon cores in orthogneisses link the eclogite–gneiss association to the Bayanhar terrane that rifted away from the Gondwana supercontinent. The ∼ 450-Ma U–Pb ages of metamorphic overgrowths on zircon from eclogites and the host granitic gneisses suggest an in situ eclogite origin, supporting the Ordovician collision between the Proto- and Paleo-Tethyan terranes. This is consistent with the first occurrence of A-type granites in the southern EKO at ∼ 440 Ma, which typically form in post-orogenic extensional settings.

works.translated_title: 东昆仑造山带南部的大陆型榴辉岩揭示了古特提斯与原特提斯地体的奥陶纪碰撞

summary_bullets.research_question: 揭示东昆仑南缘哈图榴辉岩的变质演化与构造意义，约束早古生代原特提斯与古特提斯地体碰撞过程。
summary_bullets.methodology: 综合岩相学、相平衡模拟、传统温压计、全岩地球化学及锆石U-Pb年代学分析。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 哈图榴辉岩经历顺时针P-T轨迹，峰期620–700°C和14–16 kbar，原岩为裂谷大陆边缘交代地幔，碰撞时代~450 Ma。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次报道东昆仑南缘哈图榴辉岩，提出原、古特提斯地体在奥陶纪碰撞的新证据。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为青藏高原北部早古生代增生造山过程提供关键制约，挑战原有构造演化模型。

works.title: (Ultra)high‐Pressure Metamorphism in Sedimentary Versus Basaltic Rocks: Insights From a Variscan Mélange in the South Carpathians
works.abstract: ABSTRACT Reconstructing the pressure–temperature–time ( P–T–t ) evolution of (ultra)high‐pressure rocks is essential for constraining subduction and collisional dynamics. Subduction zones are often investigated using basic eclogites, whereas nonbasic high‐pressure rocks remain comparatively understudied, potentially hindering a comprehensive understanding of complex subduction systems. The Bughea Complex is a modern‐style mélange within the pre‐Alpine basement of the South Carpathians (Romania) that hosts a wide variety of eclogitic rocks, providing an opportunity to investigate their response to subduction processes. Here, we integrate phase equilibrium modelling, rutile thermometry, zircon and apatite U–Pb dating coupled with trace element analysis and garnet Lu‐Hf dating to reconstruct the P–T–t evolution of three different eclogitic rocks from the Bughea Complex: a kyanite eclogite, a basic eclogite and an eclogitic schist. The kyanite eclogite is interpreted to derive from a continental sedimentary protolith based on its continental crust‐like trace‐element patterns and detrital‐like zircon U–Pb age spectrum (ranging from Archean to Cambrian). It records the highest peak pressure conditions (~3.2–3.6 GPa at 700°C–820°C), consistent with ultrahigh‐pressure metamorphism, followed by decompression and cooling to P–T–t records may reflect mélange rheology and variations in subduction dynamics, whereas limited heating during retrogression and compositional buoyancy appear critical for preserving peak conditions, particularly in nonbasic rocks. Overall, these findings demonstrate that continental‐derived metasedimentary rocks can preserve evidence of extreme pressure conditions not always recorded by associated basic eclogites, highlighting the importance of integrating nonbasic high‐pressure rocks into P – T – t reconstructions of subduction‐related mélanges to achieve a more complete understanding of complex collisional systems.

works.translated_title: 沉积岩与玄武岩中的（超）高压变质作用：来自南喀尔巴阡山脉瓦里斯坎混杂岩的启示

summary_bullets.research_question: 如何通过研究俯冲带混杂岩中不同类型榴辉岩的P–T–t演化，揭示基性与沉积岩在超高压变质作用中的差异记录？
summary_bullets.methodology: 结合相平衡模拟、金红石温度计、锆石和磷灰石U–Pb定年及微量元素分析、石榴石Lu–Hf定年。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 源自沉积原岩的蓝晶石榴辉岩记录了最高压力条件（~3.2–3.6 GPa），而基性榴辉岩则未达到超高压。
summary_bullets.innovation: 证明大陆来源变沉积岩能保存基性榴辉岩中未记录的极端压力证据，强调对其研究有助更全面理解俯冲系统。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为复杂碰撞带超高压变质重建提供新视角，提示研究者需整合非基性高压岩石以避免缺失关键深俯冲记录。

works.title:
Gravitational Stability of Hydrated SiO
                    <sub>2</sub>
                    and Basaltic Crust in the Lower Mantle
works.abstract: Abstract We determined thermal equations of state of hydrated stishovite and CaCl 2 ‐type SiO 2 up to 100 GPa and 3,000 K to assess the gravitational stability of hydrated stishovite and basaltic crust in the lower mantle. Using machine‐learning based atomistic simulations, we examined three hydrogen dissolution mechanisms: hydrogarnet‐type, interstitial H 2 O, and coupled Al 3+ + H + substitution. Hydrogen dissolution lowers SiO 2 densities throughout the lower mantle and reduces bulk sound velocities at its upper part. Hydrated basaltic crust with 1–4 wt% H 2 O in SiO 2 remains 1%–2.4% denser than the mantle and can sink to the lowermost mantle, potentially forming water‐rich reservoirs influencing seismic and electrical anomalies at depths. Stishovite with 0.3–2.2 wt% H 2 O is neutrally buoyant at 730–800 km, supporting its role as a source of low shear‐wave velocity layers beneath North America, Japan, and the European Alps subduction regions. These results provide new insights into water storage and transport in the deep mantle.

works.translated_title: 下地幔中含水SiO<sub>2</sub>与玄武质地壳的重力稳定性

summary_bullets.research_question: 评估水合斯石英和玄武岩地壳在下地幔的重力稳定性。
summary_bullets.methodology: 采用基于机器学习的原子模拟，确定水合SiO₂高达100 GPa和3000 K的热状态方程。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 氢溶解降低SiO₂密度和声速；水合玄武岩地壳较周围地幔致密，可沉至地幔底部；斯石英在730–800 km中性浮力。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次用机器学习模拟揭示深部水合SiO₂的热弹性及其对深部水循环的影响。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为解释深部地幔地震与电异常、水储库形成及俯冲带低速层机制提供新依据。

works.title: Sources and mechanisms for two mineralization stages at Chaihulanzi, North China Craton: constraints from mineralogy, trace elements, and in situ sulfur isotopes
works.abstract: The Chaihulanzi gold deposit, situated along the northern margin of the North China Craton, contains over 27 tons of gold with an average grade of 3.6 g/t. Geological evidence, including crosscutting relationships and mineral paragenesis, indicates that the deposit records two temporally distinct stages of gold mineralization: an early stage and a late stage. This study integrates mineralogical, in situ trace-element, and sulfur-isotope analyses to constrain the fluid provenance and precipitation mechanisms associated with these two mineralization stages. The early stage resulted in disseminated-style (V1 and V2) mineralization within altered intermediate intrusive rocks and mica schist. This mineralization features subhedral pyrite (Py1) containing inclusions of pyrrhotite (Po1) and chalcopyrite. Conversely, the late stage produced auriferous quartz veins (V3) composed of colloform-porous pyrite (Py2–Py5), pyrrhotite (Po2), chalcopyrite, and native gold. Geochemically, these two stages are distinguished by their diagnostic elemental and isotopic signatures. Sulfides formed during the early stage exhibit highly variable Co/Ni ratios and a broad δ34S range (−5.47 to +5.50‰), suggesting a hybrid sulfur source resulting from fluid–rock interaction between mantle-derived fluids and crustal reservoirs. During this stage, gold predominantly exists as lattice-bound Au+ within Py1, whereas Po1 hosts Au predominantly as nanoscale inclusions (Au⁰). In contrast, sulfides formed during the late stage display consistently low Co/Ni ratios and a higher, narrowly constrained δ34S range (+6.16 to +7.63‰), indicating a dominant metasomatized mantle sulfur source. During this stage, gold is predominantly as lattice-bound Au+ in Py2, Py3, Py5, and Po2, with Au nanoscale inclusions concentrated in Py4. These geochemical disparities indicate fundamentally distinct precipitation mechanisms. Early-stage mineralization was primarily governed by fluid cooling and wall–rock reactions, as evidenced by the enrichment of Cu, As, Sb, Bi, and Te in Py1 and the exsolution of trace element-rich Po1. By contrast, late-stage mineralization was driven by fluid phase separation, which caused a marked increase in pH, promoted coupled Au–As precipitation within colloform pyrite, and ultimately induced desulfidation, leading to the formation of trace element-depleted Po2

summary_bullets.research_question: 查干花子金矿床两个矿化阶段的流体来源与金沉淀机制有何差异？
summary_bullets.methodology: 结合矿物学、原位微量元素和硫同位素分析技术约束成矿过程。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 早期金以晶格金和纳米包裹体赋存，硫源混合；晚期金以晶格金为主，硫源为交代地幔，沉淀受流体相分离控制。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次揭示该矿床两阶段金赋存状态、硫源和沉淀机制的精细差异。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为华北克拉通北缘金矿多阶段成矿机制与找矿勘查提供新约束。

works.title: Convection injects labile particulate organic carbon to the deep ocean
works.abstract: Vertical fluxes of particulate organic carbon (POC) are central to the oceanic carbon cycle, yet the role and interannual variability of convective POC transport remain poorly constrained. Autonomous profilers drifting in the Labrador and Irminger Seas detected recurrent winter-spring chlorophyll a fluorescence peaks at 1000 meters during intense convection in 2014–2017. The bio-optical properties of the particles indicate deep mixing of surface POC rich in labile phytoplanktonic material, distinct from both background suspended particles and sinking aggregates. Model simulations show that the mixing-driven POC supply to the deep ocean (500 to 2000 meters) scales with convection volume ( R 2 ≈ 0.88) and is typically dominated by planktonic biomass. According to the model, vertical mixing regionally contributes ∼33 to 44% of the combined POC supply from mixing and sinking to the 500 to 2000–meter layer during strong convection years. These convective injection episodes likely reshape deep-ocean carbon budgets by enhancing metabolism and driving lateral exports, linking upper-ocean dynamics to deep-ocean water masses and ecosystems.

works.translated_title: 对流将活性颗粒有机碳注入深海

summary_bullets.research_question: 量化对流驱动的活性颗粒有机碳向深海输送的年际变化及其对深海碳预算的贡献。
summary_bullets.methodology: 利用自主剖面仪观测叶绿素荧光并结合模型模拟，量化混合与沉降的共同作用。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 强对流年混合主导的POC供应占500-2000米层总输入的33-44%，且主要为活性浮游生物物质。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次揭示对流注入的POC以活性颗粒为主，并重构对深海碳代谢和侧向输出的影响。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 将上层海洋动力与深海碳循环、生态系统响应直接关联，为预测气候变化影响提供机制性约束。

works.title: Limited direct links between slip variability and incoming plate structure at the Guerrero gap offshore Mexico
works.abstract: At subduction zones, the occurrence of slow slip events and tremor is often attributed primarily to fluids released from the subducting plate. Yet, sufficiently high-resolution constraints on along-strike variations in the extent and nature of incoming plate hydration required to assess the role of fluids are lacking. Using a high-resolution P-wave velocity model, we estimate the water contents of the young incoming Cocos plate before it subducts beneath the Guerrero Gap and adjacent segments, which exhibit variations in slip behavior. Seaward of the Guerrero Gap, large seamounts contain 1.5-3 times more water, suggesting a possible link between seamount subduction and the aseismic character of the gap. However, widespread upper-crustal hydration and subducting seamounts outside the gap where large earthquakes regularly occur suggest incoming plate hydration alone cannot account for megathrust slip variability offshore Mexico. Subduction of large hydrated seamounts alone is unlikely to be the primary driver of along-strike variations in megathrust slip behavior offshore Mexico, according to a high-resolution P-wave velocity model of the Guerrero Gap

works.translated_title: 墨西哥近海格雷罗缺震空段处滑动变异性与传入板块结构之间的有限直接联系

summary_bullets.research_question: 输入板块水化能否解释墨西哥Guerrero Gap俯冲带滑动行为的沿走向差异？
summary_bullets.methodology: 利用高分辨率P波速度模型估算科科斯板块俯冲前的水含量。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 海山含水更高，但水化普遍存在，单一水化无法解释滑动差异。
summary_bullets.innovation: 提供板块水化与滑移变化直接关联的高分辨率定量评估。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 揭示流体作用并非慢滑移唯一控制因素，为震源行为研究提供新约束。

works.title: Geology and magmatic-hydrothermal evolution of the miocene Beimulang porphyry Cu deposit, Tibet
works.abstract: The newly discovered Beimulang porphyry Cu deposit (1.29 Mt at 0.38 % Cu) is located in the western segment of the Gangdese belt, southern Tibet. The deposit is associated with a composite intrusive complex consisting of five Miocene intrusions, including syn-mineralization monzogranite porphyry, monzogranite, and diorite porphyry, and late-mineralization lamprophyre and granite porphyry. These intrusions intruded Eocene volcanic and intrusive rocks of the Pana Formation. Zircon U-Pb dating indicates that magmatic activity occurred between 14.8 ± 0.1 and 11.0 ± 0.1 Ma. Hydrothermal alteration at Beimulang includes potassic, propylitic, and phyllic assemblages. Potassic alteration, comprising early K-feldspar and later biotite alteration, mainly affected syn-mineralization intrusions, whereas phyllic alteration extensively overprinted earlier assemblages at shallow levels. Copper mineralization is closely associated with biotite alteration and early- to middle-stage phyllic alteration. Molybdenite Re-Os dating constrains the main mineralization to 14.1 ± 0.2–13.5 ± 0.2 Ma. Late-mineralization intrusions also record K-feldspar alteration, phyllic alteration, and minor sulfide mineralization, indicating a second magmatic-hydrothermal event at 12.3 ± 0.1–11.0 ± 0.1 Ma. However, this late event failed to generate economic Cu mineralization. Although the magmatic-hydrothermal evolution at Beimulang spanned ∼ 3.8 m.y., the majority of Cu was introduced during the early event at ∼ 14 Ma. This study demonstrates that, although multiple magmatic-hydrothermal events are commonly considered important for porphyry Cu formation, a single productive event can provide sufficient metal endowment to form a large porphyry Cu deposit.

works.translated_title: 西藏中新世北木朗斑岩铜矿床的地质特征与岩浆-热液演化

summary_bullets.research_question: 探讨西藏贝母朗斑岩铜矿多期岩浆-热液事件中哪一阶段主导铜成矿及其经济意义。
summary_bullets.methodology: 采用锆石U-Pb定年、辉钼矿Re-Os定年、蚀变矿物组合及侵入体穿插关系分析。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 主要铜矿化集中于~14 Ma的早期事件，晚期岩浆-热液活动未形成经济矿化。
summary_bullets.innovation: 证明单次成矿事件足以形成大型斑岩铜矿，挑战多期复合成矿的传统认识。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为斑岩成矿系统评价与勘探方向提供关键时限约束，强调早期主成矿期的决定性作用。

works.title: An experimental study on the possible stability of whewellite CaC2O4·H2O under subduction zone conditions
works.abstract: Abstract Whewellite was reported as mineral in fluid inclusions in high-pressure metamorphic rocks, lending support to theoretical predictions that organic species may be stable and abundant in high-pressure subduction zone fluids. In this study, we have experimentally studied the stability of whewellite at typical subduction zone pressure and temperature conditions, both by in-situ observations using an externally-heated diamond cell and by piston-cylinder experiments with long run durations. Heating whewellite in a diamond cell to 250 °C and 1.5 GPa for a few hours and subsequent cooling essentially just caused re-crystallization. However, upon heating to higher temperatures already within a few hours, decomposition to graphite, aragonite, and CO2 is obvious. Moreover, piston cylinder experiments with run durations of 7 to 26 days and conditions ranging from 300°C at 2 GPa to 700 °C at 4.5 GPa all show complete decomposition of whewellite to graphite and aragonite according to 2 CaC2O4·H2O = 2 CaCO3 + C + CO2 + 2 H2O. Overall, our results suggest that whewellite in fluid inclusions from high-pressure metamorphic rocks is likely a secondary phase formed upon exhumation at rather low temperatures. The observation of whewellite as such does not provide any evidence for the stability of organic species in high-pressure subduction zone fluids. However, combined with the data from natural fluid inclusions, our data suggest that the abiotic synthesis of carboxylic acids and their salts is feasible at rather low temperature and pressures in near-surface environments of Earth’s crust and possibly, also on other planets.
works.label: consider
works.translated_title: 水草酸钙石（CaC2O4·H2O）在俯冲带条件下可能稳定性的实验研究

summary_bullets.research_question: 草酸钙石（whewellite）在俯冲带高压条件下是否稳定存在？
summary_bullets.methodology: 使用外加热金刚石压腔进行原位观察，并结合长时间活塞圆筒实验模拟俯冲带温压条件。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 草酸钙石在俯冲带温压下均完全分解为石墨、文石和CO₂，并非稳定相。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次通过长时间实验证实草酸钙石在俯冲带条件下的不稳定性，否定其作为高压流体中有机物稳定存在的证据。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为解释俯冲带流体中有机物稳定性提供关键实验约束，并提示草酸钙石可能指示近地表非生物有机合成。

works.title: Magmatic controls on the genesis of the Jinchuan NiCu sulfide deposit: Evidence from major-trace element compositions and SrNd isotopes of apatite
works.abstract: The economically large Jinchuan NiCu sulfide deposit of Northwest China consists of distinct eastern and western intrusions, whose primary magmatic signatures have been heavily erased by pervasive hydrothermal overprint. Although alteration-resistant apatite effectively incorporates trace elements and serves as a reliable petrogenetic-metallogenic tracer, systematic apatite geochemical contrasts recording divergent magmatic-mineralization evolution between the two intrusions remain poorly constrained. We integrate major and trace element compositions and SrNd isotopes of apatite from major lithologic layers in the eastern and western intrusions to constrain magma evolution and ore-forming processes. Mineralogical observations reveal marked differences in grain morphology, paragenesis, and textural occurrence of apatite in disseminated, patchy, and net-textured sulfides from these two intrusions (abbreviated as E-DS, E-PTS, E-NTS, W-DS, and W-NTS Ap). The eastern intrusion contains magmatic fluorapatites (E-DS and E-PTS Ap) and chlorapatite (E-NTS Ap), whereas the western intrusion exclusively hosts chlorapatite (W-DS and W-NTS Ap), almost all apatite exhibiting LREE enrichment and HREE depletion. Apatite SrNd isotope modelling indicates contamination of <20% of deep crust and <10% of marble country rocks, yet the western intrusion underwent intense localized marble assimilation. Elevated Th and Zr abundances and Pb/Ce ratios in apatite from the eastern intrusion suggest a more pronounced deep crustal assimilation. Apatite Mn and V contents, coupled with Eu/Eu* and Ce/Ce* ratios as well as S+6 substitution mechanisms, demonstrate a systematic decrease in magmatic fO2 from NTS to DS and PTS ores, with the eastern intrusion showing higher fO2 than the western intrusion. Stronger deep crustal assimilation and elevated magmatic fO2 in the eastern intrusion correlate with larger metal endowments, indicating that deep sulfur-bearing crustal contamination and sulfide melt segregation dominate ore formation. The Sr/Y, La/Yb, and Eu/Gd ratios of apatite reveal plagioclase-dominated crystallization in the eastern intrusion versus clinopyroxene–amphibole fractionation in the western intrusion, with their distinct evolutionary paths governed by crystallization depth. Modelling of F-Cl-OH compositions suggests higher initial volatile contents in the western magma compared to the eastern magma. The magmatic H2O contents of ~2.5 wt% significantly enhanced the magma's maximum carrying capacity of sulfide melts to ~10 vol%, facilitating sulfide accumulation and enrichment. The primitive magma Cl/F ratios exceeding 10 suggest that the Jinchuan deep mantle source was metasomatized by Cl-rich slab fluids. We propose that the formation of the Jinchuan primary magma resulted from the interactive melting and hybridization of a hot mantle plume and metasomatized lithospheric mantle. This work highlights the utility of integrated apatite geochemical proxies in tracking magmatic evolution and ore-forming processes in the Jinchuan deposit, with broader implications for the study of global magmatic NiCu sulfide deposits.

works.translated_title: 岩浆对金川镍铜硫化物矿床成因的控制：来自磷灰石主微量元素组成及Sr-Nd同位素的证据

summary_bullets.research_question: 金川矿床东、西岩体在热液蚀变后如何通过磷灰石地球化学差异揭示不同的岩浆演化和成矿过程？
summary_bullets.methodology: 对比东、西岩体不同矿石类型中磷灰石的主微量元素及Sr-Nd同位素，并结合矿物学观察与成分模拟。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 东岩体经历更强深部地壳混染与更高氧逸度，西岩体受大理岩局部同化，挥发分差异控制了硫化物熔离与富集。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次利用磷灰石多重地球化学指标系统约束金川两岩体岩浆-成矿路径的分异机制。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为全球岩浆铜镍硫化物矿床的成矿示踪与勘查提供可靠的磷灰石地球化学新方法。

works.title: H2O-poor minerals in equilibrium with volatile-bearing fluids: Insights from diamond-hosted mineral inclusions
works.abstract: We investigated the H2O content of 21 garnet and clinopyroxene inclusions extracted from Canadian diamonds using Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy. Garnets have H2O contents below the FTIR detection limit, while clinopyroxene inclusions have H2O contents ranging from below the detection limit to 289 wt.ppm. These H2O contents are lower than in the same minerals found in xenoliths from the same localities, supporting the idea that the activity of H2O may be low during diamond formation, as previously suggested for samples from other localities (e.g., the Kalahari and Siberian cratons). Considering these findings, both the speciation of COH fluid in the lithosphere and the incorporation of H in nominally anhydrous minerals were thermodynamically modelled along cratonic mantle geotherms to investigate the composition of diamond-forming fluids. The COH speciation model shows that, contrary to what has been previously suggested, diamonds are unlikely to form from a fluid at, or close to, the water maximum, as such conditions require oxygen fugacities higher than those expected in the lithospheric diamond stability field (log fO2 (ΔIW) from +2 to 0 at ∼8 GPa). The H incorporation modelling shows that to produce inclusions with the H2O content detected here and elsewhere (dry to hundreds of ppm wt), fluids with low H2O activity are required. The different H incorporation mechanisms relevant for each mineral will lead to variable H2O contents, explaining the range observed here. These results indicate that lithospheric monocrystalline diamonds may form mainly from carbonatitic or hydrous-carbonated silicate melts rather than aqueous fluids.
works.label: consider
works.translated_title: 与含挥发性流体平衡的贫水矿物：金刚石中矿物包裹体的启示

summary_bullets.research_question: 金刚石形成于何种流体环境，是富水溶液还是贫水熔体？
summary_bullets.methodology: 使用傅里叶变换红外光谱测量钻石中石榴石和单斜辉石包裹体的水含量，并结合热力学模拟。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 包裹体水含量极低，模拟表明钻石难以从水最大附近的流体中形成，需低水活度流体。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次结合天然低水含量包裹体数据与COH流体及H incorporation热力学模拟，揭示钻石形成流体性质。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为岩石圈钻石形成机制提供关键约束，指出含碳硅酸盐熔体而非纯水流体是主要生长介质。

works.title: Comparison of geological records from different areas of the Archean basement in the North China Craton: Implications for its formation and evolution
works.abstract: The early continental crust underwent different stages of formation and evolution, including the development of ancient nuclei, microcontinents, and cratons, with tectonic regimes also changing over time. Similarities and differences in the geological records of the Archean basements in different areas offer insights into the formation and evolution of the early continental crust and their corresponding tectonic settings. The North China Craton, the largest craton in China, preserves >4.0 Ga geological records. In the craton, four, four, nine and three areas contain the oldest rock records of 3.8–3.1 Ga, 3.0–2.8 Ga, 2.75–2.6 Ga and 2.55–2.5 Ga, respectively. In many areas, the continental crust exhibits evolutionary inheritance. 2.75–2.6 Ga rocks occur in approximately 20 areas, whereas 2.55–2.5 Ga rocks are almost distributed in nearly all areas of the Archean basement. Comparison of geological records across different areas indicates that many areas evolved independently before the Mesoarchean. Some microcontinents (ancient terranes) had already formed by the end of the early Neoarchean (2.75–2.6 Ga), while the North China Craton became a unified entity in the late Neoarchean (2.55–2.5 Ga). Consequently, the formation and evolution history of the North China Craton can be divided into three stages: Pre-3.0 Ga ancient nucleus formation, 3.0–2.6 Ga microcontinent formation, and 2.6–2.5 Ga cratonization. Over time, the tectonic regime evolved from underplating (or mantle plume) to plate tectonics.
works.label: consider
works.translated_title: 华北克拉通太古宙基底不同区域地质记录的对比：对其形成与演化的启示

summary_bullets.research_question: 华北克拉通不同地区太古宙基底地质记录的异同如何揭示早期陆壳形成演化及构造体制转变？
summary_bullets.methodology: 通过对比华北克拉通不同区域太古宙最古老岩石记录的时空分布与继承性演化特征。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 华北克拉通经历了古陆核形成、微陆块拼合到克拉通化的三阶段演化，构造体制由底侵或地幔柱转向板块构造。
summary_bullets.innovation: 系统构建了从古老陆核到微陆块直至克拉通化的多阶段演化模型，并限定了构造体制转换时间。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为早期陆壳增生与构造机制转变提供了关键实例，对理解全球太古宙克拉通形成具有重要启示。

works.title: Petrogenesis of Early Cretaceous intrusions and enclaves from the Lushan area, South China Block: Insights into magmatism and their geodynamic processes
works.abstract: Early Cretaceous intermediate-acidic intrusions in the South China Block contain abundant granodioritic enclaves. Integrated zircon U-Pb geochronology, Lu-Hf isotopes, and whole-rock geochemistry reveal that the Lushan granodioritic enclaves and their porphyritic biotite monzogranite hosts share similar crystallization ages and crustal origins. Elevated initial Sr isotope ratios (0.709336∼0.710143, 0.709895∼0.710394), depleted ε Nd(t) (-8.0∼-6.7, -7.8∼-5.7) and negative ε Hf(t) values (-8.8∼-0.9, -9.9∼-2.5), low Th/Nb (0.89∼1.54, 1.15∼1.79) and Nb/U (6.26∼10.39, 4.33∼5.96) ratios, and young two-stage Nd–Hf model ages (1.39–1.58 Ga; 1.21–1.77 Ga) in both the granodioritic enclaves and porphyritic biotite monzogranite mirror the Yangtze Block upper crust, identifying it as the dominant source. The emplacement of the Haihui intrusion is interpreted as resulting from lithospheric extension triggered by Paleo-Pacific slab rollback during the Early Cretaceous. This thermal pulse induced extensive partial melting of the Yangtze upper crust, followed by crystallization, differentiation, and hybridization of cognate magmas in shallow crustal reservoirs. Consequently, the Haihui intrusion exhibits isotopic signatures characteristic of crustal melting. These findings constrain the origin and hybridization history of enclave-host systems in the northern Jiangnan Orogenic Belt, highlighting the role of slab rollback-driven extension in generating Early Cretaceous crustally derived magmatism in the South China Block.

works.translated_title: 华南地块庐山地区早白垩世侵入岩及包体的岩石成因：对岩浆作用及其地球动力学过程的启示

summary_bullets.research_question: 揭示华南地块庐山地区早白垩世侵入岩与包体的岩石成因及地球动力学过程。
summary_bullets.methodology: 采用锆石U-Pb定年、Lu-Hf同位素及全岩地球化学综合约束。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 寄主岩与包体同源，源于扬子上地壳部分熔融，受古太平洋板片后撤伸展触发。
summary_bullets.innovation: 阐明同源岩浆混合与分异历史，揭示板片后撤驱动壳源岩浆的新机制。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为华南早白垩世伸展相关壳源岩浆作用和构造演化提供关键见解。

works.title: Post-diagenetic hydrothermal events control Co enrichment in sediment-hosted Cu-Co deposits: Evidence from the Shizishan Cu-Co deposit, southwestern China
works.abstract: The role of post-diagenetic hydrothermal processes in cobalt (Co) enrichment in sediment-hosted stratiform Cu-Co (SSC) deposits remains controversial, particularly regarding whether high-grade Co mineralization is primarily diagenetic or requires later tectonic overprinting. The Shizishan deposit, SW China, exhibits a well-defined vertical Co zoning and coexisting disseminated and veinlet sulfide assemblages, making it an ideal example to address this issue. Here we integrate in-situ sulfide trace element geochemistry, Fe–S isotopes, and rutile U–Pb dating to distinguish two mineralization events. Early disseminated chalcopyrite, cobaltite, and pyrite formed during diagenesis, with Co distribution controlled by organic matter in the host rocks. The later post-diagenetic stage formed veinlet chalcopyrite, bornite, cobaltite and cobaltian pyrite cross-cutting early-stage mineralization. Veinlet chalcopyrite shows systematic depletion of Co, Ni and As relative to disseminated chalcopyrite, while cobaltite and pyrite show opposite trends, indicating remobilization and recrystallization of pre-existing sulfides. Chalcopyrite from Co-rich layers exhibits lower δ 5⁶Fe values (−0.53‰ to −0.17‰) than Co-depleted layers (−0.31‰ to −0.02‰), suggesting more reduced fluids. Hydrothermal rutile associated with veinlet ores yields a U–Pb lower intercept age of 1449 ± 33 Ma, defining a post-diagenetic tectonic-hydrothermal event. This overprinting event significantly upgraded Co grades, particularly in dolostone enriched in organic matter. Our results demonstrate that while the diagenetic stage provided primary metals and traps, it is the later orogenic-related hydrothermal modification that was essential for the formation of economic Co concentrations, and a reduced setting is a key factor controlling Co precipitation.

works.translated_title: 成岩后热液事件控制沉积岩容矿铜钴矿床中的钴富集：来自中国西南部狮子山铜钴矿床的证据

summary_bullets.research_question: 后成岩热液过程是否以及如何控制沉积岩容矿层状铜钴矿床中的钴富集？
summary_bullets.methodology: 采用原位硫化物微量元素地球化学、Fe–S同位素和热液金红石U–Pb定年综合分析。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 早期成矿为成岩期硫化物提供初始钴，后期造山热液活动在有机质丰富白云岩中显著提升钴品位。
summary_bullets.innovation: 通过硫化物及金红石多手段联用，首次厘定出矿床存在约1449 Ma的构造-热液叠加成钴事件。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 该研究强调后生成造山热液改造对经济性钴矿形成的关键作用，为同类型矿床找矿提供了新思路。

works.title: Evidence for heavy iron isotopic enrichment at Earth’s core-mantle boundary
works.abstract: Ultralow-velocity zone candidate materials may preferentially incorporate heavy iron isotopes because of their strong Fe-O bonds, and mantle plumes can transport these dense, isotopically heavy materials from the core-mantle boundary to the upper mantle, according to high-pressure experiments and geodynamic simulations. Ocean island basalts exhibit heavier and more variable iron isotopic compositions (δ^56Fe) than mid-ocean ridge basalts, but the origin of these signatures remains unresolved. Here we investigate whether Fe-rich ultralow-velocity zones at the core-mantle boundary can provide a deep-mantle source of heavy Fe isotopes. High-pressure nuclear resonant inelastic X-ray scattering and first-principles calculations show that two candidate phases therein, ferropericlase and pyrite-type FeO_2H_ x ( x ≤ 1), have stiffer Fe-O bonding than metallic Fe alloys and Fe-bearing bridgmanite, favoring heavy Fe isotope enrichment. Mass-balance modelling indicates δ^56Fe enrichments of + 0.07 to + 0.17‰ at 2500–3500 K and 135 GPa in such domains, depending on mineralogy and local equilibration. Geodynamic simulations further support the entrainment of dense ultralow-velocity-zones materials into rising mantle plumes. These results identify Fe-rich ultralow-velocity zones as potential high-δ^56Fe reservoirs and plausible deep-mantle endmember contributing to the iron isotope heterogeneity observed in ocean island basalts.
works.label: flagship
works.translated_title: 地球核幔边界处重铁同位素富集的证据

summary_bullets.research_question: 洋岛玄武岩重铁同位素特征是否源于核幔边界超低速带物质的贡献？
summary_bullets.methodology: 结合高压核共振非弹性X射线散射、第一性原理计算与地球动力学模拟。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 超低速带候选矿物具有更强Fe-O键，可富集重铁同位素并被地幔柱夹带上升。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次揭示核幔边界超低速带作为重铁同位素深部储库的机制。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为地幔地球化学异常提供深部物源解释，链接深部过程与地表玄武岩组成。

works.title: Caledonian intracontinental metallogeny in South China
works.abstract: Previous geodynamic theories have mainly focused on plate margins, and little is known about how tectonic evolution affects intracontinental processes. The nature of the Caledonian Orogenic Belt in South China is still controversial, but its intracontinental orogenic characteristics are relatively obvious. It was previously believed that mineralization was weak during the Caledonian period in South China. With in-depth geological research and exploration, a large number of Caledonian ore deposits have been successively discovered in South China in recent years. Integrating previous research results, this paper clarifies and determines that the Caledonian ore deposits in south China could be divided into four types, namely Cu polymetallic deposits related to granites that originated partially from the Neoproterozoic juvenile lower crust, W-Sn polymetallic deposits related to granites derived from the remelting of the Paleoproterozoic metamorphic basement, orogenic Au deposits, and MVT Pb-Zn deposits; these four types of ore deposits have consistent metallogenic ages, concentrated in 440–395 Ma, which is consistent with the peak ages of the Caledonian granites and the regional metamorphism of the pre-Devonian strata in South China. They are a unified whole with close genetic connections, and constitute the South China Caledonian intracontinental metallogenic system controlled by far-field stress. It is worth noting that the NE-trending Jiangshao-Chenzhou-Linwu Fault divides the South China Caledonian Orogenic Belt into two parts, with most known Caledonian ore deposits distributed in the western part of this fault. The metallogenic differences between the eastern and western sides of the fault or the metallogenic potential of the eastern region still need in-depth research.
works.label: consider
works.translated_title: 华南加里东期陆内成矿作用

summary_bullets.research_question: 华南加里东期是否形成统一的内成矿系统及其构造控制机制。
summary_bullets.methodology: 综合前人研究成果，划分矿床类型并对比成矿、花岗岩与变质年龄。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 划分出四类矿床，成矿年龄集中在440–395 Ma，构成受远场应力控制的陆内成矿系统。
summary_bullets.innovation: 提出华南加里东陆内成矿系统概念，揭示不同类型矿床间的成因联系。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为理解板内造山与成矿耦合关系提供新框架，指导区域矿产勘查布局。

works.title: Limited remineralization of Arctic permafrost-derived organic carbon in nearshore marine sediments
works.abstract: Abstract Rapid Arctic warming causes thawing and erosion of coastal permafrost, releasing organic carbon into the Arctic Ocean. Although much of this organic carbon is deposited in marine sediments, the extent to which it is remineralized and re-enters the active carbon cycle remains uncertain. Here we examine the fate of permafrost-derived organic carbon in the nearshore sediments of Qikiqtaruk, Canada. Analysis of dual carbon isotopes revealed that nearshore sedimentary organic carbon originated predominantly from eroded ancient permafrost deposits, but the remineralization end-product, dissolved inorganic carbon, diffusing back out of the sediment was younger and predominantly of marine origin. works.translated_title: 北极多年冻土来源有机碳在近岸海洋沉积物中的有限再矿化作用

summary_bullets.research_question: 北极近岸沉积物中的冻土源有机碳被再矿化并重新进入活跃碳循环的程度仍不确定。
summary_bullets.methodology: 通过双碳同位素分析沉积物有机碳和扩散出的溶解无机碳的来源和年龄。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 沉积有机碳主要来自古老冻土，但扩散出的溶解无机碳却是年轻海源，表明冻土碳再矿化有限。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次用双碳同位素直接示踪近岸沉积物中冻土有机碳的矿化，证实其矿化比例极低。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为准确评估近岸沉积物对冻土碳的长期封存能力和气候反馈强度提供关键观测约束。

works.title: Linking Magmatism and Gold Mineralization at the Fenelon Gold Deposit, Northern Abitibi, Canada: Insights from Pyrite Chemistry, U-Pb and Re-Os Geochronology
works.abstract: Abstract The Fenelon gold deposit, located in the underexplored northern region of the Abitibi greenstone belt, hosts an estimated 4.09 Moz at 3.20 g/t Au and is spatially associated with the 2697 ± 0.96 Ma Jeremie diorite (isotope dilution-thermal ionization mass spectrometry [ID-TIMS] U-Pb zircon). Gold mineralization at Fenelon consists of two styles: shear hosted and vein hosted. The Tabasco-Cayenne zones typically occur as an anastomosing shear system, whereas the Area 51 zone contains parallel sheeted veins that range from sulfide-poor quartz veins to sulfide-rich, base metal-bearing veins. Ore petrography and pyrite geochemistry reveal three distinct pyrite generations, each reflecting evolving fluid conditions. Pyrite 1 (Py1) and pyrite 3 (Py3) are relatively enriched in Co and Ni but depleted in Cu, Zn, and Au, whereas pyrite 2 (Py2) exhibits zoning and elevated base and precious metal concentrations, which are more characteristic of intrusion-related, magmatic-hydrothermal deposits than classic orogenic gold systems. Rhenium-osmium dating of molybdenite from a gold-bearing vein crosscutting the Jeremie diorite yielded an age of 2710 ± 11 Ma, indicating that gold mineralization coincided with the prolonged emplacement of the Jeremie Suite between 2710 and 2697 Ma. We propose that mineralization was driven by magmatic-hydrothermal fluids derived from the Jeremie diorite, which contributed to gold endowment. This study highlights the role of pyrite chemistry in discriminating fluid sources and supports an intrusion-related model for gold mineralization at Fenelon.

summary_bullets.research_question: Fenelon金矿的成矿作用是与造山型还是与侵入体相关的岩浆热液系统有关？

works.title: Tracing Continental Basalt Sources and Mantle Processes Using Fe Stable Isotopes
works.abstract: Abstract Iron (Fe) isotopes have emerged as powerful tracers of mantle source heterogeneity and melting processes, yet the mechanisms producing heavy Fe isotope signatures (high δ 57 Fe values) in intraplate basalts remain debated. Competing interpretations include partial melting of recycled pyroxenite domains versus carbonate‐induced oxidation of a mantle source. Here we present new high precision Fe isotope data together with whole rock elemental and Sr‐Nd‐Pb‐Hf isotopic compositions of Cenozoic Chifeng basalts from eastern China to test the above hypotheses. Fractionation corrected bulk‐rock δ 57 Fe values of Chifeng basalts vary from +0.08‰ to +0.30‰, which cannot be readily explained by either magmatic processes or mantle oxidation. Systematic covariations of δ 57 Fe with SiO 2 , trace element ratios (Nb/Zr, Ce/Pb, and Gd/Yb), and radiogenic isotopes ( 143 Nd/ 144 Nd and 206 Pb/ 204 Pb) demonstrate that Fe isotope variations are closely linked to source heterogeneities. Quantitative modeling reveals a positive correlation between pyroxenite‐melt fraction and δ 57 Fe value, indicating that variations in pyroxenitic input likely control the Fe isotopic compositions of Chifeng basalts. In fact, the Indian‐type Pb isotope signatures together with the heavy δ 57 Fe values of Chifeng basalts are best accounted for by recycled Pacific oceanic crust that was hybridized with subducted sediments and subsequently incorporated into the asthenosphere beneath eastern China. The integrated Fe–Nd–Pb isotope data further support melt–melt mixing between pyroxenite‐derived and peridotite‐derived melts within the lithospheric mantle. Therefore, the Fe isotope signatures of Chifeng basalts record source lithological heterogeneity linked to recycled pyroxenites and demonstrate the utility of Fe isotopes in resolving mantle processes.

works.title: A prolonged hydrothermal past at Santorini Caldera revealed by sedimentary trace metal and microbial signatures
works.abstract: Abstract Hydrothermal systems in volcanic calderas are critical in signalling volcanic unrest, forming ore deposits, and sustaining chemosynthetic microorganisms. Analysis of a ~3500-year sequence of sediments collected from the Santorini caldera, Greece, during International Ocean Discovery Program (IODP) Expedition 398 reveals the behaviour of a prolonged paleo-hydrothermal system. Sediment geochemical and metagenomic data record vigorous hydrothermal activity and metal fluxes for ~1100 years, within a 2270-year window between two major eruptions. Sediment hydrothermally-derived trace metals are significantly enriched over background (~200-fold for As and Hg, and 10–50-fold for Mn, Sb, Mo, and V), with long-term metal fluxes (9 t yr −1 As, 2.5 t yr −1 Cu, 7 kg yr −1 Ag) comparable to fluxes from present-day geothermal fields in the Taupo Volcanic Zone. Metagenomic analysis identifies elevated metal resistance genes—signals of microbial adaptation to heightened hydrothermal stressors. Here we integrate geological and genomic evidence to decipher the paleoenvironmental and biogeochemical history of the past hydrothermal system at Santorini caldera.

works.title: Calcium isotopes link ocean acidification to Aptian–Albian foraminiferal extinctions
works.abstract: The second-largest extinction event in the evolutionary history of planktic foraminifera occurred at the Aptian–Albian boundary. This extinction may reflect ocean acidification (OA) associated with Oceanic Anoxic Event 1b. As calcium isotope ratios (δ 44/40 Ca) can track how biocalcification rates respond to OA, we measured δ 44/40 Ca records for planktic and benthic foraminifera, bulk carbonates, and authigenic calcite across the Aptian–Albian boundary in the South Atlantic. Benthic and bulk δ 44/40 Ca data display a distinct sequence of negative and positive excursions, similar to δ 44/40 Ca variations across other OA events. Planktic δ 44/40 Ca values increase markedly, tracking a reduction in calcification rates coincident with decreases in the size, diversity, and shell thickness of planktic foraminifera. These results suggest that OA drove extinctions of planktic foraminifera at the Aptian–Albian boundary.

works.title: Microbial carbon fixation in a partially submerged caldera driven by the effect of CO₂ degassing
works.abstract: Volcanic CO₂ emissions shape fluid pathways, drive seawater acidification, and sustain microbial carbon fixation near seafloor hydrothermal vents, according to a high-resolution map of CO₂ degassing across the onshore and offshore sectors of Campi Flegrei caldera. Primary Handling Editors: Alireza Bahadori. Calderas are subsided volcanic terrains formed by the destructive power of some of the largest volcanic eruptions on Earth. Globally, many such depressions are today covered by crater lakes, or seawater, rendering them less accessible to scientific scrutiny and hence more complicated to monitor during unrest. One such system is the restless, partly submerged, Campi Flegrei caldera near Naples, Italy, where escalating hydrothermal activity during ongoing unrest demands an improved understanding of the caldera offshore. Here, we present a high-resolution, system-wide mapping of CO_2 degassing encompassing the offshore and onshore sectors of the caldera. Combining vertical seawater profiles with groundwater composition results, we obtain a refined delimitation of the anomalous CO_2 degassing zones, showing overall structural control on volatile transport and surface/seafloor discharge. Intense CO_2 degassing on the seafloor also causes ocean acidification, sustains diverse chemolithotrophic communities near the hydrothermal emissions, and influences the near-vent environment as demonstrated by taxonomic and functional diversity data. Submerged calderas are extremely dynamic environments whose volcanological significance and biogeochemistry processes deserve further investigation.

works.title: Extreme exhumation along a volcanic arc exposed the world’s youngest pluton in the Japanese Alps
works.abstract: Geothermobarometry and zircon U–Pb geochronology reveal an episode of extreme exhumation in the Kurobe area of central Japan, characterized by the exposure of the world’s youngest known granite, the middle Pleistocene Kurobegawa Granite. Our results indicate rapid exhumation rates of ∼7.5–10.2 mm/yr since ∼0.8 Ma. These exceptionally high rates, among the highest reported globally over orogenic timescales, demonstrate that extremely rapid crustal unroofing, long studied in continental collision zones, is not restricted to those settings and can also occur in subduction-zone volcanic arcs. Three-dimensional tectonic modeling suggests that this localized exhumation reflects focused deformation within high geothermal-gradient zones along the volcanic arc, combined with late Quaternary horizontal shortening. We infer that thermal structure associated with arc magmatism plays a critical role in enhancing exhumation efficiency. These observations highlight that, in subduction-zone orogens, processes linked to magmatism and slab-derived fluids—important components of subduction-zone tectonics—may significantly contribute to long-term mountain building, complementing more traditional mechanisms of mechanical deformation such as faulting and folding, which have been primarily established in studies of continental collision zones.

works.title: Magmatic fluids triggering gold mineralization in the Wuchuan-Sihui ductile shear zone, South China
works.abstract: The genesis of ductile shear zones-hosted gold deposits remains controversial due to multi-stage mineralization and diverse ore sources. The Dagougu gold deposit in the Wuchuan-Sihui fault zone (South China) features three mineralization stages: (I) albite-quartz-pyrite (Py1), (II) calcite-dolomite-chlorite-pyrite (Py2), and (III) quartz-calcite-dolomite-chlorite-polysulfide (pyrite including Py3a and Py3b)-native gold (ore stage). Rutile U–Pb dating yields ages of 178.8 ± 1.3 Ma (MSWD = 1.2; Stage I) and 177.1 ± 1.7 Ma (MSWD = 1.3; Stage III), constraining mineralization to the South China gold mineralization gap period (190–170 Ma), related to Paleo-Pacific Plate subduction. The Au-As-Cu-Pb-Ag-rich and oscillatory zoning of Py3a reflect fluid boiling during hydraulic fracturing, as corroborated by low δ34S values (avg. −1.24 ‰), hydrothermal breccias, and fluid inclusions observations. Ore fluids continuously migrated to Dagougu along the F0 fault zone, with pioneering fluids evolving at Dagougu and subsequent fluids gathering in F0. Hydraulic fracturing-induced pressure drops drove subsequent fluids into Dagougu. These fluids underwent intense fluid-rock interactions within F0, which is supported by F0 albitization, high δ34S values (avg. 10.21 ‰), and low Co/Ni ratios of Py3b. Reported H–O isotopes confirm fracturing-facilitated meteoric water infiltration. The resulting fO2 increase and cooling triggered gold precipitation, as evidenced by high Te in Py3b, low Mn in sphalerite, and low temperatures (148–185 ℃). Pyrite sulfur isotopes, published C–H–O isotopes, mineralization ages, and galena, pyrite, and albitite Pb isotopes suggest magmatic fluids derived from deep-mantle magma controlled gold mineralization through interactions with the Lechangxia Group. This study highlights the importance of magmatic-hydrothermal events in forming ductile shear zones-hosted gold deposits.

works.title: Ca isotope fractionation during precipitation of authigenic carbonates: A case study from the Haima cold seep, northern South China Sea
works.abstract: Calcium isotopes serve as a sensitive tracer for carbonate formation processes, yet the mechanisms governing Ca isotopic fractionation during authigenic carbonate precipitation, particularly in dynamic cold-seep systems, remain debated. This study presents integrated elemental (Sr/Ca and Mg/Ca) and isotopic (C-O-Sr-Ca) data from two types of authigenic carbonates (chimney and shell-bearing) recovered from the two sites with high methane flux in the Haima cold seep, northern South China Sea (SCS). The chimney carbonates exhibit strongly negative δ13CV-PDB values of −33.3‰ to −30.1‰ and positive δ18OV-PDB values of 3.62–4.31‰, whereas the shell-bearing carbonates exhibit δ13CV-PDB values of −45.2‰ to −42.1‰ and δ18OV-PDB values of 3.85–4.34‰, confirming their methane seepage-related carbon and oxygen origin. Most of the samples show elevated Sr/Ca and depleted Mg/Ca mass ratios, consistent with a predominantly aragonitic composition, though a minor subset is calcite-dominated. It is indicated that Sr/Ca and Mg/Ca ratios are mostly controlled by the carbonate mineralogy rather than the precipitation rate. The 87Sr/86Sr ratios (0.709178–0.709278) of these authigenic carbonates closely match modern seawater signatures, indicating that authigenic carbonate formed within high methane flux shows significant potential for preserving the 87Sr/86Sr signature of ancient seawater. Calcium isotope compositions (δ44/40Ca) range from 0.73‰ to 1.37‰ and show strong correlations with Mg/Ca (positive) and Sr/Ca (negative) ratios, suggesting that carbonate mineralogy exerts a primary control on Ca isotopic fractionation. These findings highlight the pivotal role of carbonate mineralogy in governing the Sr and Mg concentrations and Ca isotopic signatures of authigenic carbonates in cold seeps.

works.title: Crustal thickening-driven late Archean adakitic alkaline magmatism: A marker of Archean-Proterozoic tectonic transition in the Eastern Dharwar Craton
works.abstract: Archean alkaline magmatism is volumetrically minor yet provides critical insights into early crust-mantle interactions and the evolution of the continental lithosphere. This study investigates the origin and geodynamic significance of Late Archean alkaline syenite from the Danduvaripalle area, Eastern Dharwar Craton (EDC), using integrated bulk-rock geochemistry, in situ titanite geochemistry, and U-Pb geochronology. Titanites exhibit low Al/Fe ratios and high rare earth element (REE) contents, indicating an igneous origin. These magmatic titanites yield a well-constrained Late Neoarchean crystallization age of ∼2520 Ma. Strongly fractionated REE patterns in titanites and in the bulk rock indicate persistent garnet control during melt generation. Bulk-rock geochemistry shows classic adakitic features, including high Sr/Y and La/Yb ratios, depleted Y and heavier REE, and strong negative Nb-Ta-Ti anomalies. However, very low MgO, Ni, Cr, and Co contents, together with high Th/U and K2O/Na2O ratios, rule out slab melting or interaction of slab-derived melt with the mantle. Age-corrected near-chondritic to slightly unradiogenic εNd values, overlapping to that observed in the basement rocks, further support a crustal rather than a mantle source. These characteristics together with geochemical and phase-equilibrium modelling point to partial melting of a thickened, compositionally heterogeneous mafic lower continental crust, with garnet, clinopyroxene, and amphibole as stable residual phases during melt generation. We interpret the ∼2520 Ma emplacement of the Danduvaripalle adakitic syenite as a late- to post-collisional event, following crustal thickening and collision between the Eastern and Western Dharwar Cratons. This Late Archean adakitic alkaline magmatism marks a critical tectonic transition from arc-dominated crustal growth to intracontinental reworking and stabilization during cratonization, making it a key marker of the Archean-Proterozoic boundary in the EDC. The Danduvaripalle syenite thus represents a rare Archean example of adakitic alkaline magmatism generated entirely within the continental crust. This finding has broader implications for understanding the thermal and compositional maturation of early continental lithosphere during this pivotal tectonic transition. In addition, the notable REE enrichment in these rocks opens new avenues for future prospecting to evaluate their economic potential for REE extraction.

works.title: The evolution of the Earth’s surface iron cycle
works.abstract: Formation and burial of pyrite (iron sulfide) in marine sediments exert a fundamental control on atmospheric oxygenation and seawater buffering over geological timescales. However, little is known about how the formation and delivery of its precursor, reactive iron (Fe) oxide minerals, have evolved throughout Earth history. Secular variability in reactive Fe (including Fe oxides and pyrite) preserved in marine sediments is commonly attributed solely to redox changes. Here, we develop an approach to distinguish redox-driven influences from other controls on sedimentary reactive Fe, including the intensity of continental silicate weathering and the transfer of terrigenous particles to the ocean. We apply this framework to a compilation of reactive Fe data spanning 1,200 My of Earth history. Our results reveal persistently low proportions of reactive Fe from the Mesoproterozoic through the Cambrian, followed by a pronounced mid- to late Paleozoic rise and a subsequent decline in the late Cenozoic. This temporal pattern is inconsistent with a purely redox-driven control. Comparison with independent proxies for continental weathering and land-ocean sediment and solute fluxes suggests a strong coupling between reactive Fe burial, oxidative silicate weathering, and tectonically driven erosion. Notably, the mid- to late Paleozoic rise in reactive Fe coincided with the proliferation of land plants and increasing atmospheric oxygen. We propose a positive feedback where Earth-surface Fe cycling was both amplified by atmospheric oxygenation and contributed to it through its influence on pyrite burial in marine sediments.

works.title: Constraining the Permeability and Outer‐Rise Hydration at the Central America Margin
works.abstract: Abstract Subduction zones are important drivers of Earth's geochemical evolution; the presence of water within the subduction system has substantial implications for geohazards, including the style of seismicity and the volume of magma generated at arc volcanoes. We utilize estimates of pore fluid distributions in the outer‐rise region of the Central American margin imaged using controlled‐source electro‐magnetic surveys and novel two‐dimensional forward models simulating poro‐elastic deformation of slab bending to constrain the background permeability structure of the Cocos Plate and within outer‐rise fault damage zones. The model results suggest that a relatively low background permeability structure is required to match the observed porosity at depths greater than 3 km (less than ~10 −21 m 2 . Similarly, increasing the permeability within the damage zones of outer‐rise faults by more than a factor of 10 also over‐predicts observed porosity distributions at depths greater than 3 km. However, the simulations consistently underpredict pore fluid distributions between depths of 1–3 km, which may reflect nonlinear elastic or anelastic deformation processes not included in the simulations or inherent uncertainty in the conversion of resistivity measurements to porosity distributions. The best‐fitting depth‐permeability relationship is relatively low, which has important implications for the timing of pore fluid release down‐dip of the trench, as it restricts shallow fluid release, likely leading to higher pore fluid pressures, more widespread hydraulic fracturing, and deeper release of pore fluid along the plate interface.

works.title: Deciphering the impact of magmatic-hydrothermal processes in phosphate-rich systems: integrated apatite in-situ REE-O-Sr signatures
works.abstract: Apatite is a widely distributed accessory mineral in igneous and hydrothermal systems. Here we integrate cathodoluminescence (CL) imaging, in situ REE geochemistry, and oxygen and strontium isotope analyses of apatite from 43 samples spanning 16 European deposits representative of diverse magmatic to magmatic–hydrothermal settings, including carbonatites, alkaline complexes, lamproites, layered intrusions, IOA–IOCG deposits, granite-pegmatite systems, and hydrothermal and metasomatic veins. The combined dataset reveals systematic chemical and isotopic trends that distinguish primary magmatic apatite from magmatic–hydrothermal transition and hydrothermal–metasomatic generations, while also providing diagnostic criteria for different classes of phosphate-bearing deposits. Primary magmatic apatite is commonly characterized by LREE-enriched patterns, low δ^18O values (generally 3–9‰), relatively low to moderate radiogenic Sr(i) signatures (0.701–0.707), and oscillatory CL zoning. Progressive fluid interaction with primary magmatic apatite is typically expressed by partial REE depletion, increasing δ^18O values, more radiogenic Sr(i) compositions, and the development of dissolution–reprecipitation textures. Granite–pegmatite systems are distinguished by strong intra-REE fractionation expressed by tetrad effects (> 1.1), radiogenic Sr isotopic compositions, and pronounced negative Eu anomalies. Apatite from hydrothermal and metasomatic deposits exhibits the strongest modification of primary signatures, including marked REE depletion, elevated δ^18O values, radiogenic Sr(i) ratios, and commonly turbid or microcrystalline CL textures. This study therefore highlights the analytical and interpretative power of integrated in situ methodologies for resolving the evolution of economically and geologically significant P-rich systems.

works.title: Final closure of the eastern Mongol-Okhotsk Ocean: First evidence from Barrovian metamorphism and multistage deformation in the Luomahu Group, NE China
works.abstract: Formation of the Mongol-Okhotsk suture belt represents the terminal orogenic event that constructed the modern tectonic framework of NE Asia. However, the timing and mechanisms of the final closure of the eastern Mongol-Okhotsk Ocean remain controversial. Based on integrated field investigations and analyses of microstructures, petrography, mineral chemistry, whole-rock geochemistry, phase equilibrium modeling, quartz electron backscatter diffraction fabric, and zircon U-Pb geochronology, we document for the first time a complete Middle to Late Jurassic Barrovian metamorphic sequence within the Luomahu Group of NE China, providing critical constraints on the timing and geodynamic processes of the final closure of the eastern Mongol-Okhotsk Ocean. Our study reveals that the Luomahu Group constitutes a tectonic collage of Lower Devonian to Lower Carboniferous metasedimentary strata intruded by early Mesozoic magmatic rocks, subsequently affected by Middle Jurassic to earliest Cretaceous syncollisional magmatism, metamorphism, and deformation. The prograde Barrovian metamorphism preserves a clockwise pressure-temperature-time-deformation path superposed by two deformation phases. Phase equilibrium modeling indicates progressive burial to amphibolite-facies peak conditions followed by retrograde cooling in both garnet-staurolite mica schist and garnet-sillimanite gneiss. Both deformation phases correlate with the peak metamorphic stage. D1 deformation is characterized by top-to-the-SW/SSW thrusting. D2 deformation is marked by sinistral strike-slip shearing along NNE-SSW−trending shear zones. Zircon U-Pb dating constrains the peak metamorphic age to ca. 165−145 Ma, with the two deformation phases occurring at ca. 162−150 Ma and ca. 150−144 Ma, respectively. We interpret the prograde Barrovian metamorphism and associated D1 deformation as direct evidence of crustal thickening during the closure of the eastern Mongol-Okhotsk Ocean. The subsequent D2 deformation is attributed to the far-field effects of NNW-directed low-angle subduction of the Paleo-Pacific plate, while a potential contribution from the ongoing ocean closure remains plausible. Together with regional data, we integrate our results to establish a west-to-east multistage closure model involving slab break-off, which conclusively demonstrates that the eastern Mongol-Okhotsk Ocean finally closed at the Jurassic to Cretaceous boundary.

works.title: The Zonal Distribution of W- and Sn-mineralized Granites in the Nanling Metallogenic Belt, South China: The Role of Magma Sources and Differentiation
works.abstract: Abstract The Nanling metallogenic belt of South China hosts numerous world-class late Mesozoic W deposits in the eastern domain and Sn deposits in the western domain. However, the cause of this zonal distribution remains enigmatic. Geochemical discrepancies between Late Jurassic Sn- and W-mineralized granites may account for the metallogenic zonation. The W granites have lower CaO/Na2O ratios as well as MgO, TiO2, and F contents, and higher Rb/Sr and Rb/Ba ratios and Mg# than the Sn granites, suggesting that the magmas were derived from metapelite-dominated and metagraywacke-dominated sources, respectively. Phase equilibrium modeling reveals that anatexis of pelitic basement rocks may produce melts with W contents of up to 20 ppm, five times higher than the source rock. In contrast, high-temperature partial melting of psammitic basement rocks would generate Sn-rich melts with up to 18 ppm Sn, four times higher than the source rock. The modeling results suggest that two episodes of melt extraction are not a prerequisite for the generation of Sn-rich melts. The genetic relationship of pelitic protoliths with W deposits and psammitic protoliths with Sn deposits is also applicable to many W and Sn deposits globally. The W granites experienced higher degrees of differentiation, with lower Zr/Hf (<18), Nb/Ta (<5), and Th/U (<2) ratios than the Sn granites. The weaker differentiation of the Sn granites was related to their higher cooling rates, which reflects their shallow emplacement. Tungsten and Sn in fluids have distinctly different geochemical behavior, with strongly evolved magmas being more favorable for W enrichment than Sn, leading to the decoupling of W-Sn and the observed zonal distribution of W-Sn deposits.

works.title:
Thermodynamic Controls on the Competition Between CO
                    <sub>2</sub>
                    Solute Transport and Retention in Fracture‐Pore Media: Insights From Real‐Basalt Microfluidics
works.abstract: Abstract Reactive‐surface exposure during basalt carbonation is controlled by the entry and retention of fracture‐transported CO 2 solute within adjacent pores, yet these pore‐scale processes remain poorly constrained under reservoir temperature and pressure. Here, real‐basalt microfluidic experiments were conducted at 30°C–60°C and 5–15 MPa. Fluorescence‐based concentration reconstruction and multi‐rate mass transfer model parameters were used to quantify and interpret CO 2 solute transport and retention. Results indicate that slow CO 2 concentration‐front propagation under low temperature‐pressure conditions favored solute entry into micropores with short characteristic lengths. Increasing temperature and pressure enhanced preferential fracture‐parallel solute transport, causing an unsteady fracture‐wall concentration boundary and promoting solute back‐transfer from micropores, whereas stable retention was mainly maintained in macropores. A favorable thermodynamic window existed before solute retention in micropores was fully suppressed, allowing substantial fracture‐pore solute accumulation. These findings reveal how reservoir temperature‐pressure conditions and fracture‐pore structure jointly control storage‐relevant mineralization potential in basaltic CO 2 storage.

works.title: Exhumed eo‐Alpine High‐Pressure Rocks Fed Campanian Turbidites in Eastern Sardinia
works.abstract: Abstract This study investigates the detrital record of the early orogenic evolution of the Sardinia‐Calabria system, preserved in Upper Cretaceous arenites exposed in eastern Sardinia. Sardinia and Corsica form a continental block that includes a segment of the Alpine orogen and of its former foreland basin. We investigate Upper Cretaceous arkosic turbidites from the Lanaittu Valley in eastern Sardinia. Biostratigraphy constrains the depositional age of the arenites to the middle‐late Campanian. Petrographic analyses confirmed the presence of rare glaucophane‐crossite combined with up to 13% kyanite and trace amounts of lawsonite. Using U‐Pb and (U‐Th)/He methods, double‐dated detrital zircons reveal a significant population (22%) that records mid‐to‐Late Cretaceous exhumation‐related cooling. Older zircon U‐Pb date populations, with a dominant Middle Permian peak and Proterozoic components, indicate a cratonic provenance consistent with the Sardinia/Calabria basement. A multi‐source area within an active orogenic belt is envisaged, supplying detritus to a basin located on the thinned Sardinian crust. These data indicate an episode of eo‐Alpine high‐pressure metamorphism and exhumation, likely related to the subduction of the Western Ligurian Ocean beneath a portion of the Alkapeca microplate, which is identified with the northern Calabria‐Peloritani subterrane. This metamorphic event is comparable to eo‐Alpine events recorded elsewhere in the Mediterranean region, such as in the Sesia zone of the Western Alps. Exhumation is inferred to have occurred during ongoing convergence, marking an early stage of Alpine subduction.

works.title:
Carbonate‐Associated Sulfate Does Not Record Superheavy δ
                    <sup>34</sup>
                    S in Deep Scandinavian Bedrock Fractures: Implications for Pyrite Formation in the Deep Biosphere
works.abstract: Abstract In deep bedrock fractures of the Fennoscandian shield, pyrite with “superheavy” δ 34 S values of up to 147‰ exists together with calcite. The extreme variability and 34 S‐enrichment in pyrite indicate that microbial sulfate reduction (MSR) evolved to almost complete sulfate exhaustion in closed‐system microenvironments. The bulk δ 34 S pyrite of up to 81‰ implies a sulfate source with unusually high δ 34 S, although such a source has not yet been identified. Here, we aim to decipher this source by analyzing carbonate‐associated sulfate (CAS) of calcite related to superheavy pyrite. Our δ 34 S CAS values reveal low to moderate 34 S enrichment, with δ 34 S CAS between 2.3 and 28.2‰, which is far below the bulk δ 34 S pyrite of up to 81‰ indicating a decoupled sulfate pool for CAS and pyrite origin. The extreme δ 34 S fractionation recorded by pyrite implies very slow MSR rates, which typically promote calcite dissolution rather than precipitation. Calcite precipitation was thus inhibited during superheavy pyrite formation. Instead, the calcite shows signs for anaerobic oxidation of methane coupled to sulfate reduction (AOM‐SR), reflected by 13 C‐depletion and moderate 34 S‐enrichment. The AOM‐SR process reduces sulfate concentration, in turn providing conditions suitable for the formation of superheavy pyrite. We propose that a limited supply of substrates (sulfate and organic matter) and Fe 2+ , their episodic input into the deep fracture system together with low diffusion rates of fracture fluids enabled a balance and completion of microbial methanogenesis, AOM‐SR, and MSR. Extreme isotope signatures may thus represent diagnostic features of episodic, energy‐limited deep biosphere ecosystems, with implications for understanding subsurface microbial ecology and biogeochemical cycling.

works.abstract: ABSTRACT The middle Bangong–Nujiang suture zone (MBN) has emerged as the most intensely debated area in recent studies on the tectonic dynamics and geological evolution of the Bangong–Nujiang Ocean. This study presents an integrated analysis of geochemical, geochronological and isotopic data for the Leibao intrusions in the MBN and aims to clarify its petrogenesis and tectonic settings. The Leibao intrusions (77–79 Ma) are monzodiorite to granite in composition with a wide range of SiO 2 (52.5–81.5 wt%) and high K 2 O content, affiliated with high‐K calc‐alkaline I‐type granites. Leibao intrusions were formed by partial melting of the juvenile lower crust. They were subjected to varying degrees of middle–upper crustal contamination and fractional crystallisation during ascent and emplacement in a post‐collisional extensional setting. We propose that the MBN experienced three distinct magmatic episodes during the Mesozoic: Late Jurassic (> 150 Ma), Early Cretaceous (125–105 Ma) and Late Cretaceous ( ε Hf ( t ), and T Zr (°C) values of the Late Mesozoic rocks indicate possible periodic thickening of the continental crust, similar to the Cordilleran orogenic systems.

works.title: Dry mafic recharge modulates degassing in rift-related magma reservoirs recorded by a giant porphyry Mo system
works.abstract: Magma degassing shapes crustal volatile cycling, magma-reservoir dynamics, and magmatic-hydrothermal ore formation. Yet how relatively dry, rift-related silicic reservoirs repeatedly approach volatile saturation and sustain cyclic degassing remains elusive. Rift-hosted porphyry Mo systems exemplify this problem; fertile A-type granitoids contain moderate dissolved H2O contents (∼3-4 wt.%), whereas coeval mafic magmas are comparatively dry and metal-poor (<1 wt.% H2O; 1-2 µg/g Mo), thereby challenging the arc-derived paradigm that invokes volatile-rich mafic recharge to trigger episodic hydrothermal activity. Here we reconstruct the thermal and volatile evolution of the rift-related silicic reservoir that sourced the Shapinggou porphyry Mo system (China) by integrating in-situ Ti and δ18O analyses with Ti diffusion chronometry, thermodynamic modelling, and Monte Carlo simulations. Our results indicate that the reservoir persisted for ∼31-45 kyr as a crystal-rich silicic mush undersaturated in H2O and S. Millennial-scale injections of dry, metal-poor mafic magma acted as thermal-sulfur pumps; despite small individual volumes (∼2.6-3.5 km3), these pulses provided sufficient enthalpy to episodically rejuvenate ∼22% of the locked mush and regulate degassing style and rhythm. Reconstructed pressure-temperature paths alternated between permeable, buoyancy-driven outgassing and overpressure-driven explosive release, consistent with coexisting vein-type mineralization and near-surface breccia pipes. These results show that, in rift-related magmatic systems, dry mafic recharge can govern episodic hydrothermal activity not by supplying large water or metal fluxes, but by delivering heat and sulfur and modulating reservoir physical state as volatile saturation is approached. Recharge-controlled switching between degassing regimes therefore links deep reservoir dynamics to episodic shallow-crustal fluid release beyond subduction zones.

works.title: Highly Enriched and Heterogeneous Mantle Signals Recorded in Mantle Pyroxenite Veins
works.abstract: Abstract The Earth's mantle is inherently heterogeneous, reflecting ongoing mantle depletion and crustal recycling driven by plate tectonics. Radiogenic isotopes in oceanic basalts are commonly used to characterize mantle reservoirs, but the full chemical diversity of mantle‐derived melts may be obscured by magma mixing during melt transport and storage. Pyroxenite veins formed by melt segregation or melt–peridotite interaction in the lithospheric mantle provide an alternative archive that may better preserve the compositional diversity of mantle‐derived melts. We present Nd–Hf isotopic data for bulk rock, clinopyroxene, and orthopyroxene from pyroxenite veins in three mantle massifs exposed along the Yarlung‐Tsangpo Suture Zone in southern Tibet. Clinopyroxene and orthopyroxene from the same samples display distinct initial isotopic compositions, indicating crystallization from compositionally different melt pulses. Orthopyroxene commonly records more enriched and less radiogenic signatures than clinopyroxene, highlighting its potential to preserve isotopic information on enriched melt components. Additionally, the pyroxenite veins define a wide range of initial Nd–Hf isotopic compositions (initial ε Nd = −10.3 to +8.6 and initial ε Hf = −8.4 to 18.3), extending beyond the variability reported for basaltic lavas and cumulates from the same ophiolitic system. These variations are consistent with mixing between melts derived from depleted mantle and melts originating from enriched mantle domains. Our results suggest that mantle pyroxenite veins can preferentially preserve the isotopic heterogeneity of the enriched mantle source. Overall, this study highlights the value of mineral‐scale isotopic analyses in pyroxenites for documenting mantle heterogeneity and provides new constraints on melt migration and aggregation processes in the upper mantle.
