works.title: Neoarchean prolonged subduction-related magmatism and multistage metamorphism in the Zunhua area: implications for the cratonization of the eastern North China Craton
works.abstract: The late Neoarchean crustal accretion and ultimate cratonization of the North China Craton (NCC) were fundamentally dictated by the continuous evolution of subduction-accretion systems. In this study, we present comprehensive petrological, whole-rock geochemical, and zircon U-Pb geochronological data for the metavolcanic sequences (amphibolites and felsic gneisses) from the Zunhua area on the northern margin of the eastern NCC. SIMS (Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry) zircon U-Pb dating identifies three distinct magmatic episodes at ∼2.59 Ga, 2.54–2.53 Ga, and 2.52–2.50 Ga. The mafic volcanic rocks (now metamorphosed as amphibolites) of different episodes exhibit pristine arc-like geochemical signatures without significant crustal contamination. They were derived from partial melting of mantle wedge metasomatized by fluids within a supra-subduction zone, representing the progressive construction of an isolated intra-oceanic island arc built upon juvenile oceanic lithosphere. Conversely, the felsic gneisses display diagnostic adakitic (or Tonalite-Trondhjemite-Granodiorite-like) affinities and originated from the profound partial melting of the thickened mafic lower crust within the garnet stability field. The adakitic magmatism marks the climax of sub-arc vertical thickening and the paramount volumetric accretion of the early continental crust. Synchronized with this magmatism, metamorphic zircon overgrowths, as revealed by SIMS zircon U-Pb dating, record a multistage tectonothermal evolution capturing a fundamental geodynamic transition. The sustained subduction convergence and magma underplating drove an early thermal event (∼2.55 Ga) and a subsequent regional metamorphic peak (∼2.52–2.51 Ga) coeval with maximum crustal thickening. Following this climax, late-stage thermal pulses (∼2.49–2.45 Ga) document post-peak retrograde re-equilibration and extensional overprinting triggered by sub-arc crustal delamination. Collectively, our results provide a complete petrogenetic archive for the continuous operation of a subduction-accretion system, deciphering the transition from subduction to accretion and lower crustal delamination. This process on the northern margin of eastern NCC took place before the final amalgamation of the eastern and western blocks, providing geological constraints on Neoarchean cratonization and lithospheric rigidification in the eastern NCC.

works.title: Rapid denudation of a Paleo-Tethyan arc revealed by decoupled O isotopes and elemental compositions in Late Permian Hainan granitic rocks
works.abstract: Rapid uplift, denudation and recycling of continental arcs intimately link surface processes and deep crustal magmatism. However, direct petrological records of such rapid surface-crust recycling remain scarce. Here, we investigated Late Permian (256–250 Ma) granitic rocks from Hainan Island, South China, which formed within the eastern Paleo-Tethyan arc system. New elemental and isotopic data reveal a decoupling between whole-rock elemental geochemistry and oxygen isotopes in zircon. The studied rocks are metaluminous in composition (A/CNK 8‰). This implies that the protoliths of these Late Permian granitic rocks had experienced some degree of low-temperature water–rock interaction at Earth's surface. This elemental-isotopic decoupling is interpreted to reflect a rapid denudation and recycling loop within a Paleo-Tethyan continental arc. Tectonic uplift exposed juvenile igneous protoliths to surface conditions, where low-temperature water-rock interaction elevated their δ18O signatures. The weathered materials were then rapidly eroded, transported over short distances, and buried and remelted within a back-arc system. This scenario provides the most plausible explanation for the observed decoupling between whole-rock I-type mineralogical and elemental characteristics and zircon oxygen isotopic compositions in the Late Permian granitic rocks from Hainan Island, South China. Such decoupling may represent an important yet underrecognized aspect of continental arc evolution, reflecting efficient surface-deep coupling. Enhanced exposure and weathering of juvenile arc rocks likely promoted silicate weathering and potentially increasing atmospheric CO₂ consumption during the Late Permian, with implications for contemporaneous climate.

works.title: Depth-Dependent Chlorine Cycling at the Magmatic-Hydrothermal Interface of Mid-Ocean Ridges: Insights from Hornfelsic Diabase
works.abstract: Abstract The conductive boundary layer (CBL) at the magmatic-hydrothermal interface of mid-ocean ridges (MORs) regulates the fundamental exchange of heat and chemical species between cooling magmas and circulating seawater. While this interface is well-documented at shallow, fast-spreading ridges and in ophiolites, its nature in deep-seated magmatic environments—particularly along slow-spreading ridge segments hosting oceanic core complexes (OCCs)—remains poorly constrained. Here, we investigate the physicochemical properties of this interface through a detailed microstructural, geochemical, and fluid inclusion analysis of hornfelsic diabase, the primary constituent of the CBL, recovered from the Onnuri OCC on the Central Indian Ridge. Our results characterize two distinct lithologies: hornblende hornfelsic and pyroxene hornfelsic diabase. Clinopyroxene geothermometry yields peak metamorphic temperatures of 815–987 °C, with evidence of localized hydrous partial melting and the formation of amphibole-rich diorite. Despite these intense thermal conditions, the Onnuri hornfels exhibits remarkably low chlorine (Cl) signatures in both amphiboles (< 663 ppm) and fluid inclusions (2.0–5.0 wt.% NaCl eq.), reflecting interaction with fluids of seawater-like salinity. This geochemical signature contrasts sharply with the high-Cl brines and Cl-rich amphiboles typical of shallow fast-spreading systems. We demonstrate that this divergence is fundamentally rooted in the pressure-regulated phase behavior of seawater. Seawater P-T phase analysis identifies a critical hydrostatic pressure threshold of 80-100 MPa; beyond this limit, phase separation is effectively suppressed, whereas at lower pressures, it becomes increasingly pronounced as pressure declines. Consequently, the high-pressure regime prevents the formation of a basal brine layer—promoting interaction with low-salinity, seawater-like fluids—while the low-pressure regime facilitates brine accumulation. To evaluate whether this mechanism can be applied on a global scale, we performed a meta-analysis of MORB chemistry and hydrothermal vent datasets. Our analysis of global MORB datasets demonstrates that magma storage depth exerts the ultimate control over crustal Cl assimilation, with long-term, segment-scale magmatic flux operating as the underlying driver of this vertical architecture. Furthermore, hydrothermal vent fluid data exhibit a corresponding depth-dependent variability, with Cl concentrations stabilizing near seawater values as heat source depth increases. By synthesizing these multi-disciplinary constraints, we propose a unified, depth-dependent model for Cl cycling at the magmatic-hydrothermal interface. We conclude that the emplacement depth of the magmatic heat source, governed by segment-wide magmatic flux, serves as the primary determinant of the hydrostatic pressure of the hydrothermal cell, thereby controlling subseafloor brine formation, the extent of crustal Cl assimilation, and the chemical stability of hydrothermal vent fluids in the global MOR oceanic crust.

works.title: Widespread preservation of cumulative Paleoarchean peridotite bodies within the Eoarchean Itsaq Gneiss Complex, southwest Greenland
works.abstract: The Ujaragssuit Nunât layered intrusion, which is the largest layered intrusion within the Ujaragssuit Nunât complex (UNC) and is known for preserving the Earth’s oldest chromitites, was previously considered to have a minimum age of > 3.8 Ga. However, a recent ∼3.25 Ga age for chromitites from the Ujaragssuit Nunât layered intrusion challenges the previous interpretation that the intrusion predates the adjacent Eoarchean tonalities, raising the possibility that other ultramafic bodies in the UNC may also be younger than previously assumed. To investigate this, we conducted a thorough geochemical study of ultramafic rocks collected throughout the Ujaragssuit region, from both within and beyond the well-studied largest layered intrusion. Mineral and whole-rock geochemical data indicate that their compositions were predominantly controlled by the accumulation of olivine and orthopyroxene, along with trapped intercumulus melts. The Re-depletion Os model ages (TRD), primarily obtained from dunites, cluster at ∼3.3 Ga. Meanwhile, the amphibole-free harzburgites and the majority of Cr-Al trend amphibole harzburgites display negligible Re addition yield consistent Re-Os model ages (TMA) of ∼3.3 Ga. Taken together, the best age estimate for ultramafic rocks in the UNC is ∼3.3 Ga. In contrast, the significantly younger TRD ages (<2.3 Ga) and a ∼2.6 Ga Re-Os regression line obtained from amphibole harzburgites likely point to regional Neoarchean metamorphism, responsible for the formation of metamorphic chromites and metamorphic and/or metasomatic amphiboles. These findings demonstrate that the peridotite bodies and chromitites are not Eoarchean relics predating the ∼3.8 Ga gneiss. Instead, they represent pervasive mafic magma intrusions into existing continental crust.

works.title: Towards accurate Ca isotope fractionation at equilibrium between minerals and aqueous solutions with electronic structure calculations: Multi-framework comparison for validation and correction, and the control of structural cations
works.abstract: Theoretical calculation of equilibrium fractionation of Ca isotopes shows particularly challenging due to the limitations of DFT frameworks to properly reproduce the important vibrational properties. This is even more challenging for mineral-solution equilibria, as frameworks adapted to minerals do not properly reproduce aqueous solution structures. Based on careful correction of calculated frequencies by experimental ones, a rescaling parameter can be proposed to obtain reference ln β values from eight different theoretical frameworks, within an uncertainty ( σ ) ranging between 0.25 ‰ (PBEsol and PBE functionals) and 0.75 ‰ (LDA functional, PBE or BLYP functionals with Grimme-D2 correction) at 300K. Frameworks showing more consistent structural prediction (with consistent offsets on Ca-O distances) also show more consistent predicted fractionation properties. Eight well characterized minerals (anhydrite, fluorite, diopside, grossular, calcite, dolomite, aragonite, CaO lime) were used for the validation and correction procedure, and six more (wollastonite, anorthite, huntite, monticellite, akermanite, gypsum) were calculated to infer the controls of Ca isotope fractionation and compare to experimental or natural estimates. Ca isotopes fractionation properties of a mineral shows connected to Ca-O distance, coordination and the type of structural cation, following the expression: (1) l n α m i n e r a l − C a O = l n β C a O × ( b × Δ d + c ( c o o r d ) + d ( c a t i o n ) ) , where α m i n e r a l − C a O is the fractionation of Ca isotopes with respect to CaO lime; β C a O is the β -factor of CaO lime; Δ d is the relative difference in Ca-O distance between the mineral and CaO lime; b=-7.44 at 300K; c is the coordination effect, varying monotonically from 0 for c(6) to ≈ +0.30 for c(8)=c(9); d is the effect of the cations present in the structure (in addition to Ca2＋), determined for Si 4 + , S 5 + , C 4 + , P 5 + (based on Antonelli et al. (2019) calculations), and H + . The obtained cation effects appear to be related to their electronegativities. Assuming calcite-Ca2＋(aq.) fractionation as null, one can compare our predicted mineral-calcite fractionations with experimental mineral-Ca2＋(aq.) fractionations. The predicted aragonite-calcite and anhydrite-calcite fractionations are twice as large as the corresponding mineral-Ca2＋(aq.) experimental values, suggesting perturbing effects in solution (speciation, kinetic effects). On the contrary, predicted gypsum-calcite fractionations are in agreement with gypsum-Ca2＋(aq.) experimental values. Predicted dolomite-calcite fractionation agrees with fractionation occurring during biogenic dolomite precipitation, but dolomitization does not seem to follow isotopic equilibrium.

works.title: Genesis of the Baitoushan Cu-Polymetallic Deposit, Qimantagh Region, Eastern Kunlun Orogen: Evidence from geochemistry of garnets and geochronology
works.abstract: The Qimantagh region in the western segment of the Eastern Kunlun Orogenic Belt has undergone multiple phases of tectonic-magmatic activity from the Paleozoic to Early Mesozoic, resulting in the formation of numerous skarn- and porphyry-type deposits. The newly discovered Baitoushan skarn Cu-polymetallic deposit remains poorly studied. This paper focuses on two types of garnet from the deposit: dark garnet (Grt-1) and light garnet (Grt-2) that replaces the earlier-formed Grt-1 with their chemical compositions analyzed using EPMA and LA-ICP-MS. The results indicate that both Grt-1 and Grt-2 belong to the grossular-andradite solid-solution series, Grt-2 is enriched in the andradite component. Both garnets exhibit low total rare earth element (REE) contents. However, Grt-1 shows significantly higher ΣREE and LREE/HREE ratios than Grt-2. Grt-1 displays a pronounced negative Eu anomaly and a right-inclined REE pattern, whereas Grt-2 exhibits a moderate negative Eu anomaly with a gently left-inclined pattern. These compositional differences suggest that Grt-1 crystallized under relatively low-oxygen-fugacity and weakly acidic conditions, while the increased Fe and decreased U contents in Grt-2 reflect a higher oxygen fugacity and a higher pH during its formation. LA-ICP-MS U-Pb dating of garnet and apatite yielded ages of 219.4 ± 3.4 Ma and 220.8 ± 6.4 Ma, respectively, both falling within the Late Triassic (Indosinian period). These ages confirm the Indosinian mineralization event at the Baitoushan deposit. The compositional variations between the two garnet generations record a systematic increase in oxygen fugacity and pH during fluid evolution, demonstrating the utility of garnet geochemistry in tracking skarn-forming processes. The precisely determined U-Pb ages of garnet and apatite provide robust temporal constraints on the ore formation, confirming a Late Triassic magmatic-hydrothermal origin. Collectively, these results, integrated with regional magmatic and tectonic data, establish the Baitoushan deposit as a product of the large-scale Indosinian skarn metallogenic event in the Qimantagh region, which was fundamentally controlled by thickened crust, mantle-derived oxidized adakitic magmas, and trans-crustal structures

works.title: Enhanced upwelling and subsequent photic zone euxinia linked to the two-phase late Cambrian Marjuman extinction
works.abstract: The middle–late Cambrian witnessed recurrent biotic crises in the aftermath of the Cambrian explosion, exemplified by the late Cambrian end-Marjuman Biomere Extinction linked to major environmental perturbations across the Guzhangian–Paibian boundary. However, the precise mechanisms underlying this biodiversity collapse remain unclear. Mercury isotopes from two slope sections in South China reveal enhanced upwelling during the late Guzhangian, followed by photic zone euxinia in the early–middle Paibian, corresponding to the two extinction phases. This mercury record suggests that initial upwelling, followed by hydrogen sulfide toxicity in shallow oceans, drove the two-stage collapse of shallow marine shelf faunas in South China. Furthermore, this study strengthens the case that the coupled positive Δ^199Hg (mass-independent isotope fractionation) and negative δ^202Hg (mass-dependent isotope fractionation) shifts can serve as a tracer for upwelling in Precambrian–Cambrian oceans. Collectively, our mercury isotopes offer new insights into the dynamic interactions between ocean chemistry and early animal evolution in the middle–late Cambrian. The late Cambrian Marjuman extinction event in South China was triggered by enhanced upwelling and hydrogen sulfide toxicity in shallow oceans, according to analyses of Mercury isotope data from China.

works.title: Migrating intracontinental orogeny recorded by diachronous regional unconformities
works.abstract: Unconformities are key markers in the geological record, traditionally viewed as synchronous indicators of tectonic and sedimentary processes. Here, we investigate two major Jurassic-Cretaceous unconformities (Unconformity A and Unconformity B) across the Yanshan Fold-Thrust Belt of the North China Craton and show that unconformities can develop diachronously, recording the progressive migration of intracontinental deformation. By integrating new high-precision SIMS U-Pb zircon dating with existing geochronological data from strata above and below the unconformities across eight basins, we construct a detailed spatiotemporal framework for their development. Unconformity A, formed between ∼163 and ∼142 Ma, migrated westward (landward), reflecting progressive crustal shortening associated with flat subduction of the Paleo-Pacific plate. In contrast, Unconformity B, developed between ∼140 and ∼126 Ma, migrated eastward (trenchward) during slab rollback, recording renewed crustal deformation followed by crustal extension. This landward then trenchward migration pattern indicate that the Yanshan intracontinental orogen tracked changes in the geometry and dynamics of Paleo-Pacific subduction. Our results demonstrate that unconformities can be diachronous, and that diachronous regional unconformities provide an independent surface record of migrating intracontinental orogeny, linking deep subduction processes to upper-plate deformation and offering a framework for recognizing similar tectonic signals in other continental interiors.

works.title: Ore-controlling factors inferred from magnetic data for the Shuangjianzishan silver-polymetallic deposit in the southern Great Xing’an Range, northern China
works.abstract: Magnetic data from the Shuangjianzishan silver-polymetallic deposit in the Southern Great Xing’an Range, along with regional geological background information, were analyzed to characterize structural and lithological controls on mineralization. The mining district is dominated by conjugate northeast- and northwest-trending fault systems, with the Dashizhai Formation serving as the primary ore-bearing stratigraphic unit. Spatial distribution of intrusive ranges, morphology of deep-seated intrusive bodies, and Cretaceous volcanic rocks was examined. Early Cretaceous igneous rocks constitute the primary metallogenic formations in the mining district that host metallogenic deposits. Geophysical characteristics of key ore-controlling elements and the spatial distribution of metallogenic factors were outlined. A metallogenic model and prospecting indicators for the mining district were established, and a three-dimensional geological model of the Shuangjianzishan deposit was constructed. Two promising metallogenic sites were identified along the periphery of the mining area, providing a basis for future deep resource exploration and development.

works.title: Genesis of the Jinguanchong perigranitic uranium deposit, South China: constraints from whole-rock geochemistry and in-situ pitchblende analyses
works.abstract: The Jinguanchong deposit is the typical perigranitic uranium deposit located in the eastern Hunan Province, south China. The ore bodies primarily occur within the exocontact zone of the Yajiangqiao pluton and in the Qiziqiao Formation, with pitchblende being the predominant uranium mineral. The detailed mineralogical, mineral chemistry, geochronology, and whole-rock geochemistry of the Jinguanchong deposit have been conducted, in order to elucidate its genetic mechanism. Two uranium mineralization stages have been organized based on the mineralogical characteristics and LA-ICP-MS U-Pb dating on pitchblende. The first mineralizing stage occurred during Late Cretaceous, with a weight mean age of 72.6 ± 0.4 Ma (MSWD = 0.96). The second mineralizing stage occurred during Early Paleogene, with a weight mean age of 59.9 ± 0.5 Ma (MSWD = 0.23). The Yajiangqiao pluton exhibits a strongly peraluminous character with relatively low Th/U ratios, which is characteristic of a good U source for the mineralization. Combined whole-rock and in-situ trace-REE geochemistry of pitchblende, indicate that the Yajiangqiao pluton, Qiziqiao Formation, and Lengjiaxi Group served as uranium sources for the Jinguanchong deposit. According to the mineral paragenetic association and geochemistry of pitchblende, the ore-forming fluids of the first mineralizing stage in the Jinguanchong deposit should be rich in HCO3 –, CO2, and Ca2+, with moderate to high salinity and high temperatures. Ore-forming fluids of the second mineralizing stage are characterized by lower salinity and middle to low temperatures, mainly originated from meteoric water. Deeply-rooted faults and a series of fault breccia zones were formed under an extensional tectonic setting in the Mingyuefeng area. These zones provided pathways for the circulation of ore-forming fluids. Fluid cooling, degassing, and changes in geochemical conditions are the key factors leading to the reduction and precipitation of uranium from uranyl complexes in the ore-forming fluids. The findings of this study will contribute to establishing a mineralization model for the Jinguanchong deposit, and provide a theoretical basis for the future exploration of perigranitic uranium deposit in the Mingyuefeng area.

works.translated_title: 华南金管冲近花岗岩型铀矿床成因：全岩地球化学与原位沥青铀矿分析的制约

summary_bullets.research_question: 明确金管冲花岗岩外带型铀矿床的成因机制及两期铀成矿作用的来源与演化。
summary_bullets.methodology: 采用全岩地球化学、沥青铀矿LA-ICP-MS U-Pb定年及原位微量元素与稀土元素分析。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 识别出晚白垩世（72.6 Ma）和早古新世（59.9 Ma）两期成矿，成矿物质来自花岗岩、棋子桥组和冷家溪群。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次通过沥青铀矿原位分析揭示两期流体性质差异，并构建多源区成矿模型。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为华南外带型铀矿的勘查提供理论依据和成矿模型，指导明月峰地区找矿预测。

works.title: Distribution and enrichment mechanism of cobalt in the Chengchao skarn Fe deposit, Hubei, China
works.abstract: With the rapid growth of industries such as electric vehicles, global cobalt (Co) consumption has surged, spurring increased interest in the mechanisms of cobalt enrichment in skarn-type Fe deposits, which remains poorly constrained. This study focuses on the Chengchao skarn Fe deposit in southeastern Hubei Province, situated in the western segment of the Middle-Lower Yangtze Metallogenic Belt. By integrating major and trace element analyses of minerals across different mineralization stages with sulfur isotope data from pyrite, we elucidate the paragenesis and enrichment processes of cobalt in this deposit. Mineralogical data reveal that cobalt is exclusively hosted in Fe2+-bearing phases, such as pyralspite, phlogopite, magnetite, and especially pyrite, suggesting that Co3+ is absent or non-substitutable in the hydrothermal system. Sulfur isotope signatures indicate that the Chengchao magma assimilated substantial amounts of evaporite, enhancing sulfur and Cl− concentrations in the magmatic-hydrothermal fluid and thereby increasing cobalt extraction efficiency. During the prograde skarn stage, Co content in early-stage pyrite (Py1: 0.56–539.44 ppm Co) was governed by the initial Co concentration of fluids and mineral–fluid partitioning behavior. Peak cobalt enrichment occurred in pyrite from the sulfate–sulfide stage, including (1) Py2a (537.09–5878.34 ppm Co) during the retrograde to sulfate–sulfide transition, (2) Py2b (226.61–24294.94 ppm Co) during the main sulfate–sulfide stage, and (3) Py2c (788.26–14367.14 ppm Co) from late sulfate–sulfide to early carbonate stage. This enrichment is attributed to decreasing temperature, increasing pH, and meteoric water input, which collectively reduced Co solubility. Concurrently, oxidation of Fe2+ produced abundant S2−, promoting widespread pyrite precipitation and Co incorporation via isomorphous substitution. By the final carbonate stage, disseminated pyrite (Py3) showed significantly lower Co concentrations (79.11–231.27 ppm), likely due to cobalt depletion in the fluid during earlier mineralization stages.

works.translated_title: 湖北程潮矽卡岩型铁矿中钴的分布与富集机制

summary_bullets.research_question: 揭示矽卡岩型铁矿中钴的富集机制，约束钴的赋存状态与成矿过程。
summary_bullets.methodology: 对不同成矿阶段矿物进行主微量元素分析，结合黄铁矿硫同位素数据。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 钴主要赋存于含Fe2+矿物，蒸发岩同化增强流体萃取钴，硫酸盐-硫化物阶段温度下降和pH升高导致钴在黄铁矿中富集。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次在程潮矽卡岩矿床中系统阐明钴的富集阶段和矿物学控制因素。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为矽卡岩型铁矿中钴资源评价和找矿提供理论依据，助力电动汽车等产业的钴供应链研究。

works.title: The link between seawater and foraminiferal calcite chemistry
works.abstract: Foraminiferal calcification occurs within a semi-open system, explaining the link between shell trace-element ratios and seawater composition, according to cryo–focused ion beam milling with scanning electron microscopy. Geochemical signatures of the calcium carbonate shells of foraminifera form the basis of many proxies used in climate reconstructions. Yet, key physiological controls governing mineral precipitation remain unknown, limiting a mechanistic understanding of proxy sensitivity and interspecific variability. Here, we combine cryo–focused ion beam milling with scanning electron microscopy to reconstruct the in vivo three-dimensional ultrastructure of the foraminiferal calcification site. The images reveal a semi-open system, in which the calcifying fluid is largely isolated from ambient seawater by a thin cellular barrier, while discrete ~30 nm openings allow limited fluid exchange. This configuration provides a link between seawater and the site of calcification, offering a mechanistic explanation for the correlation between shell trace-element ratios and ambient seawater composition, complementing the ion uptake through transmembrane transport. This, in turn, improves understanding of element incorporation and enhances the reliability of foraminiferal calcite as a paleoproxy.

works.translated_title: 海水与有孔虫方解石化学之间的联系

summary_bullets.research_question: 有孔虫钙化的生理控制机制尚不明确，限制了对微量元素代用指标敏感性和种间差异的理解。
summary_bullets.methodology: 采用冷冻聚焦离子束铣削结合扫描电子显微镜，原位重建钙化位点的三维超微结构。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 钙化位点呈半开放系统，薄细胞屏障上约30纳米开口允许有限流体交换，连接海水与钙化流体。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次原位三维展示有孔虫钙化超微结构，揭示半开放系统为元素比值与海水成分的关联提供机制解释。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 提升元素掺入机制的理解，增强有孔虫方解石作为古气候代用指标的可靠性。

works.title: Serpentine’s wet breakdown path and enhanced water flux in cold subduction zones
works.abstract: Extra water in cold tectonic plates causes sinking rocks (serpentinites) to transform and absorb more water. This boosts deep water transport by cold slabs, creating lateral contrasts in hydration, density, and seismic velocity. Serpentine stability dictates deep water cycling in subduction zones. We investigated pure serpentinites (≈ 13 wt.% H_2O) using in-situ synchrotron X-ray diffraction and ultrasonic velocity measurements under two cold-slab P–T paths, varying excess water (0.9–31.5 wt.%). Here we report that under a cold core (or ultracold Moho) geotherm with >6.9 wt.% excess water, serpentinites undergo deep hydration to form the 3.65-Å phase and phase E above 9.3 GPa and 420 °C (ca. 280 km depth), increasing total water to ≈ 19.3 wt.%. With <6.9 wt.% excess water, serpentine transforms to phase E without water loss. Conversely, under a cold Moho geotherm, serpentinites dehydrate into phase E and clinoenstatite above 7.4 GPa and 585 °C (ca. 220 km depth), releasing ≈ 5.3 wt.% water. These divergent reactions highlight an underestimated water transport capacity of subducting slabs, generating lateral contrasts in hydration, density, and seismic velocity.
works.label: flagship
works.translated_title: 冷俯冲带中蛇纹石的湿分解路径与增强的水通量

summary_bullets.research_question: 揭示冷俯冲带中蛇纹石在不同水和地温条件下的分解路径及其对水运移的影响。
summary_bullets.methodology: 采用原位同步辐射X射线衍射和超声波速度测量，沿两种冷板片P-T路径调节过量水含量。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 高过量水时蛇纹石在约280 km深水化形成3.65-Å相和E相增水；低水或暖条件则脱水产生E相并释水。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次发现蛇纹石沿冷俯冲带截然相反的水化-脱水路径，导致横向物性差异。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 重塑深部水循环认知，凸显板片水运移能力被低估，为地震成像和密度模型提供约束。

works.title: Study on the petrogenic and metallogenic mechanisms of the Demingding Mo-Cu deposit in the eastern Gangdese: Implications for the eruption and mineralization of the Miocene adakitic magmatism
works.abstract: The Miocene is the primary metallogenic epoch for porphyry deposits in the Gangdese metallogenic belt and also a significant period of intense adakitic magmatism related to mineralization. However, there remains considerable controversies regarding the petrogenesis and geodynamic settings of the Miocene adakitic rocks in the Gangdese belt. The Demingding Mo-Cu deposit is located in the eastern segment of the Gangdese metallogenic belt, with granite porphyry as the main ore-bearing intrusion. This study presents Re-Os dating of molybdenite from the Demingding deposit, along with zircon U-Pb geochronology, whole-rock geochemistry, Lu-Hf isotopic analysis of granite porphyry, as well as in-situ sulfur isotopic analysis of the ores. The results show a molybdenite Re-Os age of 20.40 ± 0.55 Ma and a granite porphyry U-Pb age of 20.53 ± 0.23 Ma, indicating that the mineralization of the Demingding deposit occurred in the Early Miocene. The sulfur isotope characteristics of pyrite and chalcopyrite suggest that the sulfur is likely derived primarily from magmatic (mantle-derived) sources, and the mineralizing magma exhibits high oxygen fugacity and water content. Petrographic and geochemical features, along with Hf isotopes, indicate that the granite porphyry exhibits typical adakitic characteristics and originated from the partial melting of the thickened juvenile lower crust of the Lhasa terrane, mixed with melts from the lithospheric mantle. Through comprehensive analysis, this study proposes that the tearing of the Indian continental plate with varying subduction angles along the north–south direction, combined with the delamination of the torn Indian continental lithosphere, may have significantly contributed to the widespread development of Miocene adakitic rocks and related porphyry deposits (such as the Demingding deposit) in the Gangdese metallogenic belt.

works.translated_title: 冈底斯东部德明顶钼铜矿床成岩成矿机制研究：对中新世埃达克质岩浆喷发与成矿作用的启示

summary_bullets.research_question: 解决冈底斯带中新世埃达克质岩的成因及其地球动力学背景争议。

summary_bullets.key_findings: 德明顶矿床形成于约20.5 Ma，花岗斑岩源于加厚新生下地壳熔融并混入地幔熔体。

works.title: Limited water incorporation in davemaoite under lower-mantle conditions
works.abstract: Davemaoite can store limited water in the lower mantle, suggesting that subducted materials like basaltic crust and sediments may serve as important water reservoirs, according to in-situ lattice volume measurements of davemaoite under dry and hydrous conditions. Water storage in Earth’s mantle impacts its physical and chemical properties, yet the capacity of the lower mantle to host water remains poorly constrained. While the transition zone is a major reservoir, the dominant lower-mantle minerals bridgmanite and ferropericlase exhibit limited water solubility, and the role of davemaoite (CaSiO_3-perovskite) remains uncertain due to experimental challenges. Here we report in-situ lattice-volume measurements of davemaoite synthesized under dry and hydrous conditions up to 30 GPa and 2100 K using advanced multi-anvil techniques. At lower-mantle temperatures, hydration produces only a marginal volume reduction, indicating that water incorporation is limited to trace levels rather than the substantial amounts suggested previously. We also find no clear evidence for the tetragonal structure regardless of hydration. These results indicate that davemaoite stores limited water in the peridotitic mantle, implying that subducted crustal materials such as basaltic crust containing hydrous silica phases could dominate deep-lower mantle water storage.

works.translated_title: 下地幔条件下davemaoite中有限的水掺入

summary_bullets.research_question: 下地幔矿物davemaoite能容纳多少水及其在深部水储库中的作用？
summary_bullets.methodology: 采用多面砧压机在干湿条件下原位测量晶格体积，条件达30 GPa和2100 K。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 水化仅引起微小体积缩减，表明水掺入限于痕量，非先前认为的大量。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次通过干湿条件下原位体积测量突破实验限制，否定davemaoite高水溶性假说。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 揭示俯冲洋壳中含水硅相可能是深下地幔主要水储库，影响全球水循环模型。

works.title: Late Paleoproterozoic polymetamorphism in the north Yinshan Block, North China Craton and its tectonic implications
works.abstract: Forearc extension can result in low-P/T type metamorphism, but only a few such metamorphic belts are reported from modern and ancient arcs, and no reports are from early Precambrian terranes. The Yinshan Block (YB) in the northwestern North China Craton (NCC) experienced complicated Paleoproterozoic magmatism and metamorphism, but its tectonic evolution is inadequately constrained from a detailed metamorphic perspective. This study systematically investigates pelitic migmatites from a newly-identified Hadatu suite in the north YB for constraining the metamorphic and tectonic evolution. Two phases of metamorphism (M-I and −II) are recognized. M-I is the upper-amphibolite to granulite facies of the low-P/T type (31–32 °C/km) dominated by post-peak cooling evolution. M-II is the greenschist facies overprinting of the medium-P/T type (24–25 °C/km) characterized by a clockwise P–T path. Zircon and monazite U–Pb dating suggests that the two phases of metamorphism occurred in 1.92–1.91 Ga and 1.88–1.86 Ga, and the Hadatu suite was deposited during 1.96–1.92 Ga. The M-I metamorphism might correlate forearc extension as a result of slab rollback and mantle upwelling, and appears to be one of the early Precambrian forearc metamorphic records. The M-II metamorphism was ascribed to a collision orogeny in the north NCC. We propose that the early Precambrian tectonic evolution of the YB and also its adjacent Khondalite Belt involves five stages: the Neoarchean cratonization at ∼2.5 Ga, early Paleoproterozoic extension during 2.46–2.30 Ga and 2.22–2.00 Ga, the first-phase collision during 2.0–1.95 Ga, oceanic subduction during 1.96–1.88 Ga, and the second-phase collision event during 1.88–1.86 Ga.

works.translated_title: 华北克拉通阴山地块北部古元古代晚期多期变质作用及其构造意义

summary_bullets.research_question: 本研究旨在从变质作用角度约束阴山地块古元古代构造演化，揭示其多期变质事件与构造体制。
summary_bullets.methodology: 采用泥质混合岩的岩相学、P-T视剖、锆石及独居石U-Pb年代学系统分析。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 识别出1.92–1.91Ga低P/T型和1.88–1.86Ga中P/T型两期变质，提出五阶段构造演化。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次在早前寒武纪地体中识别出弧前伸展导致的低P/T变质带记录。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为早前寒武纪俯冲带变质作用及华北克拉通西北部构造演化提供关键约束。

works.title: Quantifying Melting Reactions in Granitic Veins in Eclogite Exhumed From Ultrahigh‐Pressure
works.abstract: ABSTRACT Recent studies have suggested various mechanisms to generate melt during exhumation of deeply subducted crust, including dehydroxylation of omphacite, fluid‐absent omphacite‐ and/or phengite‐breakdown melting and fluid‐present melting. However, the space–time relationships among these mechanisms remain uncertain. Here, we report microstructural evidence of the reactions responsible for, and compositions of, low‐volume melts frozen in situ (as leucosome pockets) within weakly deformed granitic veins that cross‐cut foliated UHP eclogite boudins in gneisses from the central Sulu belt, China. Phengite in the granitic veins records crystallization pressures of 3.4–2.7 GPa, and the granitic veins have whole‐rock Sr–Nd isotope compositions and trace element patterns consistent with derivation from the eclogite. The granitic veins likely crystallized from a solute‐rich supercritical fluid or hydrous melt generated by dehydroxylation of nominally anhydrous minerals during the early stage of exhumation (decompression). Subsequently, leucosome pockets and grain‐boundary films of melt formed in the granitic veins by the successive breakdown of omphacite and phengite. Based on the mineral modes and chemical compositions of 55 leucosome pockets (cf. microgranitoids), we distinguish those with (1) high Na/K ratios mainly composed of plagioclase and euhedral amphibole with skeletal omphacite and (2) low Na/K ratios predominantly composed of K‐feldspar and plagioclase and which contain phengite with corroded margins and fine‐grained biotite. High Na/K leucosome pockets (HLPs) are consistent with a melting reaction involving mostly omphacite‐breakdown, whereas low Na/K leucosome pockets (LLPs) are inferred to have formed by a reaction consuming variable proportions of phengite and omphacite. We argue that the reactions to form HHP then LLP initiated at approximately 1.5 and 1.1 GPa, respectively, and document two different mechanisms to generate melt during exhumation of deeply subducted crust in which breakdown of omphacite occurs before (deeper than) phengite. At higher temperatures, these melt‐producing reactions would generate a larger volume of melt that potentially could facilitate exhumation and increase crust–mantle interactions, thereby increasing the compositional heterogeneity of orogenic mantle.
works.label: must_read
works.translated_title: 超高压折返榴辉岩中花岗质脉体熔融反应的定量研究

summary_bullets.research_question: 深俯冲地壳折返过程中不同熔体生成机制（脱水、缺水熔融、有水熔融）的时空关系为何？
summary_bullets.methodology: 分析花岗岩脉内的冻结熔体（淡色体囊）微观结构、矿物压力计、全岩Sr-Nd同位素和微量元素。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 早期脱水产生超临界流体，随后绿辉石（~1.5 GPa）和多硅白云母（~1.1 GPa）依次分解形成高、低Na/K熔体。
summary_bullets.innovation: 定量区分绿辉石先于多硅白云母分解的两阶段减压熔融反应及其压力条件。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 揭示折返过程中熔体生成序列，有助于理解壳幔相互作用和造山带地幔成分不均一性。

works.title: Amphibole enrichment weakens the mid- to lower crust of southern Tibet
works.abstract: A weak mid- to lower crust is commonly invoked to explain uplift, lateral flow, and lithospheric removal beneath southern Tibet, yet its origin remains unresolved. Because present-day geotherms are generally too cool for widespread melt weakening, we tested whether precollisional arc magmatism produced a hydrous mineralogical inheritance that weakened the mid- to lower crust. Coupled phase-equilibrium modeling and experimentally calibrated flow laws show that geologically plausible bulk H2O contents of 1.0−1.5 wt% stabilize amphibole-rich assemblages containing 50−65 vol% amphibole at depths of 30−60 km. This hydration-driven transformation from dry granulitic assemblages to amphibole-rich amphibolite lowers viscosity by up to two orders of magnitude and produces slightly buoyant crust, with predicted viscosities overlapping geodetically inferred values for ductile flow beneath southern Tibet. Below ∼60 km, amphibole breakdown produces garnet- and clinopyroxene-rich assemblages, increasing density and promoting eclogitization and possible delamination. We propose that inherited amphibole enrichment created a weak mid- to lower crust, whereas subsequent amphibole breakdown localized the transition to dense, gravitationally unstable lowermost crust.
works.label: consider
works.translated_title: 角闪石富集弱化藏南中下地壳

summary_bullets.research_question: 为何藏南中下地壳在现今地温较低的情况下仍表现为弱流变层？
summary_bullets.methodology: 通过相平衡模拟结合实验标定的流变律，计算不同水含量下的矿物组合与粘度。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 1.0−1.5 wt%的水稳定了含50−65%角闪石的组合，使粘度降低达两个数量级。
summary_bullets.innovation: 提出碰撞前弧岩浆作用遗留的含水角闪石富集是造成中下地壳弱化的新机制。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为理解藏南壳内韧性流变、隆升和拆沉提供了矿物学与流变学基础。

works.title: Origin, Tectonic Processes, and Metasomatism of Serpentinite in the Shimanto Accretionary Complex, SW Japan: Possible Diapiric Intrusion of Serpentinized Oceanic Lithosphere
works.abstract: Abstract Serpentinite plays a major role in the geodynamics of subduction zones. However, the processes by which serpentinite is incorporated into accretionary complexes, and the extent to which it interacts chemically and physically with accretionary lithologies, remain unclear. To address these issues, we conducted geological, geochemical, and Raman spectroscopic analyses of the Nakaguro Serpentinite in SW Japan. This serpentinite was incorporated into the Cretaceous Shimanto Accretionary Complex (AC) that subducted to depths corresponding to the pumpellyite–actinolite metamorphic facies. The Nakaguro Serpentinite crosscuts and penetrates the block‐in‐matrix structures typical of the Shimanto AC. The serpentinite consists of lizardite and Cr‐spinel with Cr/(Cr + Al) 2 ‐ and CO 2 ‐dominated metasomatism occurred along the contact between the serpentinite and the lithologies of the Shimanto AC. However, mass balance calculations indicate that the degree of metasomatism cannot be explained by simple mass transfer. Instead, metasomatism involved the influx of silica‐ and carbon‐bearing external fluids, resulting in mass and volume gains. Structural analysis of the vein network indicates that metasomatism occurred in a reverse‐faulting stress state that was regulated by steady‐state stress along the plate boundary. We hypothesize that the Nakaguro Serpentinite derived from serpentinized oceanic lithosphere ascended diapirically into the overlying accretionary complex. One possible pathway for this ascent was along outer‐rise faults developed in the subducting oceanic plate. Our working model provides new insights into the fluid‐mediated metasomatism and the transfer of serpentinites across the plate boundary at depths shallower than the forearc mantle wedge.

works.title: Mercury isotopes trace (meta-)sedimentary melting in pegmatite lithium mineralization in the Eastern Songpan-Ganzi Belt, China
works.abstract: Lithium-rich pegmatites represent a critical source of lithium, yet the roles of source nature in the large-scale lithium enrichment during their petrogenesis remain unclear. Mercury (Hg) isotopes, with their multidimensional tracing capability, offer unique advantages in identifying source characteristics and revealing the processes of exceptional elemental enrichment. In this study, we analyzed the Hg isotope compositions of ore-related S-type two-mica granites and their derived pegmatites, as well as regional unmineralized I-type quartz diorites and metasedimentary rocks from the eastern Songpan-Ganzi lithium belt, to constrain the nature of their source. Our study reveals that the two-mica granites and their associated pegmatites, both Li-mineralized and barren, display consistently negative δ202Hg (−0.64 ± 0.49‰, 1SD, n = 34) and Δ199Hg (−0.09 ± 0.07‰, 1SD, n = 34) values. These Hg isotopic fingerprints closely match those of the regional Xikang and Bayan Har metasedimentary rocks (δ202Hg: −1.19 ± 0.69‰; Δ199Hg: −0.08 ± 0.12‰, 1SD, n = 10) and global terrestrial sediments, indicating a continental (meta-)sedimentary source for the parental magma. In contrast, the quartz diorite displays negative δ202Hg values (−0.86 ± 0.39‰, 1SD, n = 6) but near-zero Δ199Hg values (0.02 ± 0.05‰, 1SD, n = 6), indicating negligible recycling of Hg in its magma source, which is inferred to be mantle-derived juvenile crustal components. Based on these observations, we propose that post-orogenic crustal thinning triggered partial melting of (meta-)sedimentary sequences, facilitating the initial enrichment of the highly incompatible element Li. Consequently, we infer that the widespread formation of pegmatite-type lithium deposits was predominantly governed by large-scale melting of continental (meta-)sedimentary sequences.

works.title: Genesis of the Lijiahe banded carbonatite intrusion and associated iron mineralization, northwestern Yangtze Block, South China
works.abstract: Banded carbonatites commonly show a rhythmic alternation between calcite and magnetite layers, the latter often containing significant iron oxide (magnetite) mineralization. However, the petrogenesis of banded carbonatites and the mechanism responsible for iron mineralization remain poorly understood. In this study, we present detailed petrographic observations as well as mineralogical and geochemical data for the Lijiahe banded carbonatites in the northwestern Yangtze Block, central China. The banded carbonatites outcrop as small-scale stocks and dikes in the field, and they can be subdivided into three distinct types of layers: a calcite-rich layer, a mixed layer, and a magnetite-rich layer. Each layer consists of varying proportions of magnetite, calcite, and apatite, with minor amounts of olivine, phlogopite, and Nb-rich minerals. Apatite U-Pb dating results reveal that the Lijiahe banded carbonatites were formed at 778 ± 24 Ma. Three layers in the Lijiahe carbonatites all have identical Sr and Nd isotopic compositions [(87Sr/86Sr)i = 0.7039−0.7048; εNd(t) = +1.5 to +3.4], similar to the regional arc-related mafic rocks, suggesting derivation from a lithospheric mantle enriched by slab-derived materials. Both calcite and whole-rock compositions for the Lijiahe carbonatites are characterized by flat rare earth element (REE) patterns and low (La/Yb)N ratios (4.74−6.79 and 5.54−14.1, respectively), which is in stark contrast to global primary carbonatites and calcite. These distinctive flat light REE patterns may require magma generation from a garnet-poor, heavy REE−rich carbonated mantle source. Exhibiting distinct mineral assemblages and characteristic magmatic textures, the magnetite-rich layer has higher TFe2O3, Co, high field strength element (HFSE), Sn, and Zn contents but lower CaO, Sr, Ba, and REE contents than the mixed layer and the calcite-rich layer. Elevated δ13C (−0.6‰ to 0‰) and δ18O (17.6‰ to 18.4‰) values, combined with alkali depletion and replacement textures, record a late-stage carbo(hydro)thermal overprint. We propose that primary Fe oxide accumulation was predominantly governed by early magmatic processes, probably involving liquid immiscibility or density-driven mineral sorting. Subsequently, fluid-assisted metasomatism further enhanced enrichment in Fe and HFSEs (notably Nb) within the layered sequence.

works.title: Lateral Coastal Blue Carbon Export Fuels a Deep‐Ocean Carbon Sink in an Oligotrophic Warm Pool
works.abstract: Abstract Coastal blue carbon (CBC) ecosystems export organic matter offshore, but their contribution to deep‐ocean carbon sequestration remains insufficiently quantified. We measured depth‐resolved particulate organic carbon (POC) fluxes, δ 13 C signatures, and environmental DNA (eDNA) from sediment traps deployed at 150, 500, and 1,000 m in the western North Pacific warm pool. POC fluxes at 1,000 m were two‐ to four‐fold higher than predicted by classical attenuation models, indicating efficient deep‐water transfer driven by both vertical export and lateral inputs. eDNA from sinking particles revealed macroalgae, mangrove, and seagrass taxa throughout the mesopelagic and bathypelagic layers, demonstrating long‐distance transport of CBC material. δ 13 C values showed predominantly marine‐derived POC, but with measurable CBC contributions persisting at depth. These observations identify a previously underappreciated pathway linking coastal vegetation to deep‐ocean carbon storage in oligotrophic gyre systems. They also highlight the need for ground‐truth biological carbon pump (BCP) measurements, particularly for oceanic island countries with small land areas yet large exclusive economic zones (EEZs), where accurate carbon accounting depends on in situ validation of model‐based estimates.

works.title: Revisiting the oxidant budget of the DOUNCE event
works.abstract: Abstract The Shuram/DOUNCE event, the largest negative carbonate carbon isotope excursion in Earth’s history, has been linked to global ocean oxygenation and early animal evolution. While this anomaly is often attributed to dissolved organic carbon oxidation, the feasibility of this hypothesis remains debated due to uncertain oxidant supply. Here, we construct a refined global seawater δ 13 C curve for the event using an extensive carbonate δ 13 C database and published geochronological constraints. Applying an inverse approach within an Earth Evolution Model, we reassess the dissolved organic carbon oxidation timeline and oxidant demand. Our results show that oxidizing ~9×10 19 mol of dissolved organic carbon could account for the negative δ 13 C excursion, but cessation of oxidation alone cannot explain the rapid recovery, which requires enhanced productivity. These findings support continental sulfate as the major, sufficient oxidant source, while suggesting that a later period of enhanced productivity drove the rapid δ 13 C rebound.

works.title: Recent active rifting on Venus revealed by wide rift flank uplifts
works.abstract: Abstract Rifts are prominent tectonic features on Venus, yet their formation, evolution and tectonic activity remain debatable. Here we conducted 3D numerical thermomechanical experiments with visco-elasto-plastic compressible rock rheology to systematically investigate the rifting dynamics and topography under Venusian conditions. To compare active and inactive rift morphologies, the relaxation of rift topography after extension ceases was also investigated. Our modelling results suggest a relatively thick thermal lithosphere and a strong crust with dry diabase or mafic granulite rheology in rifted regions and demonstrate that wide rift flank uplifts strongly indicate either presently ongoing Venusian rifting or activity within the past few tens of millions of years. The rift valleys in the Ganis, Dali and Devana Chasmata have wide rift flank uplifts, and their characteristic topographic features are comparable to the modelled early-stage active rifts undergoing relatively high extension rates of 3−10 cm yr −1 . This suggests that the Venus rifts in these regions are still active or were active very recently. Their morphology also indicates faster extension rates than commonly assumed for Venusian rifting, potentially associated with recent vigorous mantle plume activity.

works.title: Rapid accretion of enstatite chondrite (EH)-like embryos as impactors for the proto-Earth
works.abstract: Enstatite chondrites-like impactors are proposed as key contributors to the proto-Earth and are believed to have undergone differentiation. However, this differentiation remains enigmatic: their small size precludes gravity-driven permeable flow, and enstatite exhibits a high melting temperature. Here, we report high-pressure melting experiments on EH3 chondrite, coupled with three-dimensional X-ray computed tomography, showing that more than 20% of silicate partial melting can enable efficient metal segregation. Thermodynamic simulations of EH chondrite-like embryos thermal evolution further demonstrate that heat from radioactive decay allows core formation only if embryos accreted within 1.4 Myr post-CAIs. In contrast, EH chondrite parent bodies formed later (1.92–2.0 Myr post-CAIs) with radii of 110–190 km. Our findings suggest two distinct evolutionary trajectories of EH chondrite-like embryos, providing constraints on core formation in small planetary embryos and fundamental references for the formation of planets in the early solar system. Enstatite chondrite-like embryos and enstatite chondrite parent bodies accreted very early and followed two distinct evolutionary trajectories, according to high-pressure melting experiments and thermodynamic simulations

works.title: Thermogenic methane beneath the North Greenland Ice Sheet revealed by isotopic and geological evidence
works.abstract: Abstract Glacial meltwater has been increasingly recognised as a potential source of atmospheric methane, yet its origin and variability in the High Arctic remain poorly constrained. In this study, we present measurements of methane concentration and carbon‑isotope composition in meltwater draining the northern Greenland Ice Sheet. Here we show that methane concentrations (12-20 nM) are significantly lower than those reported from other Greenland catchments, despite clear evidence of subglacial input. Isotopic signatures and regional geological context indicate that this methane is predominantly thermogenic, reflecting a geological source that is largely independent of subglacial microbial activity. These findings advance current understanding of methane sources beneath the Greenland Ice Sheet, revealing a thermogenic contribution alongside microbial methane in Arctic methane cycling. In this work we highlight the need to account for geological methane reservoirs when assessing present and future cryosphere–carbon feedbacks.

works.title: Transcrustal magma ascent beneath Laguna del Maule, Chile
works.abstract: Abstract Arc volcanoes are fed by complex networks of storage zones that extend throughout the crust. Though the geometric details of these transcrustal magmatic systems are well resolved beneath several volcanic settings, the relationship between magma transport at depth and volcanic unrest at the surface remains poorly understood. At Laguna del Maule in central Chile, we show that seismically imaged magma reservoirs in the upper and lower crust are connected by a zone of deep crustal seismicity. A pronounced one-day seismic swarm in 2018 was followed approximately 3 months later by an increase in surface uplift rate. We infer that this swarm was driven by the injection of new melt, transported between lower to upper crust magma reservoirs. The lag time between melt transport and surface acceleration was perhaps governed by the hydraulic diffusivity within the upper crustal reservoir. These results indicate that volcanic unrest begins deep within the crust and months before observable signals of shallow reservoir pressurization.

works.title: From Cambrian subduction initiation to Carboniferous mantle plume−related DUPAL magmatism in the Paleo-Asian Ocean
works.abstract: Understanding subduction initiation and mantle plume dynamics is central to plate-tectonic evolution but remains poorly constrained in ancient orogens. The tectonic evolution of the North Tianshan paleo-ocean basin, a key segment of the Paleo-Asian Ocean of the Altaids, has long been debated owing to the scarcity of diagnostic ophiolitic records. Here we present a systematic study of the Bayingou ophiolite that identifies two temporally and genetically distinct magmatic suites: a forearc-type ophiolitic assemblage (cumulate gabbro, gabbro, and plagiogranite; Group 1) and plume-related seamount basalts (Group 2). Zircon U-Pb geochronology indicates that Group 1 cumulate gabbro crystallized in the middle Cambrian (ca. 505 Ma), whereas Group 1 gabbro and plagiogranite record Early Carboniferous magmatism (ca. 345−330 Ma), implying episodic forearc magmatic activity. Group 1 rocks display major and trace element patterns and depleted Sr-Nd-Hf isotopic compositions comparable to those of typical Izu−Bonin−Mariana forearc basalts, while their Pb isotopes overlap Pacific mid-oceanic-ridge basalt (MORB) and Paleo-Asian MORB-type ophiolites, indicating derivation from a Pacific-type low-Th/U depleted mantle. Thermobarometric modeling suggests shallow (<8 kbar) and high-temperature (∼1156 °C) decompression melting of upwelling asthenosphere, consistent with extension-induced asthenospheric ascent in forearc settings. In contrast, Group 2 basalts are enriched in Nb, Ta, Ti, and light rare earth elements [(La/Yb)N = 4.6−6.6] and exhibit a pronounced DUPAL anomaly (first documented by Dupré and Allègre, 1983), indicating an enriched, plume-related deep-mantle source analogous to global hotspots (e.g., Hawaii, USA, North Pacific Ocean, and St. Helena, South Atlantic Ocean). Integrating these results with regional geology, we infer early Cambrian forearc development linked to subduction initiation, followed by sustained intra-oceanic subduction beneath the Yili−Central Tianshan block from the Early Carboniferous (ca. 345−265 Ma), accompanied by supra-subduction zone−type ophiolite formation. Widespread plume-related seamount volcanism produced composite oceanic lithosphere that later accreted into the orogenic complex. This study provides crucial constraints on forearc magmatism and plume activity, serving as a vital analogue for tectonic evolution in ancient orogenic systems.

works.title: Punctuated garnet growth within a protracted zircon record distinguishes reaction dates from residence times in North Qaidam eclogites
works.abstract: Constraining the duration of (ultra)high-pressure metamorphism is central to quantifying rates of continental subduction and exhumation, yet the answer depends on which mineral is dated. Zircon U-Pb date spectra are routinely read as residence times, but zircon may grow, dissolve, and recrystallize across many stages of a pressure–temperature path, whereas garnet records the discrete reactions that produced it. We combine microsampled garnet Lu-Hf and Sm-Nd geochronology, zircon U-Pb dating, trace-element systematics, phase-equilibrium modeling, and a quantitative modal rare-earth-element (REE) budget for eclogites from the Dulan area of the North Qaidam terrane. Garnet core and rim fractions from three samples yield indistinguishable Lu-Hf dates ranging from 439.1 ± 1.8 to 442.5 ± 1.9 Ma, recording garnet growth within analytical resolution at ∼2.6–3.0 GPa and 660–720 °C. Pseudosection modeling links this garnet growth to a single overstepped dehydration reaction releasing ∼1.6 wt% water. Zircon dates, by contrast, span ca. 484–427 Ma, and zircon trace-element and Ti-in-zircon systematics evolve systematically through this interval, indicating growth and modification across multiple stages rather than continuous eclogite-facies residence. Modal REE budget calculations show that flat heavy-REE patterns are non-unique, as retrograde amphibole and epidote or zoisite can reproduce an eclogite-like signature. These results demonstrate that garnet and zircon monitor fundamentally distinct processes: a discrete reaction pulse versus an integrated history. Their divergence, not their agreement, is diagnostic of metamorphic evolution. Comparison with other large (U)HP terranes shows that apparent multi-million-year “protracted” (U)HP spectra can readily emerge from short, single-rock garnet pulses combined with diachronous burial and exhumation of tectonic slices. Accessory-mineral-only chronologies may therefore conflate distinct reactions with prolonged residence. Mineral dates in (U)HP terranes must first be read as reaction dates, using growth-pulse geochronology, zircon compositional and thermometric trends, and modal REE budgets, before they can be converted into residence-time estimates.

summary_bullets.methodology: 结合微区石榴石Lu-Hf/Sm-Nd定年、锆石U-Pb定年、微量元素、相平衡模拟和全岩稀土配分计算。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 石榴石记录了一次约440 Ma的短暂生长脉冲，而锆石跨度484–427 Ma反映多阶段演化。
summary_bullets.innovation: 石榴石与锆石的年龄分歧而非一致才是变质过程诊断特征，前者记录反应脉冲，后者记录综合历史。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 警示不可直接将锆石年龄谱解读为滞留时间，须通过生长脉冲定年等方法先区分反应年龄。

works.title: Differential stress regime as a control on economic antimony deposition in epizonal orogenic gold systems
works.abstract: Epizonal orogenic gold systems in shallow metamorphic belts commonly exhibit contrasting styles of antimony (Sb)-rich and Sb-poor mineralization, yet the controlling factors remain debated. Here, we integrate vein classifications with fluid inclusion microthermometry and oxygen isotope data from the giant Zaozigou Au-Sb deposit (West Qinling, China) to constrain the pressure-temperature (P-T) conditions and fluid evolution. Our results demonstrate that differential stress (σ1 − σ3) governs the spatial segregation of Sb-rich and Sb-poor mineralization through its control on failure modes and fluid processes. Two distinct orebody types are identified: (1) steeply dipping Au orebodies (60°−90°) with subeconomic Sb grades (<1 wt%), hosted in shear fractures and dominated by disseminated arsenopyrite and pyrite with invisible Au; and (2) gently dipping Au-Sb orebodies (19°−45°) with high Sb grades (average 5 wt%), characterized by native gold-bearing stibnite-quartz veins in extension fractures. Fluid inclusion data reveal that steeply dipping orebodies formed under stable P-T conditions (∼0.8 kbar, ∼250 °C), whereas gently dipping orebodies experienced significant decompression (∼1.1 kbar to ∼0.4 kbar) and cooling (∼250 °C to ∼190 °C). Our comprehensive analysis demonstrates that steeply dipping orebodies formed through shear failure of intact rock under high differential stress conditions (σ1 − σ3 ≥ 5.7T) and subsequent fault reactivation under decreased differential stress conditions related to seismic stress release, with gold precipitation dominated by fluid-rock interaction. In contrast, gently dipping orebodies developed in intact rock under low differential stress (σ1 − σ3 < 4T), where fluid immiscibility triggered H2S degassing and rapid Au-Sb deposition. The mechanical relationships observed at Zaozigou may provide new insights into the enrichment of Sb in shallow epizonal orogenic gold deposits. The systematic decrease of differential stress with reduced depth in brittle regimes creates conditions favorable for Sb mineralization at upper crustal levels, where lower stress environments promote extensional failure and the substantial pressure fluctuations required for efficient Sb deposition. This stress-based framework offers a potential explanation for the characteristic vertical zoning of Sb in orogenic systems, complementing existing genetic models.

summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为理解浅成造山金系统的锑垂向分带提供了基于应力状态的新机制，补充现有模型。

works.title: Metasomatism of zircon by alkali-bearing fluids during deposition of Au deposits
works.abstract: Zircon, typically resistant to hydrothermal alteration, can be significantly modified in fluid-active systems via coupled dissolution–reprecipitation, especially in alkali-rich environments. This study investigates zircon metasomatism by potassic fluids during Au mineralization in the Jiaodong Peninsula, China. Natural potassic altered zircons from the Jiaojia Au deposit (PA-1) show CL-dark zones with thorite/xenotime inclusions, confirming fluid-driven coupled dissolution–reprecipitation. Natural Linglong granite zircons were experimentally altered using KOH-bearing fluids (2 M and 4 M) at 600 °C and 200 MPa (ZM-5) or 1000 MPa (ZM-14) to simulate natural potassic alteration. SEM and CL imaging revealed distinct textures: ZM-14 formed inward-convex fronts and overgrowths, while ZM-5 developed porous, jagged rims. LA-ICP-MS mapping shows systematic trace-element redistribution: altered rims in both natural and experimental zircons are depleted in U (7078–2930 ppm) and Th (764–247 ppm), with cores enriched in Hf (19,344 ppm), Y (5308 ppm), and ΣREE (3841 ppm). Th/U ratios (0.16–0.54) and elevated Yb/Gd (12.9–24.9) indicate K+-mediated fractionation. Experimental overgrowths lack inclusions (vs. PA-1), suggesting kinetic limitations from Th availability or reaction duration. These findings demonstrate that potassic fluids drive zircon alteration through coupled dissolution–reprecipitation, redistributing trace elements and forming diagnostic textures. The consistency between experiments and natural systems highlights zircon's potential as an archive of fluid–rock interactions, advancing models of alkali-fluid dynamics during Au ore formation.

summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为利用锆石追溯金成矿过程及碱质流体-岩石相互作用提供了新指标和机制模型。

works.title: Tectonic controls and redox dynamics: A comprehensive review of sedimentary manganese mineralization in the Devonian-Triassic Youjiang Basin, South China
works.abstract: The Youjiang Basin in South China, a part of the Paleo-Tethys Ocean, hosts significant carbonate-hosted sedimentary manganese (Mn) resources, characterized by stratigraphically confined, intense, and episodic mineralization from the Devonian to Triassic, linked closely to palaeogeographic evolution of the basin driven by episodic tectonic events. This review synthesizes the palaeogeographic evolution of the Youjiang Basin, the spatiotemporal distribution as well as the mineralogical, sedimentological, geochemical, and geochronological constraints on Youjiang Mn deposits, gaining several key insights: (1) Basin tectonics, driven by rifting, subduction, and back-arc volcanisms, formed fault-segmented basin-platform systems, regulating Mn supply, redox-stratified water columns, and sediment-starved depositional settings; (2) Mn mineralization occurred episodically, with Devonian–Early Carboniferous deposits forming in deep-water, low-clastic-input settings through redoxcline-controlled sequestration of Mn(III/IV) (oxyhydr)oxide precursors and their reduction to Mn-rich carbonates by organic matter during the diagenesis stage, whereas Permian-Triassic deposits reflect stratigraphically persistent Mn-enriched layers influenced by glacio-eustatic cycles, post-extinction redox instability, and low dilution; (3) Hydrothermal fluids and syndepositional faulting were primary Mn sources, with Mn(II) accumulating in anoxic deep waters and/or pore waters and being fixed near redoxcline conditions through microbial and redox-mediated oxidation processes; (4) Organic matter participation and microbially mediated diagenesis jointly facilitated stable Mn carbonate precipitation under high-alkalinity marine conditions. We hereby establish a comprehensive genetic metallogenic model, highlighting dynamic couplings among tectonically controlled Mn supply, stratified redox conditions, sea-level-driven redoxcline migration, microbial Mn cycling, and early diagenetic carbonate fixation, with mineralization occurring during periods of enhanced Mn flux, sustained stratification, efficient Mn sequestration, and low dilution. This review synthesis advances fundamental cognition of sedimentary manganese metallogeny and supports sustainable exploration and exploitation of Mn resources in the Youjiang Basin.

summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为右江盆地及类似背景的碳酸盐岩容矿锰矿勘探与开发提供了理论支撑和寻找新靶区的科学依据。

works.title:
Mineralization Mechanism of the Miaolong Gold Deposit,
                    <scp>SW</scp>
                    China: Constraints on Mineral Geochemistry and Sulfur Isotope of Pyrite, and Calcite Carbon–Oxygen Isotopes
works.abstract: ABSTRACT The Sandu–Danzhai Au‐Hg‐Sb metallogenic belt is an essential constituent of the giant Mesozoic low‐temperature metallogenic domain of the South China Craton. Although many sediment‐hosted Au‐Hg‐Sb deposits have been discovered in this belt over decades, possible sources of ore‐forming elements (e.g., Au‐As‐S) and fluids remain controversial. This study presents chemical compositions and S isotopes of pyrites and C‐O isotopes of calcites collected from the Miaolong deposit in the central belt. Based on their petrographic features and Au‐As compositions, three generations of pyrites are classified in the deposit: syngenetic/diagenetic Py1, pre‐ore Py2, and ore Py3. From Py1 (As 1%), the As, Au, and Cu concentrations increase gradually. This increase is greatest for As, indicating that As may be critical in the enrichment of Au and other trace elements. Au occurs in the form of lattice‐bound Au + , and the low Au/As ratios of the pyrite ( 34 S values (−21.65‰ to 34.97‰), consistent with a sedimentary origin. In contrast, Py2 and Py3 share similar and relatively homogeneous δ 34 S values (Py2 = 19.46‰–26.28‰, Py3 = 20.94‰–24.81‰). These positive δ 34 S values support an abiotic thermochemical sulfate reduction (TSR) of marine sulfate. As inferred from their C‐O isotopes (δ 18 O V‐SMOW = 15.11‰–24.43‰, δ 13 C V‐PDB = −3.95‰ to −1.52‰), the late‐ore calcite veins are likely derived from the dissolution and recrystallization of Cambrian marine limestone. In summary, a metamorphic model is proposed for Au mineralization in the Miaolong deposit, in which deep‐sourced metamorphic fluids from the Precambrian basement are essential in Au remobilization and deposition.

summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为华南低温成矿域卡林型金矿成矿物质来源和流体演化提供关键约束。

works.title: Melt Infiltration and Olivine Accumulation in Upwelling Mantle Recorded in Interlayered Spinel Peridotite, Plagioclase Lherzolite, and Mafic Rocks in the Horoman Peridotite Complex, Japan
works.abstract: Abstract Interlayered peridotites and mafic rocks in orogenic peridotite bodies provide evidence for melt–mantle interactions. A 1.2 m-thick interlayered spinel peridotite, plagioclase lherzolite, and mafic rocks is studied in the Horoman peridotite complex, Japan. Major and trace elements compositions of whole-rock and minerals provide constraints on the mechanisms responsible for such interlayered structure. The spinel peridotite and the mafic rocks have the highest and lowest MgO contents, and have the lowest and highest incompatible element contents, respectively. The plagioclase lherzolite is characterized by millimeter-scale alternating laminae of plagioclase-free and plagioclase-clinopyroxene-bearing peridotite. Its composition is intermediate between that of spinel peridotite and mafic rocks. The whole-rock and mineral compositions of the mafic rocks indicate that they formed from N-MORB-like melts. A linear compositional trend of major elements except for FeO*, MnO, P2O5 and Cr on MgO variation diagrams indicate that various proportions of N-MORB-like melts were added to a massive peridotite to form each layer. The FeO* versus MgO diagram shows that the composition varies along iso-Mg# (100 × molar Mg/(Mg + Fe)) lines, which shows olivine crystallization from the injected melts in the open system. This olivine accumulation has been suggested to elucidate whole-rock FeO*–MgO variations in abyssal peridotite. At boundaries between spinel peridotite and mafic rocks, coarse clinopyroxene crystals exhibit Ti-enriched rims, which provides evidence of chemical disequilibrium during initial melt–mantle interaction. As mantle diapirs upwell beneath mid-oceanic ridges, they experience repeated injections of melts with variable volumes and react with them. Chemical gradation in mafic rock layers from boundaries against spinel peridotite is observed in Mg# of mafic minerals in a few cm-scale. Diffusive equilibration between the mafic rocks layer and the spinel peridotite with respect to Mg-Fe equilibrium can be achieved only in several mm-scale. The plagioclase lherzolite layers formed through such mm-scale equilibrium between the peridotite and the melts with respect to Mg-Fe exchange; in contrast, plagioclase and clinopyroxene components were not smeared out and the interlayered structure remained. The observed chemically interlayered structure in the Horoman peridotite records melt injection and subsequent olivine accumulation processes underneath a mid-oceanic ridge.

works.title: Global mapping and time-series analysis of orogens, cratons, and igneous zircon samples through time
works.abstract: Gaining a comprehensive grasp of global tectonic evolution over Earth’s history is a major challenge, mainly because the available data is fragmented and incomplete. This is due to quantifiable information being lost over time via ongoing processes such as erosion, subduction, recycling, overprinting, and exposure. In hopes of enhancing such understanding, the immediate goal is to identify as many preserved segments of the geological record as possible. Accordingly, we present global databases with the locations and ages of cratons, orogens, terranes, large igneous provinces, U-Pb-dated igneous zircon samples, and ophiolite samples. The new global databases also include details such as GPS coordinates of polygonal outlines for each craton, orogen, and terrane, along with the ages during which each was active. From these data, maps based on the current geography of the continents are constructed at 50-myr intervals, spanning the timeframe from 3500 Ma to present. By identifying and quantifying these key geological components, more comprehensive studies might be possible in future investigations. Additionally, from these databases time-series are analyzed for the interval 4100–0 Ma via cross-correlation and spectral analyses. Correlograms show that five time-series are synchronously aligned (within ± 5 Myr), with all periodograms showing statistically significant cycles of 270 ± 7 Myr, which we propose is the best estimate of the periodic opening and closing of ocean basins during a Wilson Cycle. This study also compares results from two other large global databases to assess the reproducibility of the ∼ 270 Myr periodicity.

summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为检验超大陆旋回和全球构造节律提供可重复的定量框架和关键周期估计。

works.title: The Pb-Bi-(Sb)-S sulphidic melts from the VMS Besshi-type Tisová deposit, Czech Republic: mineralogy, chemistry and implications of their formation
works.abstract: Abstract Two types of crystallised melt were identified as tiny, sharply bounded, ellipsoidal inclusions (typically 20–80 µm) in metamorphosed massive pyrrhotite ore (12–14 kbar, ~530–550 °C) from the VMS Besshi-type Tisová deposit. The Pb-Bi-S melt is more abundant than Pb-Bi-(Sb)-S melt. Many inclusions exhibit complex internal eutectic-like intergrowths with enclosing sulphides. Electron-backscatter diffraction revealed crystallographic continuity of pyrrhotite/chalcopyrite across the boundaries of the inclusions, indicating that the Fe-(Cu)-S sulphides enclosed within the blebs were formed by the replacement and recrystallisation of the host sulphides, rather than by the direct crystallisation of the melt. Micro-computed X-ray tomography confirmed the dominance and random distribution of smaller inclusions. It also showed a strong, unidirectional preferred orientation of the longest axis of the inclusions within the metamorphic foliation plane, which is consistent with their ductile deformation shortly after melt crystallisation. Larger and more irregular inclusions are often oriented at an acute angle to the foliation, suggesting their link to the onset of brittle deformation. The estimated bulk compositions of the Pb-Bi-S inclusions are shifted towards galena relative to the experimentally constrained melt fields. We interpret this as selective bismuth loss during a phase of enhanced late metamorphic fluid activity. Our observations support the formation of melts at or near peak metamorphic conditions during the climax of the Variscan orogeny, followed by fluid-related modification(s) during the post-orogenic uplift phase. Our results show that melts may represent an important mechanism for the redistribution of Bi, Pb, Sb during metamorphism of sulphide ores.

works.translated_title: 捷克Tisová Besshi型VMS矿床中的Pb-Bi-(Sb)-S硫化物熔体：矿物学、化学特征及其形成意义

summary_bullets.research_question: 本文研究变质硫化物矿石中 Pb-Bi-(Sb)-S 微晶熔体包裹体的成因及变质-流体改造过程。
summary_bullets.methodology: 利用电子背散射衍射、显微 X 射线计算机断层扫描、成分分析等表征两种熔体包裹体。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 熔体包裹体经韧性变形后受流体作用脱铋，内部硫化物为宿主交代重结晶而非直接结晶。
summary_bullets.innovation: 提出熔体结晶后变形及晚期流体选择性脱铋改造，而非简单冷却固化。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 揭示了熔体作为变质过程硫化物矿石中铋、铅、锑再分配的重要机制。

works.title: S- to I-type magmatic transition captures continental arc evolution in Central and South Pamir
works.abstract: Continental arcs are pivotal to crustal evolution, serving as primary sites for magma generation, crustal differentiation, and lithospheric materials recycling. However, the mechanisms driving magmatic type transitions within continental arcs remain debated. Here we investigate the geological evolution of the Pamir continental arc through zircon U-Pb dating and Hf-O isotopes and whole-rock elements and Sr-Nd isotopes for two-mica granites, biotite granites−granodiorites−diorites, and enclaves from Central and South Pamir. Our results demonstrate two distinct granitic suites (S- and I-type) with mafic enclaves recording two magmatic episodes, characterized by distinct spatial-temporal patterns. The S-type two-mica granites (122−108 Ma) in the Northern belt of Pamir represent initial Early Cretaceous arc magmatism. These two-mica granites show high SiO2 (69.7−79.5 wt%) contents and elevated (La/Yb)N ratios, with enriched isotopic compositions [87Sr/86Sri = 0.7078−0.7189, εNd(t) = −10.6 to −8.9] and variable zircon εHf(t) values (−11.3 to +4.9) and δ18O values (6.0‰−10.7‰). They formed through muscovite dehydration melting of the Central Pamir metasedimentary basement. The mafic enclaves in the two-mica granites display arc-type trace-element patterns and variable isotopic compositions [87Sr/86Sri = 0.7050−0.7091, εNd(t) = −7.2 to −0.9, and εHf(t) = −11.9 to +6.0]. They were derived from metasomatized subcontinental lithospheric mantle and mixed with the Central Pamir basement during magma ascent. The subsequent widespread I-type biotite granites−granodiorites−diorites across South Pamir mark both magmatic flare-up and maturation of the arc system. These biotite granites−granodiorites−diorites have variable SiO2 (59.9−71.2 wt%) contents and isotopes [87Sr/86Sri = 0.7063−0.7129, εNd(t) = −11.2 to −4.8, zircon εHf(t) = −16.8 to +7.8, and δ18O = 5.9‰−13.2‰]. These rocks were mainly produced by partial melting of the South Pamir metaigneous basement, followed by fractional crystallization of plagioclase, hornblende, and biotite, and mixing with minor mantle-derived depleted melts. Their mafic enclaves have similar Sr-Nd isotopic [87Sr/86Sri = 0.7086−0.7113, εNd(t) = −10.6 to −10.2] but distinct zircon Hf-O isotopic [εHf(t) = 4.4−9.9, δ18O = 6.2‰−7.3‰] compositions relative to host biotite granites−granodiorites, indicating a mixture of asthenospheric mantle and South Pamir basement. We propose that the basement differences between Central (metasedimentary) and South Pamir (metaigneous) resulted from the Neo-Tethys flat-slab subduction−induced sediment backarc thrusting. The tectonic transition from flat-slab subduction to slab foundering triggered asthenospheric upwelling coupled with metasediment depletion, driving magma source shifts from the Central Pamir metasedimentary rocks to South Pamir metaigneous rocks. The S- to I-type magmatic transition in the Pamir continental arc was controlled by synergistic effects of evolving crustal structure and tectonic regime reorganization and holds broader implications for understanding the evolution of global continental arcs.
