works.title: Serpentinization parageneses controlled by lithological variations among olivine gabbro and peridotite from the Atlantis Massif, Mid-Atlantic Ridge
works.abstract: Serpentinization of olivine impacts the geochemical and ecological environment via molecular hydrogen production, promoted by iron oxidation to form magnetite and ferric iron in serpentine. Previous studies suggested that serpentinization proceeds with various reactions and the extent of iron oxidation is variable depending on the reaction pathways. To examine the effect of lithological variation on reactions at an incipient stage of serpentinization, we carried out microscopic observations, electron probe analyses, and Raman spectroscopy of serpentine veins cutting olivine in gabbroic rocks and peridotites from the Atlantis Massif, Mid-Atlantic Ridge. The results indicate that the serpentine veins in the proximity of olivine dominantly comprise lizardite mixed with variable minor phases or components depending on igneous lithology: brucite in peridotites, troctolites, and primitive olivine gabbros; cronstedtite-bearing serpentine, commonly without brucite, in some troctolites and slightly evolved olivine gabbros; and neither brucite nor cronstedtite component in evolved olivine gabbros. This suggests that incipient-stage serpentinization paragenesis is dominantly controlled by silica activity reflecting lithological variation. In addition to magnetite, the formation of cronstedtite in gabbroic rocks has the potential to produce hydrogen. The presence or absence of brucite and cronstedtite could affect the timing and magnitude of iron oxidation and hydrogen production during serpentinization. Considering the predominance of gabbroic rocks in the lower oceanic crust, the variation in incipient-stage serpentinization paragenesis in gabbroic rocks may have an impact on the redox state and ecological environment around the (sub)seafloor.

works.title: Geochemical constraints on the Yangtze–Cathaysia block boundary from early paleozoic I-type granitoids across the Chenzhou–Linwu fault
works.abstract: Pre-existing sutures, as the fundamental lithospheric boundaries, potentially represent lithospheric weakened zones that are easily to be reactivated and transformed, playing a crucial role in the evolution of continental blocks. In the South China Block (SCB), the Neoproterozoic suture between the Yangtze and Cathaysia blocks is well defined in the northeast along the Jiangshan–Shaoxing–Pingxiang fault (JSPF). However, whether this suture extends southward to the Chenzhou–Linwu fault (CLF) remains controversial, limiting our understanding of the tectonic evolution of the SCB. Thus, we present zircon UPb ages and HfO isotopic data, together with whole-rock geochemistry and SrNd isotopic data, for the Shangbao and Guidong granitoids located east of the CLF and the Daning granitoids situated to the west, respectively. Zircon UPb ages indicate that the studied granitoids were emplaced at ca. 443–435 Ma. All granitoids are I-type granitoids derived from the partial melting of ancient igneous basement. The high Y + Nb contents (144–593 ppm) of these granitoids, a planar distribution of Early Paleozoic granites in the SCB, and the absence of subduction-related records collectively support an intracontinental orogen for the Wuyi-Yunkai orogen (WYO). Furthermore, the Shangbao and Guidong granitoids, together with western Cathaysia I-type granitoids, exhibit lower Pb, Th, and U concentrations, and more negative εNd(t) and εHf(t) values than the Daning granitoids and eastern Yangtze I-type granitoids. This highlights a compositional contrast in crustal basements between the eastern and western segments of the CLF, characterized by minimal juvenile input in the former and a juvenile materials-modified basement in the latter. These findings suggest that the boundary between the Yangtze and Cathaysia blocks extends southward to the CLF, providing insights into the orogenic processes of the WYO, and the role of weak lithospheric boundaries in controlling asthenospheric upwelling and emplacement of mantle-derived magmas.

works.title: Organic matter enrichment dynamics in North China Block: Implications for carbon cycle perturbations during the late Paleozoic Ice Age deglaciation
works.abstract: The mechanisms governing carbon cycle feedbacks during the demise of the Late Paleozoic Ice Age (LPIA) remain poorly constrained, particularly the role of regional carbon sinks transitioning to sources. The North China Block (NCB), once a major late Paleozoic carbon sink, experienced a dramatic decline in carbon sequestration during the Sakmarian–Artinskian, coincident with global deglaciation. However, the drivers of this regional shift and its potential contribution to the LPIA termination are poorly constrained. To address this, an integrated petrological, sedimentological, and geochemical study was conducted on mudstones from the Dacheng coalfield, Hebei Province, establishing an organic matter (OM) enrichment model for the coastal plain to alluvial plain transition. Results indicate that Sakmarian coastal plain mudstones, deposited under warm-humid conditions with enhanced nutrient supply and suboxic-anoxic waters, host higher OM. In contrast, Artinskian alluvial plain deposits, influenced by climatic aridification, reduced nutrient flux, and suboxic conditions, contain significantly lower OM, highlighting paleoclimate as the primary control. Based on comprehensive NCB borehole data, organic carbon (OC) burial amounts were quantified, revealing a drastic decline from 4053.5 Gt C (1185.2 Gt C/Myr) in the Sakmarian to 1876.2 Gt C (275.9 Gt C/Myr) in the Artinskian. This represents a net reduction of 2177.3 Gt C in organic carbon burial from the Sakmarian to the Artinskian. We propose that this large-scale regional decline in carbon burial from the NCB acted as a significant positive feedback, exacerbating early Artinskian warming. The termination of the LPIA was therefore driven by a synergy of processes, where the collapse of the NCB carbon sink, coupled with global volcanic emissions and reduced weathering, collectively forced the climate system past a critical threshold, ending Earth’s longest-lived Phanerozoic icehouse.

works.title: Petrogenesis of ∼1.96 Ga Mafic–Intermediate Intrusions in the Daqingshan Area: Constraints on the Tectonic Evolution of the Khondalite Belt, North China Craton
works.abstract: The Khondalite Belt (KB) is a Paleoproterozoic collisional orogen within the North China Craton (NCC), but its pre-collisional tectonic evolution remains poorly constrained. In this study, we conducted integrated geochronological, in-situ Hf isotopic, and whole-rock geochemical analyses of the mafic–intermediate intrusions exposed in the Daqingshan area in the central segment of the KB to determine their formation ages, petrogenesis, and tectonic setting, thereby further constraining the late Paleoproterozoic tectonic evolution of the KB. Zircon U-Pb dating results show that these rocks crystallized at ∼1.97–1.96 Ga and subsequently underwent metamorphism at ∼1.94–1.92 Ga. These rocks are enriched in light rare earth elements and depleted in high field strength elements, exhibiting geochemical affinities comparable to those of continental margin arc basalts and island arc basalts. In-situ zircon Hf isotopic analyses yield positive εHf(t) values. The available data suggest that the mafic–intermediate intrusions were derived from a hybrid mantle source dominated by asthenospheric mantle and metasomatized by fluids derived from a subducted slab and experienced fractional crystallization of olivine, clinopyroxene, Fe-Ti oxides and apatite. Overall, these findings suggest that the KB was in a subduction-related tectonic setting at ∼1.97–1.96 Ga. Subsequent continent–continent collision at ∼1.95 Ga resulted in metamorphism of both the magmatic rocks and the Khondalite Series at ∼1.94–1.92 Ga.

works.title: Metallogeny of the Mesoproterozoic Belt-Purcell Basin, Northern Rocky Mountains, USA-Canada
works.abstract: Abstract Metasedimentary rocks of the Mesoproterozoic Belt Supergroup in the United States and correlative Purcell Supergroup in Canada contain diverse types of mineral deposits with a variety of commodities including base metals, precious metals, and critical metals. The economically most important deposits (≥ 10 Mt past production + reserves + resources) are stratabound Pb–Zn–Ag ores at the Sullivan mine in southeastern British Columbia, Ag–Pb–Zn–(Cu) veins of the Coeur d’Alene district in northern Idaho, stratabound sediment-hosted Cu–Ag deposits of the Spar Lake, Montanore, and Rock Creek deposits in western Montana, stratabound Co–Cu–Au–(Bi–Y–REE) ores of the Idaho cobalt belt, and stratiform Cu–Co–Ag at the Black Butte deposit in western Montana. Minor deposits in the region, also hosted in strata of the Belt and Purcell supergroups, are stratabound Pb–Zn–Ag deposits in southeastern British Columbia, and Th–REE–(Cu) veins of the Lemhi Pass district in northern Idaho and western Montana. Small prospects and occurrences include gold-quartz veins, Ag–Pb–Zn veins, Fe–(Cu–Au) deposits, and a variety of rare metals (Th, REE, Nb, Be, Sn) in pegmatites and carbonatites. High-precision geochronology of ore and gangue minerals, like in the Sullivan deposit, has yielded only Mesoproterozoic ages, but other deposits (Blackbird, Rock Creek, Coeur d’Alene, Lemhi Pass) have U–Pb and/or Re–Os ages that suggest Neoproterozoic, Paleozoic, and/or Mesozoic to Tertiary overprinting of older Mesoproterozoic mineralization, possibly linked in some cases to fluid flow during reactivation of deep basement structures. Some of the Paleozoic and younger ages are also attributed here to dissolution-reprecipitation of dated minerals and not to new metal introduction. An integrated assessment of the geochronological data reveals growing evidence for previously underappreciated roles of major mineralizing events occurring during the East Kootenay orogeny (1379 − 1325 Ma) and the Grenvillian orogeny (1150 to 980 Ma), with important implications for mineral exploration in many parts of the Belt-Purcell Basin.

works.title: In-situ elemental compositions and U-Pb ages of garnet and vesuvianite from the Cu-Zn skarn in the Dachang Sn-polymetallic district, South China
works.abstract: The Youjiang tin belt represents a globally significant Sn-polymetallic belt located at the junction between the Tethyan and Paleo-Pacific tectonic domains, yet its tectonic setting and relationship to adjacent tin belts remain poorly understood. Precise geochronological constraints are essential for deciphering ore genesis and its geodynamic evolution. This study presents U-Pb dating of garnet and vesuvianite for the Tongkeng-Yangjiaojian, Lamo and Chashan deposits within the world-class Dachang district, providing robust temporal constraints on its metallogenesis. Two garnet samples from the Tongkeng-Yangjiaojian skarns yield lower intercept ages of 92.8 ± 4.2 Ma and 92.1 ± 3.6 Ma, which are indistinguishable within analytical uncertainty from those obtained for the Lamo (93.9 ± 1.1 Ma) and Chashan (93 ± 10 Ma) deposits. In addition, vesuvianite from the Tongkeng skarn yields a U-Pb age of 90.6 ± 1.1 Ma. Trace element systematics reveal that U concentrations in all analyzed garnet samples correlate positively with LREEs rather than HREEs, indicating that U is predominantly incorporated into garnet as U4+ and occupies the X site through a mechanism similar to that governing LREEs partitioning. Positive correlations between U and W, Sn and In further suggest that a proportion of U also enters the Y site as U6+. The geochemical compositions of garnet and vesuvianite indicate that the Dachang skarn formed from the relatively oxidized, high-salinity magmatic-hydrothermal fluids. Integrated with previously published dates for the granite-related tin deposits across the adjacent Nanling Range, Southeastern Coast and Southeast Asian tin belts, these new ages support a model in which Late Cretaceous tin mineralization in the Youjiang tin belt formed in a back-arc extensional setting associated with rollback of the Neo-Tethyan oceanic slab.

works.title: Indium enrichment in sphalerite from magmatic-hydrothermal systems: Insights from the Sandaoqiao Pb-Zn-Ag deposit, the North Greater Khingan Range, NE China
works.abstract: The Sandaoqiao Pb-Zn-Ag deposit, located within the Erguna metallogenic belt of the Greater Khingan Range in NE China, contains exceptionally high indium (In) concentrations (up to 6000 ppm in sphalerite). This study provides a comprehensive analysis of In mineralization in the deposit, combining field geology, petrography, precise geochronology, in-situ sulfur isotope data, and trace element microanalysis. Zircon U-Pb ages from pre- and post-ore dikes bracket the mineralization event between 136.0 ± 0.7 Ma and 120.8 ± 0.6 Ma, while U-Pb dating of hydrothermal rutile yields a direct ore-forming age of 120.8 ± 5.8 Ma, contemporaneous with Early Cretaceous granite emplacement. In-situ δ34S values of sulfides range from 2.3‰ to 5.6‰, supporting a magmatic-hydrothermal origin. Sphalerite is the primary host mineral for In, with two generations (Sp-I and Sp-II) identified that record a progressive enrichment trend of In. The early Fe-rich Sp-I contains abundant chalcopyrite inclusions and has In concentrations of 70.3–443.3 ppm, whereas the late Sp-II without inclusions, exhibits significantly higher In contents (107.1–6037.1 ppm). Trace element mapping and correlation analysis indicate that In incorporation occurs mainly through the coupled substitution mechanism In3+ + Cu+ ↔ 2Zn2+. LA-ICP-MS data and physicochemical modeling suggest that the residence state of Cu in sphalerite, coupled with low temperature, reduced, and acidic hydrothermal conditions, facilitated pronounced In enrichment in Sp-II. These results offer new insights on the behavior of In during sphalerite crystallization in magmatic-hydrothermal systems. It further highlights the Sandaoqiao Pb-Zn(-Ag) deposit as a high potential In resource and identifies the Erguna metallogenic belt as a prospective target for In exploration.

works.title: Rapidly evolving composition of nebular infall recorded by magnesium isotopes in refractory inclusions
works.abstract: The 26 Al- 26 Mg systematics in calcium–aluminum-rich inclusions (CAIs)—the oldest known Solar System solids—has traditionally been used to provide high-resolution temporal constraints on the early Solar System evolution. More recently, the study of variations in the initial Mg isotope composition has emerged as a means to probe for potential compositional heterogeneity in the nascent solar nebula. Here, we report high-precision magnesium isotope data for a collection of 19 CAIs that captures the diversity of refractory inclusions. The data reveal widespread Mg isotope heterogeneity prior to 26 Al decay, covering a large range from −0.285 to +0.088‰. Combined with literature data, the distribution of Mg isotope heterogeneity in CAIs forms a continuum and no longer defines distinct populations. Our findings therefore suggest a continuous CAI formation process that captured a rapid temporal change in the composition of infalling material from the parental molecular cloud of the Solar System.

works.title: The fate of Venusian chlorine
works.abstract: Abstract Venus and Earth are alike in size and composition and share similarly productive histories of volatile degassing. Yet while chlorine is concentrated in Earth’s surface reservoirs, it is nearly absent from the atmosphere of Venus. The fate of Venusian chlorine offers insights into the evolution of magmatism and history of volcanic degassing on Venus and similar telluric planets. Here we explore the potential for sodalite (Na 8 Al 6 Si 6 O 24 Cl 2 ), crystallised from erupted volcanics, to act as a long-term chlorine-sink in planetary crust. By estimating alkaline melt production on Venus, we constrain chlorine sequestration into sodalite-stable alkaline volcanics. We find that phonolites containing up to 7 mol% sodalite can be produced through 91–98% fractionation of low-degree partial melts originating from the Venusian upper mantle. Overall, just ~750 m of alkaline volcanic resurfacing has the capacity to sequester an Earth-like chlorine budget within sodalite-bearing lithologies.

works.title: The coupled reanalysis global meridional overturning circulation imprinted by historic volcanic eruptions
works.abstract: Abstract The global ocean meridional overturning circulation (GMOC) is central for ocean transport and climate variations. However, a comprehensive picture of its historical mean state and variability remains vague due to limitations in modelling and observing systems. Incorporating observations into models offers a viable approach to reconstructing climate history, yet achieving coherent estimates of GMOC has proven challenging due to difficulties in harmonizing ocean stratification. Here, we demonstrate that multiscale data assimilation that integrates atmospheric and oceanic observations into two coupled models in a dynamically consistent way robustly retrieves the past 80-year GMOC. By diagnosing volcanic eruption-induced North Atlantic cooling and surface buoyancy loss, we show historic volcanic eruption events are imprinted in variability of the rebuilt GMOC. The Mt. Pinatubo (1991) volcanic eruption produces a multidecadal characteristic of the overturning evolution by the chain of enhancing diapycnal mixing - strengthening deep convection - mediated by eddy activities.

summary_bullets.key_findings: 历史火山喷发印记于翻转环流变异中，皮纳图博火山喷发通过增强深层对流产生多年代际演变特征。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次在动态一致框架下协调海洋层结，实现对全球经向翻转环流长期连续的同化重建。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为理解历史气候变异和海洋翻转环流对外强迫的响应提供了关键的观测约束与机制解释。

works.title: Mercury mobilization and export from the Greenland Ice Sheet using an ice-to-ocean approach
works.abstract: Abstract The Greenland Ice Sheet (GrIS) is a poorly constrained source of mercury (Hg) to Arctic ecosystems. We measured Hg concentrations and stable isotopes along an ice-to-ocean continuum to identify controls on GrIS Hg export. Early-season permafrost melt and rainfall produced high filtered total mercury (fTHg, ~17 pM) and monomethylmercury (MMHg, ~2 pM). As subglacial drainage evolved, particulate Hg doubled (from ~8 to 17 pM) and MMHg production remained elevated, indicating Hg mobilization from subglacial environments. Shifts in Hg stable isotope ratios and $$\Delta$$ Δ 199 Hg mass balance show supraglacial sources contribute 20–48% of exported Hg, suggesting subglacial inputs dominate the seasonal Hg flux. Fjord waters were enriched in fTHg ( ~ 10 pM) and MMHg ( ~ 2 pM) relative to rivers, consistent with particulate Hg transformations and terrestrial Hg inputs. The estimated GrIS Hg yield ( ~ 23 mmol km −2 yr −1 ) is similar to that of Arctic rivers and will likely increase with climate-driven mass loss.

works.title: The origin of Cretaceous-Palaeogene impactor revealed by nickel isotopes
works.abstract: Sixty-six million years ago, non-avian dinosaurs and other taxa went extinct during one of the largest mass extinctions in the history of life on Earth. The extinction was likely caused by an asteroid of unknown origin, responsible for the Chicxulub impact structure. Existing evidence identifies the impactor as an asteroid, similar to carbonaceous chondrites. However, carbonaceous chondrites are a diverse class of meteorites, leaving the exact nature of the impactor unclear. By measuring Ni isotopes in marine clays containing the impact ejecta, we constrain the impactor to one group of carbonaceous chondrites—CO chondrites—and some ungrouped chondrites. This study highlights the use of Ni isotopes in fingerprinting extraterrestrial materials on Earth. Given that CO chondrites are “dry” compared to the other carbonaceous chondrites and would have delivered much less volatiles, which are thought to be essential in causing the extinction, this work allows further studies of the mechanism behind the extinction.

works.title: Environmental phylogenetics supports a steady diversification of crown eukaryotes starting from the mid-Proterozoic
works.abstract: Molecular clock and preservation of early microfossil assemblages suggest that eukaryotes were present and already diverse more than ~1600 million years ago (Ma). Yet, the earliest identifiable eukaryotic crown group fossil only appeared around 1050 Ma, leaving a ~600 My gap in the Mesoproterozoic during which the evolution and diversification of early eukaryotes remain poorly understood. Here, we infer a timeline of eukaryote evolution using molecular clock and birth–death diversification models, including the large diversity of environmental sequences to take into account the uncultured majority of microbial life. Our analyses, based on a unique dataset of 75,975 nonredundant Operational Taxonomic Units and 77 well-supported fossil calibrations, indicate a steady diversification of crown group eukaryotes during the Proterozoic after the Last Eukaryotic Common Ancestor. We show that Archaeplastida was one of the earliest diversifying supergroups and the most diverse throughout the Proterozoic, suggesting that the first successful plastid endosymbiosis gave Archaeplastida a measurable evolutionary advantage. Discoba, Amoebozoa, and Rhizaria followed Archaeplastida in phylogenetic diversity throughout the Proterozoic, indicating that crown eukaryotes were already thriving in this Era. These results contrast with the common view that the geologically stable Proterozoic Era experienced little eukaryotic evolutionary innovation and indicate that all current supergroups were already established in the Mesoproterozoic.

works.title: Geochemical, Fluid Inclusions and Stable Isotopes Constraint on the Genesis of the Hendouabad Cu–Au Mineralization, Central Urumieh–Dokhtar Magmatic Arc, Iran
works.abstract: ABSTRACT The Hendouabad Cu–Au deposit, located in the central Urumieh–Dokhtar Magmatic Arc, represents a newly explored example of an epithermal deposit hosted by Late Eocene volcanic rocks of basaltic andesite to andesite composition. Mineralization occurs in two zones: A Cu–Au zone in the east and a Cu‐only zone in the west hosted by andesite, basalt and associated dikes. Ore minerals include pyrite, chalcopyrite, chalcocite, galena and bornite, and enargite with supergene assemblages of malachite, haematite and chrysocolla. Hydrothermal alteration is dominated by propylitic and silicic assemblages. Fluid inclusions yielded homogenization temperatures of 109–280°C and low‐to‐moderate salinities (1.6–9.0 wt% NaCl equiv.), with petrographic evidence of boiling. Stable isotope analyses indicate mixed magmatic–meteoric signatures, with quartz‐ and epidote‐derived δ 18 O fluid values ranging from +2.2‰ to +14.2‰ and sulphide δ 34 S values from (−12.0‰ to −5.3‰, CDT). These results suggest that ore‐forming fluids were derived from a magmatic source but were strongly modified by meteoric water infiltration and evolving redox conditions. The combined geological, petrographic, geochemical, fluid inclusion and isotopic evidence supports classification of the Hendouabad deposit as a structurally controlled low‐to‐intermediate sulphidation epithermal Cu–Au system formed through boiling, mixing and cooling of magmatic–meteoric hydrothermal fluids.

works.title: Complexly zoned clinopyroxenes and amphiboles from the end-Cretaceous alkaline lamprophyres of the Nir-Wandh igneous complex, NW Deccan Traps, India: Insights into trans-lithospheric magmatic plumbing system processes
works.abstract: The Nir-Wandh Igneous Complex (67 Ma) of the Kutch region, NW India, represents one of the earliest manifestations of alkaline magmatism within the Deccan Large Igneous Province. This study investigates the petrology and geochemistry of four camptonitic alkaline lamprophyre dykes which are characterized by complexly zoned clinopyroxenes and amphiboles, with minor apatite, FeTi oxides, and feldspar confined to the groundmass. Based on the presence or absence of olivine and the nature of clinopyroxene populations, the four lamprophyre dykes are divided into three groups: Group-A, Group-B, and Group-C. Four clinopyroxene varieties are identified: (i) P1-zoned colourless core phenocrysts with Cr-Mg-rich diopside cores and Ti-rich augite rims; (ii) P2-unzoned colourless Fe-diopside phenocrysts; (iii) P3-green core antecrysts zoned from Na-rich salite to diopside; and (iv) P4-grey core antecrysts zoned from salite to diopside. P1 occurs in Groups A and B, both P3 and P4 are restricted to the Group A, and Group C contains only P2. Three amphibole parageneses are also recognised, ranging from Ti-rich ferro-pargasite and kaersutite to Ti-rich magnesio-hastingsite, each with distinct host-rock associations. Bulk-rock geochemistry and isotopic compositions 87Sr/86Sri (0.70407 to 0.70441) and 143Nd/144Ndi (0.51279 to 0.51286) are similar across the lamprophyres and associated rocks, indicating a common origin. Trace-element modelling of melts in equilibrium with clinopyroxene suggests involvement of two distinct pulses of co-genetic magmas: (i) a camptonitic magma and (ii) a Na-Nb-Zr enriched evolved magma. Amphibole zoning and disequilibrium textures record inherited Fe-rich antecrystic cores and later Mg-rich phenocrystic rims, reflecting interaction between evolved and replenishing magmas. Textural evidence, mineral chemistry, and P-T estimates indicate prolonged fractionation, magma recharge and mixing, crystal recycling, and accumulation within multiple trans-lithospheric reservoirs. Thermobarometry suggests that the Kutch lithosphere was at least ~70 km thick during emplacement. These results demonstrate that pyroxene and amphibole zoning in lamprophyres provides valuable constraints on magma generation depths, mixing processes, and the architecture of trans-lithospheric magmatic plumbing systems.

works.title: Coupled continental and reverse weathering influence on Cenozoic cooling revealed by the marine lithium cycle
works.abstract: The Cenozoic transition from greenhouse to icehouse climate has been commonly attributed to enhanced silicate weathering driven by tectonic uplift and intensified erosion. However, the manner in which increased physical erosion translates into climate cooling via regulation of the long-term carbon-silicon cycle remains poorly constrained. We apply coupled seawater lithium concentration and lithium isotope composition to reconstruct the Cenozoic evolution of the marine Li cycle and associated surficial C-Si processes. Our results show a pronounced increase in riverine δ7Li (∼13‰) over the Cenozoic accompanied by a modest rise (0.5×) in weathering flux, but a modest decline (0.6×) in marine authigenic clay formation (reverse weathering). These trends indicate that with progressive denudation and climate cooling, weathering congruency significantly declined, reducing CO2 consumption and thereby allowing silicate weathering fluxes to rise only slightly. Concurrently, suppressed reverse weathering reflects a reorganization of marine Si cycling, which further reduced CO2 release to the atmosphere. Our refined marine Li cycle suggests that both continental silicate weathering and reverse weathering contributed to Cenozoic cooling, likely reflecting a reorganization of the global C-Si cycle.

works.title: Geochronology and geochemistry of titanite from the Haita uranium deposit: Constraints on genesis and evolution of coarse-grained uraninite
works.abstract: Coarse-grained uraninite in the Haita area (Miyi County, Sichuan Province, China) is characterized by exceptionally large crystal sizes and euhedral forms. However, uraninite in this district has experienced substantial post-ore alteration. This study therefore focuses on well-preserved remnant titanite domains for in-situ analysis to minimize screening costs and ensure data reliability. Titanite U–Pb analysis yields a concordant age of 765.5 ± 8.6 Ma, representing the crystallization age of uraninite and indicating a Neoproterozoic mineralization event. Titanite geochemical analysis indicates that the ore-forming fluids were enriched in F–H2O and other mineralizing agents, with REE patterns comparable to those of coarse-grained uraninite and high-temperature magmatic uraninite deposits. Thermobarometric estimates reveal that titanite crystallized at 650–770 °C and 160–260 MPa. The uraninite–titanite–apatite–albite mineral assemblage and Ce–Eu anomalies collectively indicate that the ore-forming fluids were Ti4+-P5+-F−-Na+-rich and reducing. Uranium migrated as U4+–F− complexes in the fluids and precipitated as coarse-grained uraninite upon slow cooling and complex decomposition. Following crystallization, the U–Pb system remained open, yielding a discordant age cluster at 400–200 Ma that may record a thermal event, though further verification is required. In conclusion, remnant titanite can constrain the formation processes and crystallization age of coarse-grained uraninite.

works.title: Beyond Equilibrium: Kinetic Thresholds and Rheological Feedbacks Create a Potentially Complex 410 in Slab Regions
works.abstract: Abstract The seismic expression of Earth's 410 km discontinuity varies across tectonic settings, from sharp, high‐amplitude interfaces to broad transitions—patterns that cannot be explained by equilibrium thermodynamics without invoking large‐scale thermal or compositional heterogeneities. Laboratory experiments show the olivine wadsleyite phase transition responsible for the 410 is rate‐limited, yet previous numerical studies have not directly evaluated the sensitivity of 410 structure to kinetic and rheological factors. Here we investigate these relationships by coupling a grain‐scale, interface‐controlled olivine wadsleyite growth model to compressible simulations of mantle plumes and subducting slabs. We vary kinetic parameters across seven orders of magnitude and quantify the resulting 410 displacements and widths. Our results reveal an asymmetry between hot and cold environments. In plumes, high temperatures produce sharp 410s (2–3 km wide) regardless of kinetics. In slabs, kinetics exert first‐order control on 410 structure through three regimes: (a) quasi‐equilibrium conditions producing narrow, uplifted 410s and continuous slab descent; (b) intermediate reaction rates generating broader, deeper 410s with metastable olivine wedges resisting downward slab motion; and (c) ultra‐sluggish reaction rates causing slab stagnation with re‐sharpened, deeply displaced 410s ( 100 km). Rheological contrasts modulate these kinetic effects by controlling slab geometry and residence time in the phase transition zone. These findings demonstrate that reaction rates strongly influence 410 structure in subduction zones, establishing the 410 as a potential seismological constraint on upper mantle kinetic processes, particularly in cold environments where disequilibrium effects are amplified.

works.title: Felsic hydrothermal deposit formation by chalcophile metal concentration through mafic recharge and fluid-mediated sulfide dissolution
works.abstract: Hydrothermal sulfide deposits (e.g., porphyry and skarn) associated with felsic magmatism are major sources of chalcophile metals, including copper (Cu), molybdenum (Mo), gold (Au), lead (Pb), zinc (Zn), silver (Ag), and tin (Sn). However, the source of sulfur and metals remains debated. We report a study of clinopyroxene-hosted sulfide inclusions in mafic enclaves from the Beidashan granitic pluton (Northeast China), associated with a giant Sn-Pb-Zn-Ag-Cu deposit. Evidence shows the following: (i) immiscibility among Cu- and Zn-rich sulfide liquid, a silicate liquid, and an aqueous fluid during mafic magma emplacement in the upper crust; (ii) metal enrichment in FeS [iron(II) sulfide]–dominated melt inclusions (∼2628 parts per million of Cu, ∼233 parts per million of Zn, ∼275 parts per million of Pb, and ∼2.0 parts per million of Sn), reflecting strong partitioning into sulfide melts; and (iii) oxidative dissolution of sulfides by exsolved fluids, enabling metal transfer to the overlying felsic magma. The study demonstrates that metals in felsic-hosted deposits are sourced from subjacent mafic magmas and that mafic-felsic interaction triggered sulfide liquid/aqueous fluid cosaturation, ensuring efficient fluid-mediated chalcophile metal dissolution and transfer.

works.title: Chlorine isotope compositions of the southern Tibetan lithosphere indicate a mantle source for chlorine in collisional porphyry Cu systems
works.abstract: The India-Asia convergence generated a series of porphyry deposits formed in the post-collisional stage, yet the enrichment mechanisms of critical ore-forming elements such as chlorine (Cl) remain poorly understood. Multi-isotope systems, particularly Cl isotopes, offer a powerful tool to trace these material cycling processes. However, the limited understanding on the δ37Cl values of collisional zones have hindered our understanding of Cl cycling. To address this, we systematically collected ore-forming porphyries, granitoid batholiths, a deep crustal granulite xenolith, an ultramafic cumulate, and an ultrapotassic volcanic rock from the southern Tibetan Plateau. Apatite Cl and Nd isotopes, along with whole-rock boron (B) isotopes, were analyzed to constrain the Cl isotope compositions of various endmembers and to further trace the origin of Cl for porphyry ore-forming magmas. From the Late Cretaceous to the Oligocene, the Zedong granitoid batholiths exhibit progressively enriched apatite εNd(t) and decreasing apatite δ37Cl, indicating increasing involvement of a low-δ37Cl enriched crustal component. Two components are therefore recognized in the collisional crust: a juvenile, depleted crust with high δ37Cl (+0.62 ± 0.28 ‰), and a reworked, enriched crust with relatively low δ37Cl (−0.51 ‰). The post-collisional Qulong and Jiama porphyry deposits show significantly higher apatite δ37Cl values (Qulong: +0.88 ± 0.42 ‰; Jiama: +0.72 ± 0.61 ‰) compared to the Zedong granitoid batholiths (+0.11 ± 0.44 ‰), yet similar to those of ultrapotassic magmas (+0.85 ± 0.10 ‰) and the juvenile crust (+0.88 ± 0.46 ‰). Combined with Nd isotope evidence, we suggest that metasomatized lithospheric mantle (represented by the ultrapotassic magmas) and juvenile crustal components are the dominant sources of Cl in the collisional porphyry ore-forming magmas.

works.title: Subducted sediments hidden in the upper-mantle X-discontinuities
works.abstract: Sequestered sediments drive mantle chemical heterogeneity and enriched volcanism, yet their deep-mantle detection and geophysical interpretation remain enigmatic. Here, we identify sediment-related processes as a viable contributor to the upper-mantle X-discontinuities, through seismic velocity modeling of various sediment compositions coupled with mid-ocean ridge basalts and pyrolite in comparison to seismological observations. The sediment-derived formation of liebermannite (KAlSi_3O_8) and stishovite (SiO_2) at 250–350 km depths can generate substantial seismic anomalies (4.0–19.4% and 3.2–15.3% increases in shear and compressional wave velocities, respectively), with minimal sensitivity to sediment compositional variations. These results suggest that the upper-mantle X-discontinuities may represent transient phase-transition windows through which subducted sediments migrate and become seismically detectable. Once these sediments are entrained by upwelling mantle plumes, they may yield distinct enriched geochemical signatures observed in ocean island basalts originating from hotspots associated with the X-discontinuities. Sediment-related phase transitions enhance the seismic detectability of recycled sediments in the upper mantle, linking intermittent X-discontinuities to hidden sediment-bearing domains and providing a geophysical means of probing mantle chemical heterogeneity.

works.title: Triassic alkaline magmatism of the North China Craton and its implications for craton evolution
works.abstract: Triassic alkaline magmatism is widespread across the North China Craton (NCC), occurring along its northern margin, the Liaodong–Jiaodong–North Korea region, and the Lesser Qinling orogen. These rocks can be broadly grouped into syenitic complexes, mafic dikes, and carbonatites. They were derived from low-degree partial melting of a volatiles-bearing clinopyroxene-rich subcontinental lithospheric mantle (SCLM) within the garnet stability field, followed by varying degrees of fractional crystallization and crustal assimilation. Integrated zircon Hf-O isotopes, together with whole–rock geochemical and radiogenic isotopic data, indicate that the SCLM beneath the NCC underwent spatially heterogeneous metasomatism. Beneath the northern margin and the Lesser Qinling orogen, mantle enrichment is attributed to melts or fluids derived from subducted oceanic crust and sediments, linked to the Paleozoic–early Mesozoic subduction of the Paleo-Asian and Paleo-Tethyan oceans, respectively. In contrast, the Liaodong–Jiaodong-North Korea region records modification by recycled continental crustal materials, associated with the Triassic deep subduction and subsequent exhumation of the Yangtze Craton. This pervasive metasomatism introduced abundant fertile components and volatiles into the SCLM, thereby weakening its rheological and physical properties. Together with subsequent modification related to Paleo-Pacific plate subduction, these processes likely promoted lithospheric instability and contributed to the ultimate destruction of the NCC at ca. 120 Ma.

works.title: Origin of the Caotan Fe-rich carbonatite in Qinling Orogenic Belt: Evidence from petrographic, mineralogical, and geochemical study
works.abstract: Carbonatites are mantle-derived igneous rocks and important global resources of rare earth elements (REEs) and niobium (Nb). However, the processes responsible for the formation of iron (Fe)-rich carbonatites and their associated Fe mineralization remain poorly constrained. The Caotan carbonatites, located along the southern margin of the North China Block, are distinctly Fe-rich and lithologically diverse, comprising both calcite- and dolomite-dominated varieties. These features contrast sharply with nearby calcite-dominated carbonatites associated with Mo–REE–U–Pb polymetallic mineralization, such as those at Huanglongpu and Huayangchuan. This discrepancy suggests that the Caotan rocks followed a distinct magmatic evolutionary pathway, although their petrogenesis and the mechanisms responsible for Fe concentration remain unclear. In this study, detailed petrographic observations define an evolutionary sequence: dolomite–calcite carbonatite → dolomite carbonatite → magnetite–forsterite–calcite carbonatite → baryte- and tremolite-bearing calcite assemblages. Magnetite, the dominant Fe-bearing mineral, occurs as sparse, fine-grained crystals in the early dolomite-bearing carbonatites but becomes abundant in the magnetite–forsterite–calcite stage, where it forms euhedral to subhedral coarse phenocrysts containing ilmenite exsolution lamellae. Major-element and REE systematics of carbonates indicate intense fractional crystallization. Early crystallization and removal of Fe-poor calcite, accounting for up to approximately 75 vol% of the cumulate assemblage, progressively enriched the residual carbonatitic melt in Fe. Notably, in situ Sr isotopic analyses reveal a pronounced shift from less radiogenic initial values in the early carbonatites [(87Sr/86Sr)i = 0.70411–0.70457] to significantly more radiogenic ratios in later-stage magnetite–forsterite–calcite, baryte–calcite, and tremolite–calcite assemblages [(87Sr/86Sr)i = 0.70573–0.70604], indicating substantial crustal assimilation. We therefore propose that Fe enrichment was initially promoted by fractional crystallization of Fe-poor calcite, which progressively concentrated Fe in the residual melt. However, the critical trigger for magnetite saturation and Fe mineralization was subsequent interaction between the carbonatitic melt and surrounding wall rocks, leading to antiskarn formation, elevated silica activity, and ultimately magnetite precipitation.

works.title: Multi-component crustal recycling recorded by LiMg isotopes in Emeishan mafic–ultramafic layered intrusions with implications for Fe–Ti–V metallogeny
works.abstract: The Emeishan Large Igneous Province (ELIP), generated by Late Permian mantle plume activity, hosts world-class Fe–Ti–V deposits within mafic–ultramafic layered intrusions. Although increasing evidence suggests that crustal materials play an important role in ore formation, the nature and proportion of crustal components incorporated into the mantle sources of these intrusions remain poorly constrained. Here we present whole-rock major and trace element data together with Li, Mg, Sr, and Nd isotopic compositions for four representative ELIP intrusions (Panzhihua, Baima, Taihe, and Hongge) to address this issue. These intrusions exhibit trace-element patterns and SrNd isotopic characteristics comparable to those of ELIP high-Ti basalts, indicating derivation from a broadly common mantle source. The samples display large variations in Li isotopic compositions (δ7Li = −6.5‰ to 6.6‰), whereas Mg isotopic compositions (δ26Mg = −0.42‰ to −0.09‰) remain within the range of depleted mantle values. After excluding the effects of low-temperature processes, including surface weathering and shallow crustal contamination, we propose that the mantle sources of these intrusions were metasomatized by recycled crustal materials, including altered oceanic crust and sediments. Mass-balance modeling indicates contributions of approximately 0.15–8.25% altered oceanic crust, 1.06–5.48% terrigenous sediments, and 0.70–2.92% pelagic sediments to the mantle source. Recycling of these components likely introduced volatiles and metal elements into the plume source and increased its oxidation state, thereby creating favorable conditions for Fe–Ti–V mineralization in the ELIP. These results highlight the key role of crustal recycling in modifying mantle plume sources and enhancing the metallogenic potential of large igneous province magmatic systems.

works.title: Iron redox and hydrogen generation during multistage serpentinization under low silica activity: insights from the Heimulin serpentinites, central China
works.abstract: The redistribution and oxidation of iron during serpentinization are critical for quantifying hydrogen production and redox fluxes in subduction zones. This study investigates serpentinites from the Heimulin area in the Qinling Orogen, central China, to constrain their evolution and identify the factors controlling Fe3+ incorporation into serpentine minerals and associated H2 generation. Whole-rock geochemical compositions and the chemistry of relict primitive Cr-spinel domains indicate that the protoliths were highly refractory forearc mantle peridotites. The enrichment patterns of fluid-mobile elements closely resemble those of forearc serpentinites such as those from the Mariana, suggesting the protolith was hydrated by slab-derived fluids in a shallow forearc region. Mineralogical analyses identify four distinct types of lizardite, reflecting the sequence of serpentinization. Initial low-temperature serpentinization produced some Type-1 lizardite grains, in which Fe3+ was incorporated into the crystal lattice through dioctahedral substitution. When silica activity became sufficiently low, hydration of olivine produced Fe-rich brucite and some Type-1 and Type-2 lizardite grains that lack evident Fe3+ substitution. As serpentinization progressed, local increases in silica activity, driven by mineralogical heterogeneity (e.g., orthopyroxene dissolution) or influx of SiO2-rich external fluids, induced breakdown of Fe-rich brucite and promoted the formation of fine-grained magnetite and some Type-2 lizardite grains, in which Fe3+ was incorporated into the crystal lattice through cronstedtite substitution. Since redox reactions primarily occur during interactions between brucite and SiO2-rich fluids, and given the widespread occurrence of cronstedtite-type substitution in natural lizardite, the formation of Fe3+-serpentine with tetrahedral Fe3+ may indicate that hydrogen production has reached the main stage. During subsequent recrystallization, the Fe3+-deficient environment favored the transformation of lizardite into chrysotile asbestos. Simultaneously, silica-poor conditions promoted the preservation of brucite, which aggregated and recrystallized to form economically significant fibrous brucite deposits. However, the chemical compositions of lizardite in recrystallized serpentinites, together with bulk-rock Fe3+/ΣFe ratios, indicate that Fe3+ was redistributed during recrystallization. Overall, low-temperature serpentinization of refractory peridotites under SiO2-poor conditions, followed by recrystallization, promotes the formation of economically valuable asbestos and brucite fibers.

works.title: Controls on REE enrichment in post-collisional alkaline rocks by subduction-related metasomatism: insights from the Zhuopan Complex, southeastern Tibetan plateau
works.abstract: Alkaline complexes host important economic rare earth element (REE) resources which are of critical strategic importance in modern technology and industry. The REE mineralization associated with alkaline rocks is generally formed in the post-collision settings, but the mechanisms of REE enrichment in their source region remain poorly constrained. The Paleogene Zhuopan alkaline complex hosting the Yongping REE deposit was emplaced in a post-collisional setting following the Indo-Asian continental collision. This complex exhibits geochemical characteristics enriched in K2O and incompatible elements (including large-ion lithophile elements, high-field-strength elements, and REEs), coupled with enriched Sr-Nd-Hf isotopic compositions and crust-like REE and trace element signatures. The Zhuopan alkaline complex originated from low-degree partial melts of an enriched lithospheric mantle source (garnet-phlogopite-amphibole lherzolite) modified by subduction slab-released fluids, which subsequently underwent fractional crystallization. The geochemically consistent REE enrichment in the Zhuopan complex was not primarily controlled by shallow-level magmatic processes, but rather via preferential extraction from amphibole-bearing metasomatic mantle during melting events. Globally distributed alkaline rocks hosting REE deposits demonstrate geochemical affinities comparable to those of the Zhuopan complex. These findings highlight that ancient subduction-related metasomatic processes exert critical control on the formation of post-collisional alkaline rocks hosting REE deposits worldwide.

works.title: First-principle study of mineral-solution equilibrium isotope fractionations of magnesium, sulfate and calcium in CaCO3
works.abstract: Chemical impurities in CaCO 3 minerals, present as ion substitutions (e.g., Mg 2 + -for-Ca 2 + , SO 4 2 − -for-CO 3 2 − ) are common. Impurities incorporated into a carbonate lattice have a different physicochemical environment than their aqueous forms, resulting in isotopic fractionations of these impurity atoms between the mineral and its parent fluid. Moreover, the lattice distortion in the presence of impurities is proportional to the impurity concentrations, potentially leading to a concentration-dependent effect on the mineral-fluid isotopic fractionation of the impurities and the major elements in the minerals. A mechanistic understanding of the effects of impurities in CaCO 3 minerals on the mineral lattice and the isotopic fractionation of the impurities and major elements is necessary for the use of carbonate minerals and their trace elements as paleo-environmental archives. The difficulty in achieving isotopic equilibrium during experimental precipitation of carbonate minerals motivates the calculation of equilibrium isotope effects by ab initio density functional theory (DFT) methods. However, the utility of DFT calculations in constraining the effects of impurity elements in carbonate minerals on the isotopic fractionation of both the impurities themselves and the major elements in the mineral is limited by computational feasibility. Even a single substitution in a model lattice, composed of as many atoms as computationally feasible for DFT calculations, results in impurity concentrations that are higher than those typical of most natural and experimental samples. Using DFT, we systematically modeled a range of calcite and aragonite supercell sizes with a single Mg or carbonate-associated sulfate (CAS) impurity, allowing calculation of the dependence of the CaCO 3 -fluid isotopic fractionation on the impurity concentration. We studied the change in the impurity bonding environment and computed phonon frequencies to calculate the reduced partition function ratios and the fractionation of S, Mg and Ca isotopes between the CaCO 3 and its parent fluid. We obtained a near-constant CAS-aqueous SO 4 2 − S isotope fractionation in calcite of 2.9‰ over a range of CAS concentrations between 26400 and 58600 ppm (sulfate mole fractions of 1/36 and 1/16), in close agreement with the highest-CAS experimental value of 2.9‰. We found a constant mineral-aqueous Mg 2 + Mg isotope fractionation over the range of modeled impurity concentrations of ∼ –8.6‰ in calcite and ∼ –7.2 to –8.8‰ in aragonite, in agreement with previous computational studies with similar Mg concentrations. We find a difference of up to ∼ 2.1‰ in 1000ln 44 α calcite and 1000ln 44 α aragonite between pure calcite and aragonite supercells and supercells of those minerals with 1/24 and 1/32 mole fractions of sulfate, respectively. A difference of up to ∼ 1‰ of 1000ln 44 α calcite and 1000ln 44 α aragonite from pure calcite and aragonite is observed with similar mole fractions of magnesium. These results highlight the effects of varying impurity concentrations in CaCO 3 minerals on the mineral-solution equilibrium isotopic fractionations of impurities and major elements, and the importance of understanding such effects for interpreting major and trace element isotopic variability in environmental and geological samples.

works.title: Fe–Mg isotope constraints on mantle processes and tectonic evolution of the Yilashan ophiolite, Tibet, China
works.abstract: The mantle processes and tectonic evolution of ophiolites in the Bangong–Nujiang suture zone remain debated, particularly regarding melt extraction, metasomatism, and chromitite formation in supra-subduction zone (SSZ) settings. Conventional tracers often fail to distinguish overprinting processes. Fe–Mg stable isotopes, which are sensitive to both partial melting and fluid/melt–rock interaction, offer a novel tool to fingerprint these processes. Here we present integrated Fe–Mg isotopic data, whole-rock geochemistry, and platinum-group element (PGE) systematics for harzburgites and chromitites from the Yilashan ophiolite (central Bangong–Nujiang suture zone) to address these issues. Harzburgites display near-chondritic δ56Fe values (0.02–0.09‰) and limited δ26Mg variability (–0.06 to 0.10‰), consistent with residues after high-degree melt extraction. Their depleted major element compositions, together with enrichment in large-ion lithophile elements and depletion in high-field-strength elements, require subsequent subduction-related metasomatism. In contrast, chromitites exhibit systematically lighter δ56Fe values (down to –0.31‰) and a wide range of δ26Mg values (–0.25 to 0.29‰), indicating pronounced isotopic heterogeneity. This variability is best explained by melt–rock interaction within focused melt pathways, consistent with the spatial association of chromitites with dunite channels, whereas alteration effects are not dominant but cannot be fully excluded. PGE systematics, including IPGE enrichment and distinct Pd/Ir–Pt/Pt* relationships, support chromitite formation from primitive boninitic melts, while harzburgite PGE patterns indicate melt infiltration or refertilization. Together, these data define a multi-stage evolutionary framework involving mantle depletion, subduction-related metasomatism, chromitite formation, and subsequent modification during cooling. Given current data limitations, this framework should be regarded as a working hypothesis requiring further testing.

works.title: Gastropod shells record larval migration from deep-sea hydrothermal vents to the euphotic zone
works.abstract: Larval migration plays an essential role in determining the distribution and evolution of invertebrate animals endemic to hydrothermal vents—disjunct and ephemeral habitats in the deep sea. However, technical obstacles have prevented field observation or tracking of their free-swimming, microscopic larvae. Our geochemical analyses of pre- and postmetamorphic parts of shells revealed that the plankton-feeding (planktotrophic) larvae of vent-endemic limpets migrate to the upper layers, in or near the euphotic zone (0 to 200 m). Oxygen isotopes indicated that the larvae experienced warm temperatures approximating conditions in the euphotic zone above the vent sites, whereas barium and manganese concentrations as proxies for hot vent fluids were much higher in postmetamorphic than in premetamorphic shells, dismissing retention under hydrothermal influence. Our results provide evidence for the influence of surface currents and temperature on the distributions of chemosynthetically nourished vent communities in the deep sea. These findings also contribute to modeling deep-sea ecosystem connectivity and planning protected areas.

works.title: Earthquake doublets in subduction zones are an Omori process promoted by megathrust tear fault interaction
works.abstract: Abstract Earthquake doublets—nearby events of similar size striking within a short period—have been a seismological puzzle for 50 years. Is the second event simply an unusually large aftershock, or do doublets arise from a distinct mechanism? If all subduction zones exhibit the same percentage of doublets, that would support the first view. But if some trenches generate many more than others, that would support the second. Here we find that while all doublets undergo Omori-type aftershock decay, the Solomon-Vanuatu subduction zone produces half the world’s doublets, ten times more than the other trench. We argue that this results from abundant near-vertical tear faults in its slab and forearc, with stress transfer more efficient between the subduction interface and adjacent tear faults than along the interface. Tear faults also segment the megathrust interface, hampering propagation of great earthquakes and so confining ruptures, resulting in a low M ≥ 8 quake rate. Thus, while doublets occur along all trenches, their abundance is mediated by tear faults.

summary_bullets.key_findings: 双震均遵循大森衰减，但所罗门-瓦努阿图因大量撕裂断层贡献全球一半双震。
summary_bullets.innovation: 揭示撕裂断层通过应力转移和分段作用调节双震丰度并抑制大震。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为俯冲带地震危险性评估和震源物理机制研究提供新视角与约束。

works.title: Two stages of Sn enrichment in granitic magmatism: insights from Sn isotopes of cogenetic minerals
works.abstract: The enrichment of tin (Sn) in high-silica (high-Si) granites is commonly linked to magmatic-hydrothermal processes, yet the respective roles of mineral crystallization versus fluid activity remain debated. Direct constraints on how individual minerals partition Sn and fractionate Sn isotopes during granite differentiation are particularly scarce. Here we report Sn concentrations and stable Sn isotope compositions (δ 122/118Sn3161a) for cogenetic minerals (muscovite, biotite, tourmaline, feldspar, quartz, spodumene, and cassiterite) and whole rocks from the compositionally zoned Pusila leucogranite pluton in the Himalaya. Tin is heterogeneously distributed among minerals: muscovite acts as the principal host and is isotopically heavier than the host rocks, whereas feldspar and quartz contain only minor Sn and are generally isotopically lighter. Cassiterite from pegmatites is also isotopically light, with a mean δ 122/118Sn3161a of 0.036‰. Whole‑rock δ 122/118Sn3161a values increase systematically from −0.035‰ in biotite granite to + 0.337‰ in albite granite, whereas pegmatites show larger Sn isotope variations (0.292‰ to 0.816‰). These observations reveal two distinct stages of Sn behavior. During the magmatic stage, progressive crystallization of feldspar preferentially removes light Sn isotopes from the melt, driving the residual magma toward heavier isotopic compositions while allowing Sn to behave incompatibly. In the pegmatite stage, low Nb/Ta, Zr/Hf, and K/Rb ratios, pronounced REE tetrad effects, and widespread sericitization indicate significant fluid activity. An exsolved Sn-bearing aqueous fluid precipitates isotopically light cassiterite in the pegmatites, leaving the residual melt isotopically heavier. Together, these results support a model in which Sn enrichment involves early magmatic pre‑concentration followed by fluid‑mediated redistribution and cassiterite precipitation. Our findings delineate the mechanisms of Sn enrichment in evolved granitic systems and demonstrate the potential of Sn isotopes as a tracer of magmatic-hydrothermal processes.
works.label: consider
works.translated_title: 花岗质岩浆作用中锡富集的两个阶段：来自同生矿物锡同位素的启示

summary_bullets.research_question: 在高硅花岗岩中，矿物结晶与流体活动对锡富集分别起何作用？
summary_bullets.methodology: 对喜马拉雅Pusila淡色花岗岩中共生矿物及全岩进行锡浓度和稳定同位素(δ122/118Sn)分析。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 岩浆阶段长石优先移除轻锡同位素使残余熔体变重；伟晶岩阶段流体出溶沉淀轻锡锡石，残余熔体进一步富重同位素。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次通过共生矿物锡同位素系统揭示岩浆与热液两阶段锡富集机理。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为示踪岩浆-热液成矿过程提供了锡同位素新工具，深化对稀有金属花岗岩成矿机制的理解。

works.title: Deeper solar wind penetration on the Moon’s farside from noble gas records
works.abstract: Krypton and xenon in lunar farside soils are derived from solar wind and suggest deeper penetration because the solar wind is not slowed by Earth’s magnetosphere. This contrasts with the nearside, according to noble gas analyses of soil samples collected by the Chang’e-6 mission. As the Moon lacked an atmosphere and global magnetic field for much of its history, volatile elements in lunar soils are established to originate primarily from solar wind irradiation and meteorite and comet impacts. Potential differences in volatiles and their origins between the near and far sides of the Moon are not well understood. Here we report the noble gas compositions of lunar farside soils sampled by Chang’e-6. The samples have low neon (Ne) isotope ratios, whereas krypton (Kr) and xenon (Xe) isotope ratios are distinct from those of meteoritic and cometary components and are solar wind-derived. Release patterns for krypton and xenon also indicate deeper solar wind penetration on the Moon’s farside, in contrast to Chang’e-5 and other nearside samples. This hemispheric difference can be explained by partially decelerated solar wind, slowed to ~200 km s^−1, reaching the Moon’s nearside as it passes through Earth’s magnetosphere, a process that does not occur for the farside Chang’e-6 soils. Thus, the Earth’s magnetosphere influences the overall velocity of solar wind bombarding the Moon, affecting its volatile distribution and isotopic variations.

summary_bullets.innovation: 首次利用嫦娥六号背面样本揭示地球磁层对太阳风速度及挥发物分布的调控作用。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为地月空间环境相互作用、月球表面挥发物分布及空间风化研究提供关键证据。

works.title: Four deep-sea technologies that could help detect deadly earthquakes and tsunamis
works.abstract: Deep-sea drilling ships, sea-floor sensors and repurposed Internet cables are helping scientists to study the last unmapped area on Earth. Deep-sea drilling ships, sea-floor sensors and repurposed Internet cables are helping scientists to study the last unmapped area on Earth.

summary_bullets.research_question: 如何利用深海技术监测海底地质活动以预警破坏性地震和海啸？
summary_bullets.methodology: 采用深海钻探船、海底传感器和改造的互联网电缆进行海底数据采集。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 这些技术能填补地球最后未测绘区域的观测空白，提升灾害预警能力。

works.title: Early tidal despinning history recorded in the tectonics of Oz Terra, Charon
works.abstract: Abstract Records of early geologic and thermal evolution after planetary accretion are rarely preserved on icy moons in the Solar System. Charon’s ~ 4.0 Ga surface age suggests the potential preservation of landforms induced from early orbital evolution. Here we show that despinning-induced stress inferred from compressive tectonic features explains latitudinal variations in the orientations and types of tectonic features in Charon’s northern highland, Oz Terra. In addition to global extensional features, we identify north-trending arcuate ranges in Oz Terra, interpreted as compressional in origin. Using an elastic dislocation model, we infer the geometry and kinematics of two thrust faults by fitting the observed tectonically induced topography. The inferred geometry yields a lower bound of 30–36 km for the elastic ice shell thickness at the time. The thrusts accommodate ~ 1 % east-west compressive strain in the equatorial area. The corresponding flattening change suggests an initial rotation period of ~ 14.3 h for Charon. The modeled stress patterns also account for the east-west extensional features. Our work suggests that Charon’s surface presents an example that records the planetary despinning history, which predates the proposed global extension and cryovolcanism on Charon. The coevolution of despinning and global contraction favors a cold start for Charon, offering insights into the early thermal evolution of icy satellites in the outer Solar System.

summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为冰卫星早期热演化与轨道演化耦合提供关键约束，支持冷启动假说。

works.title: High-resolution imaging of a sediment core reconstructs past monsoon seasonality
works.abstract: Assessing the response of the South Asian monsoon to rapid climate change requires understanding its seasonal driving mechanisms under changing climate conditions. Now, advanced geochemical imaging of an Arabian Sea sediment core reveals distinct seasonal responses to global and high-latitude climate forcing in the South Asian monsoon variability during the last deglaciation.

summary_bullets.research_question: 南亚季风在末次冰消期对快速气候变化的响应及其季节性驱动机制是什么？
summary_bullets.methodology: 利用阿拉伯海沉积岩芯的高分辨率地球化学成像，重建过去季风季节性变化。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 发现南亚季风变率对全球和高纬度气候强迫存在明显的季节性响应差异。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次通过高分辨率成像技术区分季风季节性信号，而非传统年均或单季指标。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为预测未来全球变暖背景下季风季节性变化及其气候影响提供了关键古气候约束。

works.title: The earliest amber from the Middle Devonian of China
works.abstract: Resin production is a major innovation in land plants, signaling the evolution of specialized secretory systems, complex terpenoid biosynthesis, and defensive and wound-sealing functions. Yet its origin remains poorly constrained because fossilized resin (amber) is exceedingly rare in Paleozoic deposits, with the earliest widely accepted amber record from the Late Carboniferous. Here we report the earliest known amber from the Middle Devonian of China (~385 million years old), extending the geological record of amber by ~65 million years. Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy and gas chromatography–triple quadrupole mass spectrometry reveal chemical signatures comparable to conifer-type amber. These data indicate that some Middle Devonian vascular plants—most plausibly progymnosperms or arborescent lycopsids—had already evolved biosynthetic capacity consistent with terpene synthase. The early emergence of resin production may have promoted the ecological success of Devonian-Carboniferous terrestrial floras by enhancing protection and wound sealing.
works.label: flagship
works.translated_title: 中国中泥盆世最早的琥珀

summary_bullets.research_question: 树脂分泌的起源时间不明，早期化石稀少，本文探究树脂（琥珀）在地质历史中的最早期记录。
summary_bullets.methodology: 采用傅里叶变换红外光谱和气相色谱-三重四极杆质谱联用技术，分析中国中泥盆世琥珀的化学指纹。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 发现距今约3.85亿年的最古老琥珀，将琥珀记录提前约6500万年，其化学特征与松柏类琥珀相似。
summary_bullets.innovation: 首次将树脂分泌的实证推到中泥盆世，揭示早期维管植物已具备萜烯合酶相关的生物合成能力。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为理解植物防御与伤口愈合机制的早期演化及陆地植物生态成功提供关键依据，对古植物学和化学生态学具重要价值。

works.title: Coevolution between crustal thickness and sulfur oxidation state in Gangdese felsic magmas
works.abstract: Whether the abundant sulfate (S6+) of oxidized felsic magmas at convergent plate margins is sourced from subducted materials or generated through magmatic differentiation remains poorly understood. Here, we use S content in apatite to track the evolution of S redox state in felsic magmas over the past ∼120 Myr in the eastern Gangdese, southern Tibet. Unlike previous studies that rely on apatite grains separated from igneous rocks, we measure S in apatite inclusions hosted in detrital zircon. This approach enables us to assess magmatic S oxidation across the orogenic crust on a significantly broader scale than permitted by limited rock samples. Our results show two episodes of systematically elevated apatite S contents in the eastern Gangdese: one during the Late Cretaceous (95-80 Ma) and another from the Late Paleocene to the Miocene (45-10 Ma), following the India-Eurasia collision. This apatite S trend is consistent with that of the magma fO2 reconstructed using zircon Ce-U-Ti oxybarometer. More importantly, both apatite S content and magma fO2, on average, correlate with crustal thickness. While source composition and assimilation processes may contribute to redox heterogeneity in felsic magmas, our findings point to the critical role of crustal thickness in modulating the oxidation state of felsic magmas on an orogenic scale. Finally, by tracing oxidized S through detrital zircon samples, which are easy to collect and analytically efficient, our approach may allow for quick and effective evaluation of regional potential for porphyry copper mineralization.

summary_bullets.research_question: 氧化长英质岩浆中的硫酸盐主要来源于俯冲物质还是岩浆分异过程？
summary_bullets.methodology: 通过测量碎屑锆石中磷灰石包裹体的硫含量，追踪冈底斯地区长英质岩浆硫氧化态的长期演化。
summary_bullets.key_findings: 岩浆硫含量与氧逸度在晚白垩世和晚古新世至中新世两阶段系统性升高，并与地壳厚度正相关。
summary_bullets.innovation: 利用碎屑锆石中的磷灰石包裹体替代传统岩石样品，实现区域尺度岩浆氧化态的快速评估。
summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为快速评价斑岩铜矿成矿潜力提供了高效新方法，并揭示地壳厚度对岩浆氧化状态的关键控制作用。

works.title: Heavy sulfur isotope of arc ultramafic cumulates revealed by S-rich apatite from the Dongwanzi intrusion, North China
works.abstract: Arc magmas generally have higher sulfur (S) contents and higher δ34S values than mid-ocean ridge basalts. However, it remains debated whether the enrichment of S is due to crustal processes or mantle metasomatism. We present elemental and S-Sr isotopic compositions of apatite from the Early Permian Dongwanzi ultramafic intrusion, northern margin of the North China Craton. This arc intrusion is composed of clinopyroxenite and hornblendite based on textural relationships. Clinopyroxenites contains interstitial apatite and euhedral cumulus apatite. Interstitial apatite grains have high Cl (0.36–1.10 wt%), and Th (16.1–130 ppm), and La/Yb ratios (52.1–112), high 87Sr/86Sr ratios (0.70370–0.70391), and low δ34SV-CDT values (−10.5 to +4.44 ‰), consistent with crystallization from late-stage trapped melts. In contrast, euhedral cumulus apatite grains have low Cl (0.23–0.71 wt%), high δ34SV-CDT values (∼ + 7.9 ‰), and La/Yb ratios (33.4–64.6), and low initial 87Sr/86Sr ratios (∼0.70337), indicative of growth from a relatively primitive magma. Compared to cumulus apatite in clinopyroxenites, cumulus apatite grains in hornblendites contain high F (1.45–2.69 wt%) and total REE + Y (1510–9830 ppm), and high 87Sr/86Sr ratios (0.70333–0.70351), but slightly low Cl (0.01–0.50 wt%) and δ34SV-CDT (7.06 ‰ to 8.25 ‰), which were attributed to progressive fractional crystallization coupled with limited wall-rock contamination from clinopyroxenite to hornblendite. As a result, the consistently high δ34S values of cumulus apatite indicate that crustal contamination only caused a limited S isotope variation (∼1 ‰) during the formation of the Dongwanzi intrusion. Using S isotopic compositions of cumulus apatite in clinopyroxenite, the parental magma has δ34S values of ∼ + 7.9 ‰. Such high δ34S values are best explained by sub-arc mantle metasomatism rather than by crustal contamination. Collectively, our study highlights that S isotopic composition of apatite can be used to track the S isotope evolution and to constrain S sources in arc mafic-ultramafic cumulates.

works.title: Genesis and geodynamic implications of Early Cretaceous granitoids in the southern Great Xing’an Range, NE China: The Laodaogou granitic complex
works.abstract: Mesozoic granitoids associated with Sn-Pb-Zn-Ag polymetallic deposits are prominent features in the southern Great Xing’an Range (SGXR), NE China. Understanding the origin and evolution of these granitoids is crucial for deciphering the associated mineralization and geodynamic processes. This study presents geological observations, zircon U-Pb ages, whole-rock major- and trace-element data, and zircon Lu-Hf isotopic analyses of the Early Cretaceous Laodaogou granitic complex in the SGXR. This complex, which hosts the Laodaogou Ag-Pb-Zn-(Sn) occurrence, consists of various types of plutonic rocks, including biotite monzogranites, biotite alkali-feldspar granites, alkali-feldspar granites, and porphyritic alkali-feldspar granitic dikes. Zircon U-Pb dating of these units yields Early Cretaceous ages ranging from ca. 145.3 Ma to 130.6 Ma. The four granite units exhibit broad variations in (K2O + Na2O)/CaO (5.63−56.64), FeOt/MgO (6.85−116.97), 10,000*Ga/Al (2.25−3.09), and Zr + Ce + Nb + Y contents (97.1−274.7 ppm). The elemental results coordinated U-Pb ages indicate that the Laodaogou complex exhibits high degrees of fractionation, evolving from I-type to A-type granites. The granite units show similar εHf(t) values (+7.7 to +16.1) and relatively young Hf model ages (650−165 Ma). It suggests that they were primarily derived from partial melting of a juvenile lower crust originating from a depleted mantle source. In the context of relevant published data, we propose that the retreating subduction of the Paleo-Pacific plate drove the Early Cretaceous magmatism in the SGXR. Asthenospheric mantle upwelling induced partial melting of the juvenile crust within the Central Asian Orogenic Belt, accompanied by magmatic differentiation and shallow emplacement. These processes culminated in regional Sn-Ag-Pb-Zn mineralization within the SGXR.

works.translated_title: 东北大兴安岭南部早白垩世花岗岩类的成因与地球动力学意义：以老道沟花岗质杂岩为例

summary_bullets.research_question: 研究大兴安岭南段早白垩世花岗岩成因及其与锡铅锌银成矿和地球动力学过程的联系。
summary_bullets.methodology: 结合地质观察、锆石U-Pb定年、全岩主微量元素及锆石Lu-Hf同位素分析。

works.title: Crustal growth and reworking of the Southern West African craton: Implications for regional tectonics
works.abstract: This contribution reviews the crustal growth of the West African Craton and its geodynamic evolution using whole rock geochemistry together with U-Pb geochronological and Lu-Hf isotopic records preserved in igneous zircon grains from felsic plutonic rocks. Our study shows that the crustal growth in the southern West African Craton during the late Siderian and most of the Rhyacian (~2350-2300 Ma and ~2300-2060 Ma, respectively) was largely driven by the opening and subsequent closure of a large oceanic basin that fragmented the Neoarchean continental lithosphere. This tectonic evolution involved two major orogenic cycles including the Eoeburnean (~2285-2120 Ma) and Eburnean (~2120-2095 Ma) orogenies, each marked by distinct pulses of both juvenile magmatism and associated crustal reworking. Geochemical, geochronological, and isotopic data acquired on Eoeburnean plutonic rocks are used to investigate the process leading to crustal growth and its evolution during the Rhyacian. In central and western Ghana, central Cote d’Ivoire, and Burkina Faso, melt derivation from sources where hornblende and/or garnet were stable is consistent with crustal thickening and the injection of mantle derived magmas. In contrast, eastern and southeastern portions of the sWAC record reworking of Archean crust, as indicated by negative ƐHf values, whereas the western Kénéma-Man Domain over in Liberia and Sierra Leone exhibit intact Archean continental crust. During the Eburnean orogeny, more extensive crustal melting occurred at both deep and shallow structural levels, with ƐHf values indicating both continued juvenile input and reworking of earlier crust, including ongoing reworking of the northern margin of the Archean Kénéma-Man Domain. Late-orogenic bimodal magmatism (~2095-2040 Ma) in southern Guinea is interpreted as a response to asthenospheric upwelling, likely triggered by lithospheric delamination or slab break-off following arc-continent collision. These magmatic rocks exhibit mixed isotopic signatures, consistent with contributions from both mantle-derived and reworked crustal sources. We propose that the tectonic evolution of the southern West African Craton was controlled by at least two partly synchronous subduction zone segments. The first was active during the Eoeburnean orogenic cycle and was southeast-dipping beneath the Archean BurGhana block in the eastern part of the craton. The second one was active during the Eburnean orogenic cycle and east-dipping, likely extending northwards into the Reguibat Domain and extended in the southern West African Craton where Precambrian terrains accreted onto the Archean Kénéma-Man Domain. The convergence and diachronous collision of intra-oceanic arcs with Archean lithospheric blocks (Kénéma-Man, BurGhana, Reguibat) marked the protracted closure of a ~3,500 km wide oceanic basin.

summary_bullets.research_question: 探讨西非克拉通南部在成铁纪晚期至层侵纪的地壳生长与构造演化机制。
summary_bullets.methodology: 利用全岩地球化学、锆石U-Pb年代学和Lu-Hf同位素记录进行分析。

summary_bullets.relevance_note: 为理解太古宙-元古宙过渡期大陆地壳生长及俯冲-碰撞过程提供了关键约束。

works.title: Geotectonic−metallogenic evolution of the Paleo-Tethys in the northern Tibetan Plateau: A synthesis from divergent to convergent settings
works.abstract: The tectonic evolution of the Paleo-Tethys Ocean and its associated metallogenic processes in the northern Tibetan Plateau are pivotal topics within the field of Earth sciences. Despite recent advances, a detailed understanding of its evolutionary history and metallogenic mechanisms remains elusive. This contribution, grounded in the metallogenic characteristics of the northern Tibetan Plateau from the late Paleozoic to early Mesozoic, provides a systematic dissection of the tectonic evolution of the Paleo-Tethys and its profound impact on the metallogenesis of this region. The study identifies two branches of the Paleo-Tethys. The northern branch, situated between the Kangxiwa−Animaqing−Mianlue suture zone and the Xijingwulan−Jinshajiang−Ganzi−Litang suture zone, represents the main ocean basin, whereas the southern branch, situated within the Longmu Co−Shuanghu suture zone between the Northern and Southern Qiangtang terranes, formed through post-arc expansion. This contribution not only clarifies the timing of initiation (Early Devonian) and closure (Late Triassic) of the Paleo-Tethys but also categorizes its metallogenic processes into two major types based on tectonic cycles—those associated with divergent settings and those associated with convergent settings. Metallogenesis associated with divergent settings is exemplified by the super-large Xiarihamu magmatic Ni-Cu-Co sulfide deposit, underscoring the role of Paleo-Tethys rifting in this ocean basin’s metallogenic evolution. In contrast, metallogenesis associated with convergent settings is characterized by numerous medium- to small-scale late Permian to Triassic porphyry−skarn−polymetallic deposits and pegmatite-hosted Li-Be deposits, highlighting the significant contributions of oceanic subduction and collisional orogeny to mineralization. The discovery of Triassic super-large orogenic Au deposits in the Eastern Kunlun and Western Qinling orogens, as well as the pegmatite-hosted Li deposits at Dahongliutan and Jiajika, located in the Western Kunlun orogen and Songpan−Ganzi orogen, respectively, further supports the intimate link between the tectonic and metallogenic evolution of the Paleo-Tethys.

works.title: Time series analysis of mantle cycles, Part III: The 90 Myr cycle in the frequency of igneous zircon ages
works.abstract: A 90 Myr quasi-periodic cycle in zircon ages from igneous rocks has persisted for at least 3500 Myr. Although some age peaks from the 90 Myr cycle may correspond to the supercontinent cycle, there is no obvious relationship with the assembly or breakup phases. Our time-series of the globality of igneous activity shows that even the largest igneous events comprise less than 36% of the continental crust by volume. This implies that igneous events are regional rather than global in extent. The globality estimates of large igneous provinces are also rather small, in the range of 5%–15%, having a far smaller sample size than that from the igneous database. Another time-series shows that peaks in surface area of orogenic activity fluctuate proportionally to variation in igneous activity. This correlation indicates that the tectonic processes that trigger orogenic activity are closely associated with global variation in igneous activity. A dominant mantle event at 2700 Ma resulted in a rapid increase in the orogen/terrane area ratio, perhaps reflecting initiation of widespread plate tectonics. Considering the collective results from all time-series, the tectonic activity associated with the 90 Myr cycle appears to be regional and in any case not global. Both collisional and accretionary phases of orogens are characterized by mixed ε Hf(t) and ε Nd(t) values, positive in some instances and negative in others, with no discernable pattern. The large troughs in ε Nd(t) values at 2000–1800 Ma and 600–350 Ma correlate with the assembly of supercontinents Columbia and Gondwana-Pangea, respectively, and peaks in ε Nd(t) with positive signatures (1400, 1200, 800, and 700 Ma) correspond to the breakup of these two supercontinents. Although some of the peaks from the 90 Myr model have positive ε Hf(t) and ε Nd(t) and negative δ 18O suggesting juvenile crustal additions, they do not require net growth of juvenile crust because other peaks that align with this cycle have crustal reworking signatures. We speculate that the 90 Myr cycle is linked to periodic mantle magma generation caused by thermal instabilities in the deep mantle. This process could be reinforced by a related cycle in mantle plumes. It is also possible that some episodes of subduction, slab avalanches, and other upstairs-driven mantle events are at least partly controlled by an already existing 90 Myr cycle produced by these thermal instabilities in the deep mantle.
